title: Javautvecklare
description:
Vill du använda din problemlösningsförmåga och utveckla lösningar som gör skillnad för många? Hos oss får du möjlighet att skriva kod, utvecklas i din yrkesroll och samtidigt bidra till samhällsnytta varje dag. Upptäck ett mångsidigt uppdrag!
   

  

**Om jobbet**
 Skatteverket har höga ambitioner att bidra till den digitala transformationen som sker i Sverige. Skatteverkets it-avdelning är en av Sveriges största med omkring 1700 medarbetare som ansvarar för utveckling, drift och förvaltning av Skatteverkets it-landskap.
   

  

 På it-avdelningen utvecklar vi bland annat digital infrastruktur för andra myndigheter och för hela Sverige. Vi samverkar också med andra myndigheter för att skapa hållbara och effektiva lösningar. Exempel på områden vi arbetar med är AI-lösningar för snabbare och effektivare informationshantering, lösningar för hantering av moms och arbetsgivaravgifter samt datalager för skarpare analyser och bättre styrning.
   

  

 Vi arbetar agilt med stöd av ramverket SAFe och du är med och påverkar den förändringsresan. Du arbetar i ett team där ni tillsammans ansvarar för både utveckling och förvaltning. Du får möjlighet till varierande arbetsuppgifter med utvecklingsmiljöer som omfattar flera generationer av teknik, plattformar och verktyg.
   

  

 Skatteverket genomför just nu en övergång till en ny containerbaserad plattform, OpenShift Container Platform (OCP). I rollen som Javautvecklare finns det möjlighet att utvecklas inom containerteknik. Tillsammans med dina kollegor bidrar du till samhällsnytta samtidigt som du utvecklas och har roligt på jobbet. Vi är en stor it-avdelning som erbjuder dig utvecklingsmöjligheter både på djupet och på bredden. Du har flexibel arbetstid och det är en självklarhet för oss att du har balans mellan arbete och fritid.
   

  

 Skatteverkets it-avdelning arbetar aktivt för en inkluderande arbetsplats präglad av jämställdhet och mångfald, där alla medarbetare ges lika möjligheter att bidra och utvecklas.
   

  

 Läs mer på Jobba med it hos oss
   

  

 Du är placerad i Sundbyberg.
   

  

**I Det Här Jobbet Ska Du**
* vara resultatinriktad och se till både gruppens och din egen prestation
* agera medvetet och professionellt utifrån en god självinsikt
* ha förmågan och viljan att lära dig nya saker, vara flexibel och kunna ställa om vid förändringar
* ha god samarbetsförmåga, vara hjälpsam och ha ett gott bemötande
* kunna analysera informationsflöden, se samband, mönster och göra avgränsningar.


**Du Ska Även Ha**
* högskoleutbildning om minst 180 högskolepoäng (120 poäng) inom IT‑området, alternativt flerårig aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant
* minst tre års aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet av programmering inom Java
* flerårig, aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet av containerplattformar
* flerårig, aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet av integrationer och dataflöden
* aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet av generativ AI
* god kommunikationsförmåga i tal och skrift på svenska.


 Det är önskvärt att du har flerårig, aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet av agila arbetssätt samt arbetslivserfarenhet av Git och Spring Boot. Vidare vore det önskvärt att du har arbetslivserfarenhet av frontendramverk, t.ex. Vue eller React.
   

  

**Bra att veta**
 Anställningen är tillsvidare och kan inledas med provanställning i sex månader.
   

  

 En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.
   

  

 På skatteverket.se/jobb kan du exempelvis läsa om vår samhällsbärande roll, fördelarna med att jobba hos oss och hur det går till när du söker våra jobb.
   

  

 När du ansöker bifogar du ditt cv. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar och du ska därför inte bifoga det i din ansökan.
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Senior Software Engineer (Python) – Life Science Instrumentation
description:
*Join Moleculent and play a key role in building the software backbone of a cutting-edge life science instrumentation platform!
   

  

 If you've built software for lab systems, medtech, instruments, robotics, automation, or machine vision, or you come from traditional software with experience in complex operational systems and want to work closer to a physical product,* 
*this could be your next step!*
*Moleculent is on a mission to build products that yield new insights into the molecular foundation of human biology. This is a chance to join a focused and dedicated team with extensive experience building successful life-science companies and products. Our platform combines hardware, imaging, data processing and you will help build the software that ties it all together and turns every instrument run into reliable, usable data.*
*This is a full-time, permanent position based on-site in Solna, Stockholm. Applications close on the 9th of November, but please apply as soon as possible. We review applications continuously, and the role may be filled before the closing date.*
*Applicants should be eligible to work in Sweden without sponsorship.*
**Job Description**
 As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll join our software team of experienced, driven engineers. You will work across the software that supports the instrument, from experiment orchestration and data processing to operational tools and deployment.
   

  

 You will work side by side with our software technical lead and collaborate daily with the software, analysis, and instrument teams. Over your first year, you will move from contributing across the stack to owning releases, reliability, deployment, and monitoring, with a growing say in architecture.
   

  

**Key responsibilities include:**
* Build and evolve the Python software, orchestration, and data-processing pipelines that run and support instrument experiments
* Investigate and solve problems that span software, data, infrastructure, and the physical instrument environment
* Improve reliability, monitoring, diagnostics and recovery across the platform
* Drive releases, CI/CD, deployment, and production readiness
* Build operational tools and interfaces for monitoring experiments, jobs, errors, and system health
* Automate engineering and operational work through scripts, tests, and AI-assisted workflows
* Review changes across the platform and gradually take ownership of architecture and operational decisions


**Qualifications**
 We're looking for someone with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. You have 5+ years of professional software development experience, including building software that runs in real-world products or operational systems. Professional proficiency in English is a prerequisite.
   

  

 It's also a strong plus if you have a background in scientific, instrument, robotics, automation, imaging, test-and-measurement, or medtech software.
   

  

**Required qualifications:**
* Strong hands-on Python development experience, with the maturity to take on growing technical ownership
* Experience developing software as part of a larger product or operational system, where software interacts with broader workflows, infrastructure, data, or physical equipment — not only isolated application services.
* Solid engineering fundamentals: readable, tested, and maintainable code, APIs, debugging, and code review
* Some experience with databases, production services, and deployment or CI/CD
* Comfortable working in Linux environments
* Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools, and you critically review, test, and take ownership of the changes they produce


**Bonus qualifications:**
* FastAPI, PostgreSQL or similar Python web/data frameworks
* Distributed task or compute frameworks (Ray, Celery or similar) and data-processing pipelines
* Docker, CI/CD systems (Azure DevOps, Jenkins or similar), or on-premise/edge/offline deployments
* Some React or TypeScript experience


 You will thrive at Moleculent if you are curious, pragmatic, and enjoy taking real ownership in a small team where your work directly shapes an important product.
   

  

 You like working in a goal-oriented, cross-functional environment where things move fast and change often. You are friendly and positive, with a passion for collaboration and innovation.
   

  

****MOLECULENT****
 We believe innovative biotechnology has enabled massive leaps forward in understanding the composition of tissues and organs. However, the functional understanding of how cells communicate in their native context and form these complex systems has just begun. We develop technology designed to uncover radical new insights into the cellular level of human biology by mapping the communication between cells in human tissue and providing meaningful data.
   

  

 https://www.moleculent.com/
   

  

 Please note that Moleculent manages the recruitment process for this position. External recruitment agencies are requested to refrain from direct contact with us in this regard.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Music Monetization & DRM
description:
**Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking, from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We’re an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Creating and collaborating to transform the sound of streaming, content, and culture. Come join us, and let the world
 *feel* 
 your work.** 




  





 We are looking for two Senior Backend Engineers to join our team. Your primary responsibility will revolve around Digital Rights Management (DRM) with a specific emphasis on social media platforms, where YouTube currently represents our predominant focus. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of music rights within the dynamic digital landscape.
 



  





 You'll leverage Google cloud services to enhance operations and contribute to innovative, efficient solutions. The role involves engaging with large datasets to derive data-driven insights, informing decisions for Epidemic Sound's revenue operations. The position offers a collaborative environment where your ideas are valued, and teamwork drives success. Additionally, you'll contribute to smart decision-making processes affecting revenue operations.
 



  





**Your Key Responsibilities Include** 



* Support our mission to make claiming and safelisting content smooth and secure for all users
* Take ownership of services end to end, including the infrastructure and monitoring around them
* Point us in the right direction when building services for our customers
* Monitor and optimise services that fetch and analyse data from UGC platforms like YouTube
* Work closely with data and machine learning engineers to ensure that our business operations can make the right decisions



  





**About You** 




 Experience with a strong command of backend technologies, you excel in designing, optimising and maintaining the core infrastructure that ensures our services run smoothly. Your expertise is particularly valuable when dealing with high-availability systems and complex partner API integrations.
 



  





 Your proficiency extends to processing and managing large data volumes efficiently, all while adhering to the stringent compliance requirements of social media platforms. Your technical acumen is most notable in designing services that are simple to reason about and straightforward for the next person to pick up.
 



  





 Moreover, your interest in areas such as Digital Rights Management (DRM) underscores your commitment to addressing backend challenges in handling and safeguarding large-scale datasets. Your contributions play a vital role in maintaining the integrity and reliability of our backend systems.
 



  





**Requirements** 



* Experience in backend development, ideally in Go, which is what we build our services in today
* Data expertise: excel in processing and evaluating large volumes of data, with proficiency in SQL for data processing and integration tasks
* Experience in algorithm evaluation, including testing and analysis of outputs
* Cloud experience, preferably Google Cloud Platform
* Comfortable building microservices, whether event-driven or request/response.
* Comfortable owning your infrastructure end to end (Kubernetes, Helm and Terraform)
* Strong communication skills: excel in English both written and verbal communication, crucial for collaboration and understanding in our global team



  





 Nice to have
 


* Proficiency in Kotlin, Java or Python is an advantage
* Some TypeScript and React, enough to build small internal tools yourself
* Interest in DRM protocols and practices is a bonus
* Familiarity with audio formats, codecs or streaming is a plus
* Exposure to machine learning systems in production is welcome



  





**Equal opportunity employer** 




 We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.
 



  





**Application** 




 Ready to make the world
 *feel* 
 your work? Please apply, in English.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
*While generic AI struggles with hallucinations and shallow analysis, Fortune 500 brands need strategic intelligence they can trust with billion-dollar decisions. We're building the specialized AI that delivers it.*
**We are Stravito and this is the problem we solve.**
 Stravito transforms how Consumer Insights professionals and Brand Managers work by building AI that automates their core workflows while eliminating hallucinations. We help world-leading organizations across industries accelerate strategic decision-making by turning millions of market research documents into intelligent systems that generate reports, discover insights proactively, and synthesize knowledge across vast content libraries.
   

  

**The Mission**
 Build the data backbone that powers billion-dollar decisions at world-leading companies. We're looking for a Backend Engineer to architect and evolve the content systems that handle millions of market research documents and enable strategic decisions at the world's largest brands.
   

  

 Your mission is to grow our robust, scalable content foundation that enables seamless access to business-critical content through APIs and reliable processing capabilities that other teams build upon.
   

  

 Our platform processes a massive amount of market research documents and data points, powering intelligent workflows for the core work our users do at global brands.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Unique**
* Foundation for AI innovation: Build the content infrastructure that enables our AI brain to process the data that matters.
* Enterprise-scale challenges: Handle content ingestion from global industry elading companies with diverse requirements
* Ownership: Your decisions impact how thousands of professionals access business-critical insights
* Cross-team enablement: Create and evolve the APIs and data models that empower our customer-facing product teams to innovate.


**What You’ll Do**
**Transform How Fortune 500 Companies Access Their Research Intelligence**
* Connect diverse ecosystems: Build and maintain robust integrations that seamlessly ingest content from diverse enterprise systems
* Design for scale: Create content processing systems that handle millions of documents while maintaining low API response times
* Enable AI innovation: Build the data models that power our AI brain's ability to synthesize insights across massive content libraries
* Set the technical foundation: Establish patterns, standards, and interfaces that enable product teams to rapidly build customer-facing features
* Optimize for performance: Ensure reliable, performant content systems across all ingestion channels


**What We Need**
* Back-end expertise: Strong experience designing and building distributed systems and handling large-scale content processing. We care more about your engineering fundamentals than any specific language or framework
* Cloud-native mindset: Hands-on experience running services in modern cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar), with containerization and infrastructure as code. Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices is important
* Integration mastery: Proven track record of building reliable APIs and integration patterns for diverse data sources and formats
* System thinking: Ability to design scalable, maintainable data models that empower other teams to build on top of them
* Collaboration & curiosity: Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, with a curious, innovative mindset that thrives in cross-functional teams with product and design
* Nice to have: Experience with search technologies such as Elasticsearch, exposure to front-end development (React/TypeScript or similar), deeper familiarity with AWS services


*The salary range for this role depends on location and will proactively be shared with you in the first interview.*
**What’s in it for you?**
 Join a remote-first, globally distributed team of 100+ professionals from 30+ nationalities, united by our core values: simplicity first, an 'own it, do it' mentality, embracing different perspectives, and enjoying the journey together. We bring everyone together for company events throughout the year to strengthen our global connections.
   

  

 You'll grow alongside seasoned professionals with deep expertise across AI, market research, and enterprise systems. We offer exceptional career development opportunities in our fast-evolving market, competitive compensation, and a collaborative culture where everyone actively supports each other's success.
   

  

 Most importantly, you'll have the satisfaction of simplifying the professional lives of thousands of Brand Managers and Consumer Insights professionals worldwide, making their strategic decisions more data-driven and impactful.
   

  

 Ready to build the AI that powers Fortune 500 strategy? Join us.
   

  

 Stravito is the insights platform for the world's leading enterprises, right in the middle of an exciting transformation from a SaaS company into a world-class AI company. We bring all of a company's customer and market knowledge into one place, making it findable, usable, and ready to act on, so insights teams can make sharper, fact-based decisions. Founded in Stockholm, Sweden in 2017, Stravito today works with some of the world's most recognised brands and is home to 100 employees across 10 countries in Europe and North America.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer – React & JavaScript  (Stockholm)
description:

* 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax
* An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

title: Senior Fullstack Developer to MittVaccin
description:
*Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.*
*Since 2012, MittVaccin has been a pioneer in digital vaccination services for residents and healthcare providers across Sweden. As part of Cambio since 2020, we continue to drive innovation that improves access to vaccinations and supports safe, efficient vaccination management. Today, MittVaccin is Sweden’s leading vaccination platform, trusted by 14 regions, 100+ municipalities, and 400+ healthcare providers nationwide. Since 2026, we have also expanded into Finland, marking the beginning of our international growth journey.*
**The position**
 As a Fullstack Developer, you will play a key role in developing MittVaccin, Sweden's leading digital vaccination platform. Working closely with developers, architects, and product owners, you will design and build modern, scalable solutions with a primary focus on backend development and infrastructure.
   

  

 This is a hands-on role where you will contribute to everything from architecture and new product development to operations and performance optimization. Rather than maintaining legacy systems, you will help modernize and shape the future of digital vaccination services.
   

  

 Joining a small, agile team with high autonomy and ownership, you will have a direct impact on products that support healthcare providers and improve public health across Sweden and beyond.
   

  

**About You**

title: Product Engineer
description:
Come join us as our Product Engineer
   

  

 We’re looking for a Product Engineer with a fullstack profile who wants to help us build the next generation of Mevisio and our platform.
   

  

 You’re comfortable working across the stack and have enough experience to take ownership of what you build – from understanding the problem to getting a solution into production. And AI of course, is already part of how you work. You use it to explore ideas, write and review code, debug, test, learn and move faster. Not because someone told you to, but because you genuinely like how it makes you and us faster and smarter!
   

  

 This is Mevisio
   

  

 Mevisio is a Swedish SaaS company building a platform that digitizes management and collaboration in the manufacturing industry.
   

  

 Our platform replaces the physical whiteboards traditionally used for daily meetings on the shop floor. Teams use Mevisio to visualize KPIs, manage activities, follow up deviations and bring real-time information together in one place. The platform is highly customizable and integrates with other systems, which makes the technical challenges both interesting and varied. Today, Mevisio is used by large manufacturing companies across the world.
   

  

 Why Mevisio
   

  

 We’re a small SaaS company with large international customers and a lot left to build. That means you’ll get close to the product, the customers and the decisions. You won’t only receive finished tickets and implement them. We want you to understand the problem, challenge ideas and help us figure out the best solution.
   

  

 Our values – People Matter, Aim High, Better Together and Customer First – guide how we work with our customers and with each other, which must be your core too.
   

  

 What will you do?
   

  

 You’ll work across our product – from frontend experiences to backend services, APIs, data and integrations. You’ll build new features, improve what already exists and solve technical problems that come from running a flexible platform used by manufacturing companies around the world.
   

  

 Because we’re a small team, you’ll be involved throughout the process. You might discuss a customer problem in the morning, figure out a solution together with the team and start building it the same day.
   

  

 AI is a natural part of our work. We want you to experiment with how modern AI tools can help to continuously improve the development process , work faster and better – while still taking responsibility for the quality, security and maintainability of what we ship. We want someone who is passionate about building a software factory, automated operations, and an AI-assisted product work!
   

  

 What does a day look like?
   

  

 We always start the day with freshly brewed coffee and some chat about what’s going on. After that, you might work on a new product feature, investigate a problem reported by a customer or discuss an upcoming solution. You could spend part of the day in the frontend, move over to an API or backend service and later use an AI coding agent to explore a solution, refactor something or help you test an idea. Some problems will have a clear answer. Others won’t. We want you to be comfortable figuring things out along the way and dig deeper when it’s needed.
   

  

 For lunch, we usually have a box or get something from the restaurants near the office. But lunches are most of the time eaten together. Music can be played at times too, and we would love to hear your favorite!
   

  

 What we think you will bring to us
   

  

 You don't need to have been developing software for ten years. We're looking for someone around mid-level, with a solid technical foundation and enough experience to work independently.
   

  

**We Think You Have**
* A few years of professional experience in full-stack software development.
* Experience building and shipping real web applications across both frontend and backend.
* A university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering Physics or another relevant technical field is a plus.
* Solid knowledge of modern web development, APIs, databases and software architecture.
* Experience working with cloud-based applications and modern development practices.
* The ability to take a feature or problem from idea to production.
* Professional fluency in English.
* Experience from B2B SaaS, integrations or complex configurable products is a plus.
* Basic understanding of LLM principles and limitations, agent host architecture and security practices, MCP protocol


***And then there’s AI... again...***
 We’re genuinely interested in how AI is changing software development, so this part matters to us.
   

  

 You already use tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar as part of your everyday development workflow. You’re curious about what these tools can do, but you also understand their limitations. You don't blindly accept generated code – you review it, understand it and take responsibility for what ends up in production.
   

  

 Maybe you've also experimented with agents, LLM APIs or AI-powered product features. That's a plus, but not a requirement. What matters most is that AI isn't something you're waiting to start using. You're already exploring what it means to be a developer in an AI-native world.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

 You’re curious, pragmatic and like building things. You enjoy solving problems without needing every detail specified in advance. You take responsibility for your work, but you're not afraid to ask for input or challenge an idea when you think there’s a better way.
   

  

 You like learning new things and sharing what you discover with the people around you. And while you care about moving fast, you also care about building things properly. We’re a small team, so who you are matters just as much as what you’ve done before.
   

  

**Other Perks And Benefits**
 🚆 Centrally located office near public transit
   

  

 🏖️ 30 paid holidays annually
   

  

 💪 Attractive wellness contribution
   

  

 📈 Pension plan
   

  

 🪐 Opportunities for professional development
   

  

 🔕 Flexible working hours and hybrid office setup
   

  

 🎊 Regular social gatherings and team activities
   

  

 💻 Latest tech gear
   

  

 ☕️ Coffee and tea every day
   

  

***Come join us and build the best solution out there! And let's have fun while doing it!***
***NOTE: we already have an external partner in this recruitment why we kindly ask other firms not to contact us!***
 Mevisio is a powerful platform designed to elevate operational performance for leaders and teams, driving efficiency through smart visualization and enhanced communication. Our application transforms traditional whiteboards into interactive touch screens, displaying real-time KPIs and activities tailored to each client's needs. Trusted by global companies and digital leaders, Mevisio is deployed in over 3,000 facilities across 60+ countries, with more than half of our revenue coming from international markets.
   

  

 Our customizable platform integrates seamlessly with other systems, supporting clients in diverse industries, particularly manufacturing and healthcare, where Lean principles thrive. By reducing waste and boosting safety and sustainability, Mevisio empowers organizations to achieve operational excellence and improve their overall performance.

title: Senior Game Developer (Game Feel, UI, Animations, VFX) - Paper.io2
description:

Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.
   

  

 This position can be fully remote within CET +/-2h.
   

  

 Team

Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.
   

  

 You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on

**.**

 Role

 Profile
   

  

* 5+ years of professional experience in C# and Unity
* Proven track record in successful mobile game development
* Exceptional expertise in a specialized area (e.g., animation, particle systems, shaders, architecture, performance optimization or networking) is a major plus

title: Systemutvecklare
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla moderna systemlösningar som stärker ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag? Är du en systemutvecklare som både trivs med att bygga nytt och ta ansvar för långsiktig förvaltning och vidareutveckling? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig.
   

  

 Åklagarmyndigheten står inför flera utvecklingsinitiativ där AI och informationshantering får en allt viktigare roll. Nu bygger vi upp ett nytt utvecklingsteam och söker en systemutvecklare med fokus på AI som vill vara med och utveckla, förvalta och vidareutveckla våra lösningar.
   

  

 Rollen omfattar hela livscykeln, från analys och design till driftsättning och förvaltning. Du kommer att vara en viktig del i uppbyggnaden av ett nytt utvecklingsteam och bidra till utvecklingen av både verksamhetskritiska system och myndighetens AI-plattform. Arbetet kombinerar modern systemutveckling med AI-baserade lösningar och kräver ett helhetsperspektiv där kvalitet, säkerhet och hållbarhet är centrala delar.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**
 Som systemutvecklare med inriktning AI arbetar du med utveckling och förvaltning av våra system och plattformar och ansvarar för att skapa robusta, säkra och hållbara lösningar. Du medverkar också i utvecklingen av myndighetens AI-plattform och arbetar med hela kedjan i moderna RAG-lösningar, från dokumenthantering och indexering till sökning och kvalitetssäkring av svar.
   

  

 Arbetet omfattar både utveckling och förvaltning av verksamhetskritiska system samt vidareutveckling av myndighetens AI-plattform. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter är:
   

  

* utveckling, förvaltning och vidareutveckling av verksamhetskritiska system, huvudsakligen i Python
* design, utveckling och förvaltning av API:er, integrationer och tekniska gränssnitt
* felsökning, produktionssättning och teknisk support i nära samarbete med verksamheten
* utveckling av testbar, robust och underhållbar kod med stöd av versionshantering och CI/CD
* dokumentation, övervakning och livscykelhantering av lösningar och tjänster
* deltagande i arkitektur- och designarbete med fokus på säkerhet, kvalitet och förvaltningsbarhet
* vidareutveckling av vårt ramverk för AI-orkestrering och RAG
* utveckling av den vektorbaserade sökplattformen och tillhörande tjänster
* utveckling av funktioner för generativ AI, dokumenthantering, indexering och sökning
* utveckling och kvalitetssäkring av spårbar och behörighetsstyrd informationsåtkomst


**Vi söker dig som har**
* högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, dataingenjörsutbildning eller annan relevant utbildning, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
* flerårig erfarenhet av utveckling och förvaltning av produktionssatta systemmiljöer
* flerårig erfarenhet av utveckling i Python
* erfarenhet av objektorienterad utveckling och moderna utvecklingsmetoder
* erfarenhet av versionshantering och CI/CD-processer
* erfarenhet av API-utveckling och systemintegrationer
* god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift


**Som person vill vi att du**
* är självgående, ansvarstagande och driver arbetet från utveckling till förvaltning
* har lätt för att samarbeta och skapa goda arbetsrelationer
* har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och trivs med att lösa komplexa tekniska problem
* har ett starkt kvalitets- och säkerhetsmedvetande
* är nyfiken på ny teknik och motiveras av att omsätta den i praktisk nytta


**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av**
* generativ AI, stora språkmodeller (LLM) eller RAG-lösningar
* sökplattformar, informationssökning eller kunskapshantering
* vektordatabaser, embeddings eller semantisk sökning
* containerbaserade plattformar och automatiserade driftsmiljöer
* arbete med AI-lösningar i miljöer med höga krav på säkerhet och informationshantering
* Java eller .NET
* CI/CD med GitLab
* relationsdatabaser
* erfarenhet av drift och utveckling av AI-lösningar i lokala eller säkerhetsklassade miljöer
* arbete inom offentlig verksamhet


 Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Om anställningen**
 Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning med en provanställning i 6 månader.
   

  

 Tester förekommer i rekryteringsprocessen. Vi ber dig skicka in din ansökan på svenska. Anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass och därmed sker säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav för denna anställning.
   

  

 Åklagarmyndigheten är en modern arbetsplats som möjliggör distansarbete i hög omfattning, vilket gör att många medarbetare på it-avdelningen till stor del arbetar och träffas virtuellt. Vi ses på kontoret minst en gång i veckan och då i våra fina lokaler centralt vid Karlaplan i Stockholm. Läs mer om hur det är att arbeta på it-avdelningen här.
   

  

 Åklagarmyndigheten är en beredskapsmyndighet. Vid en anställning kan du komma att krigsplaceras på Åklagarmyndigheten. Läs mer under Jobba hos oss.
   

  

 På grund av arkivbestämmelser sparar vi ansökningar i två år. När du ansöker kommer dina personuppgifter att behandlas enligt offentlighetsprincipen samt dataskyddsförordningen. När du skickar in din ansökan till oss, samtycker du till detta.

title: Lead Software Engineer - Medical OS
description:
**Mission**
 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
   

  

 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The Medical OS team builds the software behind every Neko visit, from check-in through the scan to the doctor's conversation with the member. We are building it AI-first: an intelligent clinical platform that prepares personalised briefings, drafts documentation, and handles routine coordination, so clinicians spend their time where they matter most, on clinical judgment and with members. Underneath it all sits a longitudinal health record that gets richer with every scan, the foundation for care that's personal, proactive, and consistent as Neko scales (Member-first, always).
   

  

**What You'll Deliver In The First 6-12 Months**
* Ship AI-native clinical workflows end-to-end across the stack: personalised pre-briefs, drafted debriefs, and intelligent assessment tools, always with the clinician as the decision-maker (Chase 10X, Not 10%).
* Build the clinician-in-the-loop flywheel: clinician expertise teaches the system, the system gives clinicians more time with members, and every scan makes care more personal (Tech-enabled, human-centred).
* Make direct contact with clinicians and members your working pattern: spend time in clinics, understand the work first-hand, and turn what you learn into shipped product (Impact, not activity).


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Full-stack engineering with the depth to lead complex, cross-functional delivery end-to-end. We don’t mind candidates that are stronger on back-end or front-end, if they can demonstrate how effectively at closing the gap in the weaker stack they are, including with AI.
* Solid command of architectural concepts and the frameworks they use: able to explain and defend trade-offs rather than assembling AI output blindly.
* Product-minded and customer-driven: a track record of shipping well-rated products with excellent customer experience, and of deciding what to build by talking to customers. The ideal candidate doesn’t delegate deciding what to build: they are part of it.
* Demonstrable AI-first ways of working, beyond "I use Claude to write code": agentic tooling in the daily workflow and experience building AI or automation into the product itself.
* Strong communication is a must with the ability to mentor the engineers around them.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consumer (B2C) product experience with a slick user experience, or B2B/B2B2C experience on a modern, well-rated product.
* Med-tech, clinical, or healthcare experience is a bonus. Experience in regulated industries (e.g. fintech) is equivalent: we value candidates already used to thinking about regulatory constraints.
* Exposure to hardware/firmware integrations or device ecosystems.

title: Junior Software Platform Engineer – AI & Automation | SEB Life & Pension, Solna
description:
Are you a recent graduate or early in your career and excited about software engineering, automation, AI and modern development practices?
   

  

 At SEB Life & Pension, we are modernising how software is built, tested and deployed. Around 25 development teams rely on the platforms, tooling and engineering capabilities we provide.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Junior Software Platform Engineer who wants to help us improve and shape how software engineering is done at scale.
   

  

 You do not need previous experience as a Platform Engineer. We are looking for technical curiosity, problem-solving ability and a strong desire to learn, experiment and improve the way software is developed.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will join a team responsible for building and improving engineering capabilities used across our development organisation.
   

  

 Working closely with development teams and other engineers, you will help create tooling, automation and platform capabilities that make software delivery faster, safer and easier.
   

  

 Your work will span areas such as:
   

  

* CI/CD and deployment automation
* Engineering tooling and platform services
* Containers and Kubernetes-based environments
* Infrastructure as Code
* Automated testing, quality and security controls
* Standardisation and self-service for development teams
* AI-assisted and agentic software engineering


 A particular focus for us is agentic engineering. We are exploring how AI coding agents, structured specifications, automated testing and engineering guardrails can work together as part of the software development lifecycle.
   

  

 This is an area we are actively developing, giving you the opportunity to experiment, learn and help shape how these technologies are used across our organisation.
   

  

 Who we are looking for
   

  

 You may be a recent graduate or have up to a few years of professional experience. We believe you have a technical university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering Physics or a similar field.
   

  

 More important than the length of your experience is your curiosity, technical foundation and motivation to learn.
   

  

 We think you will enjoy this role if you:
   

  

* Like programming and solving technical problems
* Are curious about how modern software delivery works
* Enjoy automation and finding ways to reduce repetitive manual work
* Like experimenting with new technologies and approaches
* Want to understand how engineering platforms work at scale
* Enjoy collaborating with developers and other engineers
* Want to contribute to how engineering practices evolve and improve


 Your experience may come from university projects, a thesis, internships, open-source contributions, personal technical projects or previous employment. Familiarity with technologies such as C#, Python, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux or Terraform is an advantage, but we do not expect you to know them all. What matters most is a solid technical foundation and a strong willingness to learn.
   

  

 Why join us?
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to develop broad skills across software engineering, automation, cloud-native technologies and AI-assisted development while working with real systems at scale.
   

  

 The tooling and capabilities you help build can influence how around 25 development teams build and deliver software, meaning an improvement you create can have an impact far beyond your own team.
   

  

 You will also join us at a time when we are increasing our use of automation and Infrastructure as Code while actively exploring how AI and agentic engineering can become part of everyday software development.
   

  

 If you are curious, eager to learn and want to help shape how modern software engineering is done at scale, we would like to hear from you.
   

  

**Ready for to join?**
 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

 Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today, but no later than
 **1st of November 2026.**
 If you have questions about the position, please contact Laban Bondesson, Hiring Manager, by email at laban.bondesson@seb.se
   

  

**About The SEB & The Recruitment Process**
 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. We also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.
   

  

 SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment.
   

  

 The employment is covered by collective agreements signed between Finansarbetsgivarna and Akademikerföreningen, and between Finansarbetsgivarna and Finansförbundet.
   

  

**Learn more about working at SEB** 
 on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.
   

  

 https://sebgroup.com/career
   

  

 https://bit.ly/SEBcareer

 Kunskap om

 The Data & Analytics Engineering department brings together specialists in data infrastructure, analytics, and data management. Together we build a modern and reliable data foundation that supports decision-making across the business.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Data Platform
description:
*10% of Europe's CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating, and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that.*
*With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we're making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time.*
*Founded in 2022, and with 1000+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, an HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany, and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034.*
**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Platform team.
   

  

 As Aira grows, more teams rely on data to build products, make decisions and run their day-to-day operations. One of our biggest challenges is helping teams move fast without creating unnecessary complexity for everyone else.
   

  

 This role sits right in the middle of that challenge.
   

  

 You'll help build, improve and scale the platform that teams across Aira depend on. Some days you'll be working on pipelines and platform capabilities. Other days you'll be discussing architecture, helping teams solve problems or figuring out how to scale ways of working that made sense when we were smaller.
   

  

 The role combines strategic thinking, stakeholder management and hands-on engineering. If you enjoy building things while also influencing how an organisation works with data, you'll feel at home here.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Build, improve and maintain Aira's data platform
* Develop and operate batch and streaming data pipelines
* Work with domain teams to establish and evolve data serving pipelines
* Help teams own and manage their data assets through our Data Mesh approach
* Enable analytics engineers and domain experts to build data products, self-service analytics and data science solutions
* Make it easier for teams to build, run and maintain data products
* Help teams avoid solving the same problem in ten different ways
* Improve reliability, governance, observability and platform performance
* Contribute to architectural decisions and the long-term direction of the platform
* Explore new technologies and approaches when they solve real problems


**Who You Are**
 You have several years of experience within Data Engineering and have worked with production systems at scale.
   

  

 You've probably seen different ways of solving similar problems, whether that's through product companies, consulting or working across multiple teams and domains. Your background might be in data engineering, platform engineering, backend development or infrastructure.
   

  

 You're comfortable moving between implementation details, architecture discussions and conversations with stakeholders.
   

  

 You understand that building a successful platform isn't only about technology. Different teams have different priorities, constraints and ways of working. A big part of the role is helping us find solutions that work well across the organisation while keeping things practical.
   

  

 You're comfortable explaining technical trade-offs, helping teams understand why decisions matter and building support around a shared direction.
   

  

 Sometimes you'll help teams move faster. Sometimes you'll push back on an approach that creates unnecessary complexity or long-term problems. You're comfortable doing both.
   

  

 You enjoy creating structure where it's needed, but you're pragmatic enough to know when simplicity is the better option.
   

  

 Most importantly, you care about building foundations that will still make sense a few years from now, not just getting something out the door this sprint.
   

  

**Technical Experience**
 We're not looking for a perfect checklist match, but experience with many of the following will help you succeed:
   

  

  

* Modern data platform architectures and Data Mesh
* Infrastructure as Code
* Production-grade data pipelines
* Kafka and streaming architectures
* ELT/ETL development
* Database and pipeline architecture
* Cloud platforms and distributed systems


***Our current stack***
* GCP (BigQuery, IAM)
* AWS (Kafka Connect, Schema Registry)
* Azure (Access Management)
* Python
* SQL
* Dagster
* dbt
* dlt
* Terraform
* GitHub Actions
* Kubernetes


 At Aira, we champion the next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

title: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer - Automotive
description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Join our Special Vehicles division and help shape customised transport solutions for defence and other demanding applications.
   

  

 As a
 **System Engineer** 
 , you’ll translate unique customer needs into Scania’s electronic architecture while contributing to in-house systems and software. Working across the full vehicle lifecycle, you’ll gain deep insight into Scania and TRATON’s ecosystem - from concept to aftersales.
   

  

 This role is perfect for a senior engineer who enjoys hands-on work, system-level thinking and delivering real customer impact in a dynamic environment.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Translate special customer requirements into Scania’s electronic architecture.
* Develop and adapt embedded software (C/C++) for customised vehicle functions.
* Lead and coordinate complex cross-system assignments.
* Develop and maintain solutions for defence and special vehicle applications.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless system integration.
* Troubleshoot and resolve system/software issues in production and field operations.
* Assess the technical feasibility of after-sales rebuilds from a system and software perspective.
* Act as a key interface, turning customer needs into effective technical solutions


**Who You Are**
 You are a technically strong System Engineer who can balance detail with a big-picture perspective. You have experience in C/C++ and a solid understanding of embedded software development. You can interpret complex customer needs and turn them into practical solutions.
   

  

 You take initiative, think proactively, and have an entrepreneurial mindset—owning your work and driving it forward in a dynamic environment.
   

  

**Skills**
**Must have:**
* Experience in automotive embedded systems and software development lifecycle.
* Ability to lead complex technical tasks across multiple domains.
* Experience in automotive cybersecurity (ISO 21434).
* Strong C programming skills in embedded environments (MISRA C is a plus).
* Fluent in Swedish and English, with strong communication skills


**Good to have:**
* Knowledge of functional safety (ISO 26262).
* Knowledge of export control and defence systems.
* Experience with Scania vehicle systems (CRISP).


**Personal skills:**
* Strong system-level thinking with attention to detail.
* Proactive and accountable, with a strong sense of ownership.
* System-oriented, balancing big-picture thinking with technical depth.
* Collaborative communicator across teams and disciplines.
* Curious, structured and motivated to learn and grow continuously.


**This Is Us**
 We’re a diverse, international team at Scania, developing advanced, highly customised vehicle solutions. As we grow, we’re evolving from a coordination-focused group into a hands-on development team, building systems and software end-to-end.
   

  

 Our team is close-knit and collaborative, working in a dynamic environment driven by real customer needs. We value transparency, curiosity, teamwork and support each other in tackling complex, meaningful challenges.
   

  

 You’ll report to a manager who leads with openness, trust and honest feedback. The environment is supportive but encourages ownership - you’ll have the freedom to take initiative, share ideas and challenge the status quo. If you enjoy improving things and thinking entrepreneurially, you’ll thrive here.
   

  

**Scania Offers**
 We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
   

  

 With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
   

  

 Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
   

  

**Application**
 Your application should include a CV and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.
   

  

 Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-30. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process and a background check may be required for this role.
   

  

 If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
   

  

 Mascarenhas Murilo, Head of System and Software, murilo.mascarenhas@scania.com
   

  

**We look forward to your application!**

title: Forskningsingenjör med tekniskt ansvar för AI-baserad ultraljudsdiagnostik
description:
****Vill du bidra till att förbättra människors hälsa?****




 Vill du ta ett AI-baserat beslutsstöd från forskning till kliniskt bruk? Institutionen för klinisk forskning och utbildning, Södersjukhuset (KI SÖS) söker nu en forskningsingenjör som ska ta ett tekniskt ansvar för vår plattform för ultraljudsbedömning av ovarialtumörer, en medicinteknisk programvara i klass IIb enligt EU MDR. 
   

  





 Hos oss blir du en nyckelperson i ett tvärvetenskapligt team av AI-ingenjörer, gynekologer och ultraljudsexperter vid KI SÖS, Södersjukhuset och KTH, och ditt arbete får direkt betydelse för patienter. Rollen innebär ett eget ansvar för plattformens arkitektur och införandet av den i nya vårdmiljöer. 
   

  





 Tjänsten är en tidsbegränsad anställning på 1 år, omfattning kan variera mellan 50-100% beroende på den anställdes tillgänglighet och verksamhetens behov.
   

  





****Din roll****




 Som forskningsingenjör kommer du tillhöra professor Elisabeth Epsteins forskargrupp vid KI SÖS och arbetet kommer dessutom innebära samarbete med professor Kevin Smith vid KTH/SciLifeLab. Tillsammans utvecklar och implementerar vi ett AI-baserat beslutsstöd för ultraljudsbedömning av ovarialtumörer. Programvaran utvecklas som medicinteknisk produkt (Software as a Medical Device, klass IIb enligt EU MDR) och målet är nu att vidareutveckla programvaran för kliniskt bruk i nya vårdmiljöer och för nya tillämpningar, med stöd av ett stort multimodalt dataset från Region Stockholm. 
   

  





 Som teknisk ansvarig har du ansvar för plattformens arkitektur, utveckling, installation och drift, i nära samarbete med våra AI-ingenjörer och det kliniska teamet. Några av dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer bestå av att: 
 


* Äga och vidareutveckla den tjänsteorienterade, händelsedrivna arkitekturen, som omfattar DICOM- och e-postintag, datainsamling, bildbehandling och AI-inferens, rapportering och vidarebefordran
* Installera, konfigurera och stödja plattformen i olika vårdmiljöer i samarbete med sjukhusens IT-avdelningar, PACS-förvaltare samt nätverks- och säkerhetsansvariga
* Utveckla ny funktionalitet och nya kliniska tillämpningar tillsammans med våra AI-ingenjörer och kliniker
* Förvalta inferenspipelines för YOLO- och klassificeringsmodeller, inklusive modellversioner, förbehandling, tröskelvärden och reproducerbar konfiguration
* Bygga och underhålla automatiserade tester (enhets-, integrations-, end-to-end- och regressionstester) och DICOM-simulering, samt ta fram verifieringsunderlag inför releaser
* Hantera konfiguration, hemligheter, certifikat och betrodda noder på ett säkert sätt i samtliga installationer
* Arbeta enligt projektets kvalitetsledningssystem, IEC 62304 och ISO 14971, och bidra till livscykelhantering, riskhantering, spårbarhet, SOUP-hantering och kontrollerade releaser
* Driva och felsöka systemet, från loggar och tjänstefel till beteende i drift



 I rollen ingår även resor till olika vårdenheter inom regionen.
   

  





****Vem är du?****




 Vi söker dig som har en civilingenjörs- eller masterexamen inom datavetenskap, teknisk fysik, medicinsk teknik eller motsvarande, alternativt motsvarande yrkeserfarenhet. Därutöver ser vi att du har följande: 
   

  





**Krav** 



* Flera års erfarenhet av Pythonutveckling, inklusive typannoteringar, paketering, beroendehantering, loggning och felhantering
* Gedigen erfarenhet av Docker och Docker Compose för utveckling, test och driftsättning
* Erfarenhet av tjänsteorienterade eller händelsedrivna system, meddelandeköer, asynkron bearbetning och integration med externa system
* Erfarenhet av automatiserad testning (pytest), arbetsflöden i Git/GitHub och kodgranskning Erfarenhet av Linux, nätverk och felsökning i produktionsmiljö
* Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på engelska, både i tal och skrift



**Meriterande** 



* Praktisk erfarenhet av DICOM (studier, serier, instanser, metadata, lagring, routing och interoperabilitet)
* Erfarenhet av utveckling av medicinteknisk programvara enligt EU MDR, IEC 62304, ISO 14971 eller IEC 81001-5-1
* Erfarenhet av systemintegration i sjukhusmiljö (PACS, HL7/FHIR)
* Erfarenhet av att driva ML-modeller i produktion, till exempel med PyTorch, ONNX eller YOLO
* Erfarenhet av bildinsamling i realtid från videoutgång och kontinuerlig inferens
* Erfarenhet av GCP (databaser, lagring, containerdrift, hantering av hemligheter) samt JavaScript/React
* Erfarenhet av moderna Pythonverktyg och statisk kodanalys, till exempel uv, mypy och Pylint
* Förmåga att kommunicera på svenska, både i tal och skrift



 Som person är du självgående och tar initiativ. Du är kvalitetsmedveten och värdesätter reproducerbart och väldokumenterat arbete. Du är kreativ och analytisk när du löser tekniska problem och flexibel när förutsättningarna skiljer sig mellan vårdmiljöer. Du samarbetar väl med kliniker, sjukhus-IT och ingenjörer. Tidigare erfarenhet från hälso- och sjukvården är meriterande. Vid bedömningen av de sökande lägger vi särskilt stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. title: Data Platform / Power BI Developer
description:
**Job Description**
*At Billerud we believe that when we have tomorrow in mind, we will do our very best today. It is thanks to our employees that we are a world-leading company within the field of renewable paper and packaging materials. Do you want to realize your true value and work for a sustainable tomorrow? Join us!*
**We are now looking for a Data Platform / Power BI Developer**
 You will be part of our Global IT Business Intelligence team with the purpose of enabling data-driven decision making across Billerud. The team consists of experienced BI and analytics professionals working closely with stakeholders across business functions and locations.
   

  

 As a Data Platform / Power BI Developer, you will play a key role in shaping and evolving our modern analytics landscape. You will develop scalable data solutions, create valuable insights for the business, and contribute to our journey within advanced analytics, cloud technologies, and AI-enabled solutions.
   

  

 The position is based at one of our Swedish locations, preferably Solna, but can also be located in Gruvön, Gävle, Frövi, Skärblacka or Karlsborg
   

  

**Your Main Tasks Will Be**
* Design, develop and maintain data platform solutions and reporting capabilities.
* Build and optimize data models, data pipelines and integrations across business systems.
* Develop dashboards, reports and semantic models in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Support and improve existing BI solutions while ensuring performance, quality and governance.
* Contribute to initiatives within AI, sustainability reporting and advanced analytics.
* Explore and implement new technologies that strengthen our analytics capabilities.


 At Billerud, we put Safety First. Together we take great pride in our responsibility to contribute to a safe work environment. Please read more about our Safety First initiative here.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**To succeed in this position, we believe you have:**
* University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Several years of experience within Business Intelligence, Data Platform or Analytics development.
* Strong experience working with SQL and data modelling.
* Strong experience with Power BI
* Experience designing and delivering scalable data solutions in cloud environments.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions.
* Professional proficiency in English.


**Meritorious**
* Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric and Azure.
* Experience with data integration, APIs and ETL/ELT development.
* Experience with Power BI administration and governance.
* Knowledge of AI, machine learning or advanced analytics.
* Experience from manufacturing, process industry or sustainability-related reporting.
* Relevant certifications within Power BI, Azure or Snowflake.


**Personal qualities**
 For us, personality is important. To succeed in this position, we believe you are curious and motivated by understanding both technology and business needs. You enjoy solving complex problems and are able to analyze situations from different perspectives to find sustainable solutions.
   

  

 We believe you are collaborative and skilled at building strong relationships, since you will work closely with colleagues and stakeholders across multiple business functions and geographic locations. You are proactive and take ownership of your work, driving initiatives forward while ensuring high quality in your deliveries. At the same time, you are structured and organized, enabling you to prioritize effectively in a dynamic environment.
   

  

 Our values are central in our business and we believe that you recognize yourself in:
 **We care for each other** 
 and
 **We do what we say** 
 .
   

  

**Contact**
 If you want to know more about the role you are welcome to contact Amy Celesti, IT Business Intelligence Sr Manager, at Amy.Celesti@billerud.com.
   

  

 For more information about the recruitment process, please contact Erika Collin, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, at erika.collin@billerud.com.
   

  

 We kindly decline proposals from external recruitment providers.
   

  

**Application information**
 Welcome with your application no later than October 30th. Selection may take place continuously during this process.
   

  

 Billerud is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.
   

  

**Why us?**
 As part of our Global IT BI team, you will have the opportunity to influence and shape the future analytics landscape of an international company undergoing an exciting data and AI transformation. You will work with modern technologies and collaborate with colleagues across the business to deliver solutions that create real value.
   

  

* An opportunity to contribute to a more sustainable future.
* Development and career opportunities in a global organization.
* Work with modern technologies including Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake and AI-enabled solutions.
* Performance-based bonus, occupational pension and a number of different benefits according to company policy.
* Opportunity for hybrid working according to company standard. 4 days in the office/1 day remote.


 Our recruitment process will contain: Interviews, recruitment test, references, alcohol- & drug tests and background check.
   

  

**Do you want to help create a sustainable future through your work?**
 At Billerud, we are fully committed to reduce our and our customers carbon footprint by offering high-performance paper and packaging materials. We are convinced that the right solutions can be important tools to help fight climate change. That's why we see it as our responsibility to enable the best packaging choices, for a better tomorrow.
   

  

 Our proud history in the forestry and paper industry goes back more than 150 years. Since then, we’ve grown to what we are today: a world leading company in high-performing paper and packaging materials - passionately committed to sustainability, quality, and customer value. Our materials are the basis of packaging and paper products used by millions of people around the world, 24 hours a day, all year round.
   

  

 We serve customers in more than 100 countries through our three business areas Liquid Packaging Board, Paper and Paper Board. Our nine production units are located in Sweden, USA, and Finland and we have around 5,200 employees in 16 countries. Our annual turnover is approximately SEK 40.5 billion and the share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. At Billerud we always put safety first, care for each other, and do what we say.
   

  

 Join us in redefining sustainable packaging and drive meaningful change for a better tomorrow.

title: Senior Research Engineer
description:
**Description & Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 At EA, we believe games are powerful because they bring together multiple ways people engage: play, watch, create, and connect.
   

  

 Creator-made content is already a part of EA's history — from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe creative technologies will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on helping more players participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Research Engineer to create the next generation of game AI in interactive entertainment. Our work centers on the latest technologies, including Reinforcement Learning, Language Models, and Imitation Learning. The team works directly in game engines to develop agent solutions today, while also advancing our long-term goal of developing the next generation of interactive and reasoning agents for players. The team has a track record, having deployed machine learning (ML) agents in FC26 and testing ML agents for the Battlefield franchise. This is an applied role, and you will translate your ideas into functional demonstrations (e.g., demos) to guide innovation in a very practical way.
   

  

 This is a hybrid remote/in-office role: 3 days/week at our EA office in Stockholm, Sweden.
   

  

 You will report to our Director of Research.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with researchers, engineers, artists, and designers to translate prototypes into production-ready engine features, ensuring understanding of existing systems.
* Develop novel ideas by researching and implementing solutions to some of the most complex challenges in video game AI.
* Contribute to applied research in areas such as Language Models, Reinforcement Learning, and reasoning. This includes engineering work around integration, scaling and development.
* Build compelling demos that highlight novel applications of AI agents, NPC behaviors, and game AI bots, with a focus on integration into modern game engine technologies.
* Engineering Leadership: Share findings and best practices, help others in the team succeed, push the boundaries of what is possible in games research.


**Qualifications**
* Advanced Research Background: 7+ years of experience, with a degree in Computer Science, a STEM field, or equivalent practical experience related to game AI.
* Agents related technology expertise: Experience with Language Models (LMs), Reinforcement Learning, and Imitation Learning.
* Practical experience: Experience turning ideas into functional prototypes or demos that showcase concepts in practice.
* Programming Proficiency: Excellent programming abilities in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow), alongside experience in C++ for real-time systems. Experience with AAA game engines (e.g., Unity, Unreal, Godot, Frostbite, or proprietary).


**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

**Job Description**
**Postdoctoral Researcher in Geospatial AI & Earth Observation**
**Location:** 
 KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden
   

  

**Duration:** 
 2 Years (Full-time position with possibility of extension)
   

  

**Host Department:** 
 Department of Real Estate and Construction Management & Digital Futures
   

  

**About The Position**
 Are you a driven early-career researcher passionate about pushing the boundaries of
 **AI, Earth Observation, and Spatial Data Science** 
 ? Join us at
 **KTH Royal Institute of Technology** 
 for a 2-year postdoctoral fellowship at the cutting edge of Geospatial AI.
   

  

 This position offers a unique opportunity to lead methodological breakthroughs in
 **Physics-Informed Deep Learning, Spatial Foundation Models, and Resource-Efficient (Green) AI** 
 . You will work within a high-impact, intersectoral ecosystem.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities & Research Directions**
* Next-Generation Geospatial AI: Research and develop novel spatiotemporal deep learning models to unify dynamic satellite EO archives and high-resolution terrestrial spatial data.
* Physics-Informed & Green AI Paradigms: Embed physical constraints and explore resource-efficient training algorithms (e.g., Forward-Forward learning) to overcome computational bottlenecks and reduce carbon footprints.
* High-Performance Computing: Train and deploy multi-modal foundation models.
* Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Engage with top researchers, data engineers, and urban decision-makers to transform satellite intelligence into real-world societal impact.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Education: A Ph.D. degree (or close to completion) in Geospatial Information Science, Computer Science, Geodesy, Remote Sensing, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
* Technical Skills: Strong background in Deep Learning (PyTorch/TensorFlow), GeoAI/Spatial Data Analytics, and multi-modal data fusion.
* Bonus Qualifications: Experience with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), Green AI algorithms, satellite imagery processing (Copernicus Sentinel data), or high-performance supercomputing environments.
* Soft Skills: Excellent track record of scientific publication, problem-solving mindset, and strong collaborative skills in an international context.


**What We Offer**
* Top-Tier Research Environment: A position at KTH—one of Europe’s leading technical universities—embedded within Digital Futures, Sweden’s flagship research center for digital transformation.
* State-of-the-Art Resources: Full access to national GPU supercomputing clusters (NAISS) and cutting-edge geospatial datasets.
* Career Development: Ample funding for international conferences, workshops, and networking, designed to establish your academic independence and leadership.
* Future Prospects: Fixed 2-year contract with the potential for extension based on performance and ongoing research funding.
* Excellent Living Standards: Competitive Swedish post-doc salary, full social security benefits, paid parental leave, healthcare, and high quality of life in Stockholm.


**How To Apply**
 Interested candidates should submit:
   

  

* Cover letter detailing research interests and motivation.
* Curriculum Vitae (CV) including a full list of publications.
* Brief research statement outlining relevant expertise.
* Contact information for two academic references.


 Contact: Dr. Jingbin Liu, Email: jingbin@kth.se
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
 KTH is committed to gender equality and diversity. We encourage applications from underrepresented groups in technical disciplines.

title: CICD Engineer
description:
At Tele2, we challenge the telecom industry to create more valuable solutions for our customers. Guided by our challenger mindset, we deliver high-quality connectivity and digital services, ranging from mobile and fixed networks to TV, streaming and global IoT.
   

  

 Sustainability is an integral part of how we work. Tele2 has been recognized as a climate leader in Europe by the Financial Times and named Sweden’s most sustainable company, reflecting our long-term commitment to reducing our environmental impact and advancing circular solutions together with our customers.
   

  

 Our values – Be Brave, Take Action, Make it Simple and Act Cost-efficiently – guide our culture, how we collaborate and how we turn ideas into action.
   

  

*As a CICD Engineer, you’ll be at the heart of automation, innovation, and continuous delivery : empowering development teams across Tele2. If you're passionate about driving simplicity, speed, and scalability in tech, this is your chance to make a real impact.*
**DCT**
 Are you ready to be at the forefront of digital innovation? Join our dynamic team at Tele2, where Digital Capabilities & Technology (DCT) is the engine behind our products and services. As the essential enabler of our commercial ambitions, DCT brings automation and simplicity to the telecommunications industry, revolutionizing the way we connect and communicate.
   

  

 Within our organization, you’ll find everything from the backbone infrastructure of technology and IT systems, serving both our external & internal customers, to advanced analytics, AI creation, and frontend development. Our team plays a vital role in ensuring reliable and premium services through delivering exceptional experiences to our end customers, both Consumer and Enterprises, all the while supporting our colleagues within Tele2.
   

  

**About The Job**
 As a CICD Engineer, you will be a part of the delivery/operations team. You will focus on building and maintaining an internal service catalogue of the most demanded capabilities by development teams. One of our key offerings is a centralized continuous delivery platform, allowing teams to quickly deploy either virtualized or containerized workloads to production. As well as maintaining and innovating on the platform, you will be offering guidance and support on best practices around continuous delivery.
   

  

**Who are you?**
 To thrive and succeed in this role we believe that you have...
   

  

* At least three years’ experience in the IT industry, either in software development, operations, or similar.
* Understanding of Agile software development methodologies.
* Knowledge of Continuous Delivery principles and DevOps mindset.
* Experience with infrastructure automation tooling (eg. Ansible, Puppet).
* Automation platform experience (eg. Jenkins).
* Experience in scripting languages (eg. bash, groovy, ruby).
* Experience in Docker and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency in working in a Linux environment.
* Experience in tools like Gitlab, Artifactory, Nexus.
* Strong skills in Swedish and English, both written and verbal.


*Preferred Qualifications:*
* Experience with major build tools (eg. Maven, NPM, Gradle).
* Experience with monitoring and logging frameworks.
* Experience in Vulnerability Management Tools.
* Knowledge of test automation practices and tooling.
* Knowledge around release management.


 In this role, we look for someone with a can-do mindset who thrives in finding solutions when obstacles occur. Communication and dialogue with the development teams will be crucial, so you should also enjoy building connections with others.
   

  

 At times, our work can be intense, so well-being and cohesion in the group is the highest priority. In addition to formal criteria such as experience and competence, we therefore place great emphasis on your personality.

 Pension and health care
   

  

 Hybrid and flexible work life balance
   

  

 Career opportunities
   

  

 Parental benefit
   

  

 Employee benefits and Tele2 discounts
   

  

 Inclusive workplace

title: Senior Software Engineer (AI Infrastructure)
description:
