title: Principal User Researcher
description:
The role Sharkmob is an innovative AAA video game company dedicated to creating engaging multiplayer experiences. Our research lab focuses on understanding what drives players and enhances their enjoyment. We collect insights using traditional research methods, whether through usability testing or playtests, to guide our developers in making data-driven decisions. Our Data, User Research, and Design teams work closely to interpret player behaviours and conduct extended research in collaboration with local universities.
  
  

As a Principal User Researcher, you will be the craft expert who leads research efforts, mentor teammates, & support design. You will also align user research activities across the studio, driving player-centric game development. This is a fixed-term position, with the possibility of extension depending on business needs. Responsibilities Design & execute studies using experimental design and research methodology.
  
  

Actively share knowledge and maintain key stakeholder relationships via workshops, reports, and presentations Develop, promote, and ensure good user research practices. Guide game teams in planning user research strategies for the lifecycle of their games. Support teams via expert reviews, UX writing, and industry knowledge to guide decision making Promote collaboration between Data, UX, Design, and Marketing teams. Provide consultative support and guidance to senior stakeholders.
  
  

Mentor and upskill User Researchers in all areas of the craft. Requirements 8+ years of experience in user research Experience in mentoring or leading teams. Bachelor's degree or higher in experimental/social/cognitive psychology, human-computer interaction, or equivalent industry experience. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
  

Extensive experience with user interviews, surveys, moderating research sessions, and usability tests. Passion for video games is beneficial, and experience in game development or the entertainment industry is desirable. Strong analytical skills with a background or coursework in descriptive and inferential statistics. Bonus points Experience with shooter or live service games.
  
  

Experience in UX design or UX writing Who we are Sharkmob is a Swedish game developer founded in 2017. We create AAA-quality games for PC and console, using the Unreal Engine to power our ambitions of taking multiplayer games to new heights. We are currently developing Exoborne, our first original IP. In 2022, we released Bloodhunt, a battle royale set in the Vampire: The Masquerade universe.
  
  

At Sharkmob, we believe great games are created by diverse teams with different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We are committed to building an inclusive and collaborative workplace where creativity can thrive. Our culture is built around shared ownership, a passion for creating great games, and, just as importantly, having fun along the way. We’d love for you to join us on our journey and become part of our crew.
  
  

To learn more about Sharkmob, our projects, and the perks of being a crew member, visit our homepage.

title: Motion Designer
description:
We're looking for a Motion Designer to join our Marketing Department in central Stockholm. This is an opportunity to create visually engaging and on-brand motion graphics, animations, and video assets that elevate Navigraph’s visual communication.

**About Navigraph**
-------------------


Navigraph is a Swedish SaaS company that provides the international flight simulation community with flight planning tools, navigation data, and aeronautical charts as those used in professional aviation. Our 1.8 million registered users care deeply about realism, procedures, and getting the details right.


We're a team of nearly 60, including marketing professionals, software developers, UX and graphic designers, data analysts, content producers, and support specialists. Navigraph was founded by Stephen O'Connell (CTO) and Magnus Axholt (CEO), both of whom are still active in the company. We've grown considerably but kept the collaborative, creative culture we started with.

### **What makes us different**


Navigraph is privately held, profitable, and built on the principle that people come first. That means prioritizing product quality and employee satisfaction. Our employee NPS is 80, placing us in the top percentile across industries - you can read more about our culture on our career site!


The problem space is unusual: professional aviation complexity, consumer-grade usability expectations, and platforms spanning mobile, web, desktop, and in-simulator environments, including VR. You won't find this combination elsewhere.

**The team**
------------


You'd join the Content & Creative Team in our Marketing Department, reporting to the Head of Marketing.

**The role**
------------


The Motion Designer creates engaging motion graphics, animations, and video assets that bring Navigraph’s products and stories to life. Working across marketing, product communication, and Navigraph Academy, you’ll adapt motion to the needs of different channels and audiences while maintaining a strong and consistent visual identity.

### **Motion Design and Animation**

* Create 2D and 3D motion graphics, product demos, UI animations, and visual effects.
* Translate complex aviation, product, and software concepts into clear and engaging visual stories.
* Create and adapt motion for different channels and formats, including campaigns, organic content, web, product releases, tutorials, and Navigraph Academy lessons.
* Take projects from concept and storyboarding through animation and final delivery.

### **Brand and Creative Development**

* Ensure motion and video assets align with Navigraph’s brand and visual language.
* Work with the Design Council to develop how the Navigraph brand comes to life through motion.
* Develop reusable templates, transitions, and animation systems that improve consistency and help us scale production.

### **Collaboration and Ownership**

* Work closely with Content Producers, Designers, and Marketing to understand communication needs and turn them into effective visual solutions.
* Take ownership of motion projects, proactively identify opportunities, and drive work forward from idea to delivery.
* Use analytics, community feedback, and an understanding of each channel to continuously improve the work.
* Stay current with motion design techniques and tools, and bring new ideas and approaches into the team.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Professional experience in motion design, with a strong portfolio showcasing 2D and 3D motion, animation, and visual storytelling.
* Strong proficiency in After Effects, with experience in Premiere Pro and 3D tools such as Blender or Cinema 4D.
* A strong eye for design, animation, timing, composition, and brand consistency.
* Ability to translate complex products and technical concepts into clear, engaging visual communication.
* An understanding of how motion needs to adapt across different channels and formats, from organic social and web to product showcases, campaigns, tutorials, and Navigraph Academy lessons.
* A proactive mindset, you take ownership, identify opportunities, bring ideas to the table, and drive projects from concept to final delivery.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, working closely with Design, Marketing, and Content while balancing brand consistency with the needs of each channel.
* Experience with UI animation, educational content, aviation, flight simulation, or technology is a plus.

**What we offer**
-----------------


Navigraph is built on an open, caring culture where people genuinely come first. The structure is flat, leadership is hands-on, and flexibility is based on trust. Innovation and creativity aren't just tolerated, they're expected. You'll join a team that genuinely enjoys what they do and takes pride in setting the standard for what flight simulation tools can be.

* **Flexible work options:** On-site and hybrid
* **A great benefits package:** Please check out our career site.
* **Growth opportunities:** We’ll support your professional development and give you the resources you need to excel.
* **Memorable experiences:** The Navigraph team is a tight-knit group with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We enjoy spending time together, and our annual work trips always include team-building activities that leave lasting impressions!

**How to apply**
----------------


Send your application, along with a portfolio and case studies that demonstrate your design thinking and the outcomes of your work. We're actively hiring and reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:

You use AI every day to work smarter and keep challenging how we work, while your own thinking and judgment stay in charge.
  
  

Please note that we are hiring for this role in Sweden. What you will be doing Own the App Pod's roadmap: plan a few quarters ahead, sequence work around dependencies, and keep it achievable Lead and grow the pod: sprint planning, backlog, releases and clear priorities for designers, engineers and testers, with people management of team members as the role grows Shape features with design from problem to scope, and bring in engineering and QA at the right moment for feasibility and testing Build on health data, from what we have today (measuring devices, what users log) to new sources we may add: understand how data flows through our systems and the algorithm, and turn it into clinically grounded features that support women across their whole reproductive health journey Prioritize by user value and hold a high quality bar for what we ship Work closely with customer support, one of your most important partners: use their insights to find user pain points, and make sure they're ready for every release. Work with other partner teams too, such as data science, platform, regulatory and marketing, to deliver and launch features Work with user research and listen to user feedback to understand what users need Drive the pod's key metrics, retention and user satisfaction, and build in-app features that support growth and user acquisition Look at the data yourself: define success metrics, follow how features perform, and work with our product insights analyst on deeper analysis Use AI every day to speed up your work (PRDs, tickets, analysis, operations) and help the pod work smarter with it Challenge how we work and improve our processes, from discovery to release Work within our regulated setting (FDA-cleared, CE-marked medical device), including documentation and risk management What skills and experience we think you have 3+ years as a Product Manager in a tech company Experience leading a cross-functional team of designers, developers and testers, and aligning partner teams around clear priorities Experience owning a product roadmap and leading quarterly planning Strong technical understanding: you can follow architecture and estimates, and explain how data moves through a product Strong product sense and user focus: you prioritize by user value and care about quality and detail Comfortable working with data: you look at metrics yourself and use them to make decisions Daily use of AI in your work, and curiosity about using it in new ways A track record of improving how a team works or launching something new, not just maintaining what exists Based in Sweden, Stockholm preferred Nice-to-have skills and experience Experience in femtech, health or medical devices Experience in a regulated setting (ISO 13485, FDA) Experience with wearable or sensor data Experience leading a large UX restructure of an app A technical background (engineering, data, science) What we offer Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team based in and around Stockholm that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location Professional development - you will work alongside knowledgeable colleagues in the continuous growth and skill enhancement environment Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development How to apply To apply, just upload your CV and answer the questions on the application form. Keep in mind that we can't accept applications through email because of GDPR, and only applications submitted via the career site (and in English) will be considered.

We welcome candidates from all walks of life and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates. description:

-------------

Mechanics Designer, New Business, Access Control Solutions
**Job Description**
-------------------


Mechanics Designer, New Business, Access Control E&M

  

*Do you want to make a change and be a part of creating a smarter and safer world for everyone? Are you looking for a stable employer with a long-term growth? We have delivered several groundbreaking products that have made an impact on perceived safety and look forward to pioneering many more. We offer you the opportunity to develop in your role at a world leading company using cutting edge technology.*

**Who is your future team?**  

We are a team of 13 positive, forward-thinking individuals who highly value teamwork and each other. Our team comprises of both Mechanics and Electronics engineers, working cross-functionally and collaborating with various departments on a daily basis. We are responsible for one out of the three product areas at New Business, specifically Access Control.


Our team is a blend of highly experienced designers and recent graduates, as we believe that great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time. We foster an open environment where each team member takes the time to help colleagues and share knowledge—something you'll notice when you join us!

  

  

At New Business Access Control Solutions, we look ahead, to create innovative products and system solutions to broaden Axis's total offering. Our focus is on smart professional solutions in the area of Access Control Systems, developing products like Door Controllers, Card Readers, and related accessories. These exciting products have won the hearts of our customers and even design competitions like the Red Dot design Award!

As a mechanical designer, you'll play a broad role, participating from the initial product idea to the global launch. Your responsibilities will include detailed mechanical design, feasibility studies, concept development, manufacturability, testing and verification, but also support in volume production and certifications.


Since product development is carried out in cross-functional project teams, you'll collaborate closely with product owners, project managers, electronics engineers, industrial designers, UX specialists, sourcing, software developers, design for manufacturing, design for testing, quality assurance, and technical writers.


You'll encounter various technologies and challenges, such as:  

  



* Die casting
* Injection molding
* Sheet metal
* Electronics packaging
* RF/antennas
* Heat management
* User interaction methods and technologies
* Ease of use and installation
* Vandal, dust & water resistance

As many of our products are new to us or the market, you'll have ample opportunity to utilize your creative side. You have at least 5 years of relevant experience in this field, with a university degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent. You master 3D modeling and mechanical design for both plastics and metal. You are used to developing complete products, from idea to volume production. You are familiar with working in teams where you take a leading role. Having experience in consumer electronics development is a significant asset.

Axis offers a multicultural workplace with an open corporate culture. We allow and encourage our employees to think independently. Your development is something we truly care about. Except from all the opportunities that comes with a big organization, we encourage you to try new areas depending on your interest. E.g our concept “Axchange” where you can try new roles or responsibilities somewhere else in the company.


Axis offers great benefits, e.g. flexible working hours, classic Swedish “fika” Friday afternoon, morning fika every day, corporate bonus, physical training grants, insurances and your very own Axis bicycle.

  

  

**Ready to Act?**  

Does this sound like your future adventure? Don’t hesitate - send in your application today! We go through applications continuously.


If you have any questions reach out to recruiting manager Vasilios Spiropoulos at Vasilios.spiropoulos@axis.com

\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*


UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence.


At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling.


UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package.


Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF.


**For every child, the right to Data**


**How can you make a difference?**

**Purpose****of Assignment**
----------------------------


To provide hands-on, specialized expertise in data and systems integration, application and workflow development, automation and applied AI to the UNICEF Office of Innovation (OOI). The Consultant will play a critical role in advancing OOI’s Insights & Evidence function by designing and deploying data tools, analytics, knowledge systems, and intelligent workflows that help UNICEF better leverage data and knowledge for innovation.


**Scope of Work**
-----------------


We are looking for Innovation Data and Product Consultant to join the Insights and Evidence team at UNICEF's Office of Innovation (OOI). You will help OOI better leverage data and knowledge to support innovation, by developing systems and applications and using innovative analytical methods, including AI and large language models, so that timely insights reach the colleagues and decision-makers who need them across UNICEF and, where relevant, the wider humanitarian and development community.

  



The role covers the full cycle from problem exploration to deployment and adoption, including helping users build the know-how and confidence to use these tools and solutions effectively. You will work under the guidance of the Knowledge Management and Data Analytics Lead, in close collaboration with OOI's Systems & Services and Solutions sections and other UNICEF offices.

  



The work combines strong technical execution with thoughtful product design grounded in systems thinking and Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles. The aim is to bring leading product and data/AI engineering practices from industry into the UNICEF context, while keeping solutions cost-effective, lean and appropriate for the contexts in which UNICEF works. We work in a build-test-learn way, moving quickly from ideas to minimum viable products and iterating based on real-world use. It will suit a versatile builder who enjoys moving between data, technology and product design to develop practical solutions to complex problems.


#### **Core areas and ways of working:**


**User research and product discovery**


Apply systems thinking and HCD methods to deeply understand user pain points and use cases for data, knowledge and AI solutions* .

Gather reliable evidence to test assumptions and articulate design decisions throughout the product lifecycle* .

**Data systems and products**


Design and build data models, databases, pipelines and data entry workflows that connect different sources into a reliable base of information* .

Develop dashboards, applications and other data and knowledge products for OOI, UNICEF and partners, including solutions tailored to specific Country Offices and innovation teams* .

**Automation and AI**


Build and automate workflows for capturing, processing, and using data and knowledge, including through AI* .

Apply LLMs, text analytics, and other AI techniques to analyze large volumes of unstructured text such as reports and documents* .

**User adoption**


Implement tailored approaches to help teams adopt and integrate data and knowledge solutions into their daily work* .

Produce user guides and demos and run hands-on sessions that support effective user adoption* .

All work is **deliverable-based**, supporting defined initiatives and outputs rather than ongoing staff functions. This is a home-based role, ideally with good overlap with Stockholm (CET) working hours.

  


***To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have...***

***Minimum requirements:***


**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Human-Computer Interaction, Digital Technology, Business Analytics, Economics, Service Design, or another relevant field.


**Work Experience:** At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in systems and data integration, application development, business intelligence, data analytics, workflow automation or applied AI.

description:

Our client is a high-growth, market-leading InsurTech intelligence platform that combines geospatial expertise, peril risk data, and property analytics to empower global insurers, MGAs, brokers, and reinsurers to make superior underwriting and risk selection decisions. Their underlying ambition is bold and transformative: to accurately locate and describe every building on Earth. Backed by institutional investor backing and led by domain specialists across insurance and cloud platform infrastructure, they are actively strengthening their global platform, core data assets, and operational processes to scale internationally.


Operating in an agile, dynamic, and evidence-driven culture, our client values curiosity, technical fluency, and radical ownership. They eliminate administrative friction, empowering their people to move fast, collaborate directly with key leadership, and ship product releases that directly optimise risk exposure and underwriting performance for world-class financial institutions.

**About the Role**


To support their next phase of global expansion, our client is recruiting an experienced, hands-on Product Manager to own and elevate core product capabilities across three interconnected surfaces: web applications used by underwriters and risk analysts, developer-centric APIs integrated into enterprise core systems, and the underlying geospatial, property, and peril risk datasets.


Reporting directly to the Product Director, this is an influential individual contributor role with zero administrative bloat or direct management overhead. You will operate as a key product leader, driving cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Data, Design, Sales, and Customer Success. You do not need to arrive as an insurance veteran, but you must possess the analytical curiosity to master the domain and the confidence to independently drive strategic product decisions.


Key Responsibilities

* Define, prioritise, and manage product roadmaps and backlogs across web apps, APIs, and underlying risk/property data products, ensuring continuous alignment with high-value business outcomes.

* Regularly engage directly with insurers, underwriters, brokers, and partners through interviews, demos, and user feedback to translate complex user workflows and pain points into scalable platform features.

* Translate complex business, risk, and integration requirements into clear, concise, and actionable engineering specs, user stories, and API/data definitions.

* Partner with Engineering and Data teams to facilitate refinement, guide delivery, coordinate releases, and provide commercial/customer success teams with the product enablement needed to maximise adoption.

* Establish core product success metrics, analyse product analytics and API usage signals, and conduct post-launch retrospectives to continuously iterate and refine future platform priorities.


Skills & Competencies

* Outstanding ability to conduct discovery interviews, run user demos, translate commercial/technical user needs into concise requirements, and present persuasively to cross-functional stakeholders.

* Hands-on familiarity with APIs, system integrations, data feeds, and basic data concepts to maintain high credibility when collaborating with Engineering and Data teams.

* Proven ability to make trade-offs clear, evaluate value versus effort and risk, and successfully influence cross-functional teams without formal managerial authority.

* Demonstrated track record of defining product success metrics, utilising analytics/usage feedback, and making evidence-based adjustments.


Qualifications & Experience

* Practical, hands-on experience independently managing products through full lifecycles (discovery, spec, delivery, launch, and iteration). Experience limited solely to technical support or administrative coordination will not be considered.

* Prior experience or exposure in insurance/underwriting, geospatial or property data products, or UX/UI design collaboration is advantageous, though strong learning agility and natural curiosity matter most.

* Thrives in a highly autonomous, remote-first environment; comfortable delving into technical details, managing live product triage when needed, and traveling occasionally within the UK for key customer and team sessions.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
*Natural Cycles° is a leading women’s health company that developed the world’s first birth control app, used by millions globally. We are a fast growing startup, and we promote an international working environment filled with smart and ambitious colleagues based in Stockholm, Geneva, New York, and remotely. Our mission is to pioneer women’s health through research and passion, empowering every woman with the knowledge she needs to take charge of her health.*


We're looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager to lead our App Pod in the Product Team: the cross-functional team of designers, engineers and testers who build the in-app experience of the Natural Cycles° app. You'll own the pod's roadmap and day-to-day delivery, turning health data, from devices and user input, into clinically grounded features that help women understand their bodies across their whole reproductive health journey.


You understand how the product works under the hood, care deeply about the user and about quality, and bring the team along with clear priorities. You use AI every day to work smarter and keep challenging how we work, while your own thinking and judgment stay in charge.

**Please note that we are hiring for this role in Sweden.**

**What you will be doing**

* Own the App Pod's roadmap: plan a few quarters ahead, sequence work around dependencies, and keep it achievable
* Lead and grow the pod: sprint planning, backlog, releases and clear priorities for designers, engineers and testers, with people management of team members as the role grows
* Shape features with design from problem to scope, and bring in engineering and QA at the right moment for feasibility and testing
* Build on health data, from what we have today (measuring devices, what users log) to new sources we may add: understand how data flows through our systems and the algorithm, and turn it into clinically grounded features that support women across their whole reproductive health journey
* Prioritize by user value and hold a high quality bar for what we ship
* Work closely with customer support, one of your most important partners: use their insights to find user pain points, and make sure they're ready for every release. Work with other partner teams too, such as data science, platform, regulatory and marketing, to deliver and launch features
* Work with user research and listen to user feedback to understand what users need
* Drive the pod's key metrics, retention and user satisfaction, and build in-app features that support growth and user acquisition
* Look at the data yourself: define success metrics, follow how features perform, and work with our product insights analyst on deeper analysis
* Use AI every day to speed up your work (PRDs, tickets, analysis, operations) and help the pod work smarter with it
* Challenge how we work and improve our processes, from discovery to release
* Work within our regulated setting (FDA-cleared, CE-marked medical device), including documentation and risk management

**What skills and experience we think you have**

* 3+ years as a Product Manager in a tech company
* Experience leading a cross-functional team of designers, developers and testers, and aligning partner teams around clear priorities
* Experience owning a product roadmap and leading quarterly planning
* Strong technical understanding: you can follow architecture and estimates, and explain how data moves through a product
* Strong product sense and user focus: you prioritize by user value and care about quality and detail
* Comfortable working with data: you look at metrics yourself and use them to make decisions
* Daily use of AI in your work, and curiosity about using it in new ways
* A track record of improving how a team works or launching something new, not just maintaining what exists
* Based in Sweden, Stockholm preferred

**Nice-to-have skills and experience**

* Experience in femtech, health or medical devices
* Experience in a regulated setting (ISO 13485, FDA)
* Experience with wearable or sensor data
* Experience leading a large UX restructure of an app
* A technical background (engineering, data, science)

**What we offer**

* Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team based in and around Stockholm that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location
* Professional development - you will work alongside knowledgeable colleagues in the continuous growth and skill enhancement environment
* Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work
* Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value
* Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development

**Location**


We are remote-friendly, but we find great value in being able to connect with our teams in person. **Most of the Product team you will work with is located in Stockholm, and the team occasionally meets in the office for collaboration and face-to-face time.**

**Sounds interesting?**


If you want to be part of a successful team, we encourage you to apply for this position as soon as possible.


We look forward to hearing from you!

**How to apply**


To apply, just upload your CV and answer the questions on the application form. Keep in mind that we can't accept applications through email because of GDPR, and only applications submitted via the career site (and in English) will be considered.


At Natural Cycles we value diversity and inclusion because we know that teams with people from different backgrounds and experiences are stronger. We welcome candidates from all walks of life and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.  

  

**Note: We are not looking for consultants or help from recruitment agencies**

title: Staff Product Designer - Agentic Experiences
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints, from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
   

  

 Spotify's Core Experience (CoreX) team is shaping how listeners interact with Spotify through conversation, voice, and AI-powered experiences. We're building new ways for Premium subscribers to discover content, create playlists, control playback, and explore what they're listening to, using natural language.
   

  

 We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to help shape the future of these experiences. You'll lead the design direction for our conversational agent while staying close to the craft, designing and prototyping experiences that make AI feel useful, intuitive, and trustworthy. Working with product, engineering, machine learning, and design partners, you'll help create experiences that bring listeners closer to the audio and creators they love.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Shape the experience strategy for Spotify's conversational agent, partnering with product, engineering, and data teams to create a shared design direction across multiple teams.
* Lead end-to-end product design for the core chat experience, from early exploration and prototyping through testing, refinement, and delivery.
* Define how conversational interactions work across Spotify, including when the agent responds, asks questions, offers choices, or helps listeners take action.
* Explore how conversation fits alongside familiar browsing and playback experiences across Home, Now Playing, and other key Spotify surfaces.
* Design intuitive voice and text interactions that support different listening contexts, including hands-free experiences, headphones, connected devices, and in-car listening.
* Create reusable interaction patterns and design guidance that help other teams bring conversational and AI-powered capabilities into their products.
* Partner with research, data science, and conversation design teams to evaluate experiences, understand listener behavior, and improve the product through evidence and experimentation.
* Build interactive prototypes to explore ideas, test assumptions, and make complex AI behaviors easier to understand and evaluate.
* Support and mentor designers across the program, share knowledge, and help teams make thoughtful design decisions that balance user needs, technical possibilities, and business goals.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have experience leading product design for complex digital products, shaping design strategy, and bringing multiple teams together around a shared direction.
* You have worked on conversational, voice, or AI-powered experiences and understand how to design interactions that help people feel informed, confident, and in control.
* You bring strong interaction and visual design skills, with the ability to create consistent experiences across mobile, voice, and connected devices.
* You enjoy hands-on design and prototyping, using AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to explore ideas, learn quickly, and communicate how an experience should work.
* You can turn complex or ambiguous challenges into clear design opportunities, using research, experimentation, and thoughtful judgment to guide decisions.
* You communicate ideas clearly, welcome different perspectives, and build collaborative relationships with designers, engineers, product partners, and senior stakeholders.
* You enjoy supporting other designers, sharing what you learn, and contributing to a team culture built on curiosity, creativity, and inclusion.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the Europe region as long as we have a work location.
* This team operates within the BST and CET time zone for collaboration.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Acne Studios Digital Designer
description:
Acne Studios is a progressive luxury house and through collaboration and curiosity, we set high aspirations and strive for excellence. We value everyone's contribution and embrace feedback to develop ourselves and others. We aim to minimise our environmental impact across all our operations and to address societal challenges in the way we conduct our business.
   

  

 As Digital Designer at our Stockholm HQ, you will help shape the digital expression of Acne Studios across e-commerce and customer-facing digital channels. Working at the intersection of design, fashion, and technology, you will create engaging digital experiences that bring our brand, collections, campaigns, and collaborations to life online.
   

  

 CULTURE OF COLLABORATION
   

  

 We firmly believe that when you feel supported, included, and trusted, it enables you to enjoy your work and thrive in it. You will be a part of a team of colleagues with diverse roles and backgrounds, each with their unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As Digital Designer, your main contribution will be to create and evolve digital experiences that strengthen the Acne Studios brand and support our e-commerce ambitions. You will report to the Head of Digital Studio. You will play a vital role in delivering engaging, brand-aligned digital experiences across key customer touchpoints by:
   

  

* Deliver design updates and improvements for acnestudios.com, including site layouts, and for newsletters
* Create digital design solutions for campaigns, launches, collaborations and new functionality
* Translate creative direction into strong and consistent digital experiences
* Collaborate closely with art directors, developers, e-commerce and marketing teams
* Ensure a high level of quality and consistency across digital touch points
* Stay up to date with developments in digital design, fashion and technology


**Who You Are**
 You have high aspirations and focus on details that create substantial impact. You enjoy working as a team and you embrace feedback to develop yourself and others. You are curious and thrive in a dynamic environment. Cooperation, respect, and clear communication are important, along with your ambition to learn and grow. If these qualities speak to you, we would love to have you on our team.
   

  

**Specific Personal Qualities For This Role**
* Passionate about digital design with strong attention to detail
* Hands-on and comfortable managing day-to-day design needs in a fast-paced environment
* Curious and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders
* Able to propose creative solutions while maintaining a strong understanding of the brand's creative direction
* Organised and able to meet tight deadlines while maintaining a high level of quality


**Specific Experience And Knowledge For This Role**
* 3-5 years' experience in digital or web design
* Advanced proficiency in Figma
* Strong understanding of UX and responsive design
* Experience designing for e-commerce
* Portfolio showcasing relevant digital work
* Fluent in English, written and spoken


 What matters most to us is not whether you master all the listed knowledge and skills. We are dedicated to recognising the potential in each individual. We embrace diversity of people as well as ideas and viewpoints and encourage everyone's individual expression of their own identity.

title: Web & Digital Optimization Manager
description:
Stratsys and Hypergene are now one organisation, serving customers across the Nordics with solutions for Financial planning, Performance Management, GRC, Sustainability and Quality. We are now looking for a Web & Digital Optimization Manager to join the Hypergene Group in Stockholm.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity to take on a role with clear ownership and real influence during a time of change. You will take overall ownership of our new shared website and its digital effectiveness – from a technical, visual and commercial perspective – while playing a central role in shaping how our digital presence develops as Stratsys and Hypergene come together.
   

  

 Read more about the Stratsys and Hypergene merger here: https://www.stratsys.com/news-blog/hypergene-stratsys-officially-join-forces
   

  

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU? 💡**
* Join Hypergene Group at an exciting stage and play a key role in developing a shared digital presence for two established SaaS companies.
* Take ownership of an area that is becoming increasingly strategic and commercially important.
* Have the mandate and space to identify opportunities, set direction and make a tangible impact.
* Collaborate with an ambitious and close-knit Marketing team across Demand Generation, Brand, Content, Design and Lifecycle Marketing.
* Work closely with external web and performance marketing agencies, as well as colleagues across the wider business.
* Work from our central Stockholm office and be part of a social, ambitious and collaborative team.


**About The Role 📌**
 As Web & Digital Optimization Manager, you will have a key role in developing how our website and wider digital presence support the customer journey and commercial objectives across Hypergene Group.
   

  

**Website strategy and performance**
 You will define how our website should evolve across markets, languages and stages of the buying journey. This includes owning key performance metrics for traffic, engagement and lead conversion, and using data and user behaviour to identify, prioritise and drive the initiatives that create the greatest impact.
   

  

**Conversion optimisation**
 You will drive structured CRO initiatives to continuously improve how visitors engage with our digital presence. Working closely with Demand Generation and Lifecycle Marketing, you will develop and optimise landing pages, forms, CTAs and user journeys.
   

  

**Findability and digital visibility**
 As the way people search for and evaluate solutions continues to change, you will develop our approach to technical and on-page SEO, AEO/GEO and LLM findability. You will also strengthen our presence across relevant third-party channels, such as G2, Reddit and review platforms, ensuring that Hypergene Group is visible and accurately represented where future customers seek information.
   

  

**Governance and delivery**
 You will create structure around our web operations, including CMS governance, publishing processes, quality standards, GDPR compliance, cookie consent and tracking. Together with internal stakeholders and external web and performance agencies, you will set direction, prioritise initiatives and align Marketing, Brand, Content and Design around a shared web roadmap and future digital platform.
   

  

**YOUR BACKGROUND ✔️**
* 5+ years in web, digital optimisation or growth within B2B SaaS.
* Proven CRO results, with experience running tests and using data to prove impact.
* Strong technical SEO skills and hands-on experience with tools like Ahrefs and GA4.
* A practical understanding of how AI and LLMs are changing search.
* Proven ability to use AI in day-to-day work, with concrete examples of workflows or agents you have built or run.
* Working knowledge of GDPR and cookie consent on websites.
* Experience with a CMS like Webflow and Hubspot, and with managing external agencies.
* Fluent English and preferably good Swedish, with the ability to quality-assure Swedish content


**About You 👀**
 You are structured, proactive and commercially minded, with strong project management skills and the confidence to take ownership. You can see the bigger picture of how digital presence should support a business, while also translating it into clear priorities and practical next steps.
   

  

 You are comfortable setting direction, asking the right questions and balancing different perspectives. At the same time, you enjoy working closely with colleagues and partners to bring people together around a shared direction. Curiosity about digital behaviour and a genuine interest in shaping what comes next are key to succeeding in this role.
   

  

**WHERE YOU FIT 📍**
 You will report to the Head of Demand & Revenue Marketing and join a close-knit, ambitious Marketing team spanning Demand Generation, Brand, Content, Design and Lifecycle Marketing. You will work from our central Stockholm office.

title: Visual Design Director
description:
Above is looking for a Design Director to join our creative team based in our Stockholm studio. This is a permanent full-time role.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Visual Design Director you will be a key player in driving cutting-edge design and innovation projects for some of the world’s most exciting brands. You will help us identify and secure new commercial opportunities, acting as a strategic partner for new and existing clients.
   

  

 With a high level of conceptual thinking, you will have a direct impact in shaping excellent project deliveries through craft and creativity, while also shaping our culture, team capabilities, and ways of working across disciplines.
   

  

 Our work is exciting and diverse in nature, spanning digital experiences such as websites, apps, and HMI. We collaborate across disciplines to create impact across all organizational levels and future horizons — from category-defining hero products to multidimensional digital ecosystems.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for an inspiring, forward-thinking Design Director who demonstrates excellence in craft, creativity, leadership, and emerging technologies:
   

  

* Forward-thinking approach to digital product experiences, with a keen interest in emerging trends and future developments
* Holistic thinker with strong conceptualization skills and critical-thinking abilities, comfortable leading conversations with stakeholders across design, technology, and business
* Demonstrated commercial experience in selling impactful digital experience projects — ideally supported by a strong professional network
* Strong storytelling and client leadership, with the ability to clearly communicate ideas and thought processes to both peers and clients
* Preferably 10+ years of professional experience, including familiarity with fast-paced agency environments and workflows
* Ability to lead, mentor, and grow multidisciplinary design teams, fostering creative excellence, psychological safety, and high performance
* Ability to lead clients through complex challenges and structure design processes that enable diverse teams to succeed
* Aesthetic sensibility in harmony with a thoughtful, user-centered approach to design, business, and technology
* Experience using — or actively driving — AI-enabled design workflows to explore ideas faster, prototype more intelligently, and elevate creative and strategic outcomes
* Ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into meaningful design direction, team practices, and client value
