**A Bit About Above**
 We are a Scandinavian innovation agency dedicated to driving positive change through the integration of design, strategy, and technology. Our creative 360-approach allows us to break down boundaries between the physical and digital, while fusing hardware and software into meaningful experiences.
   

  

 We work with leading global brands, local Scandinavian heroes, and a fantastic collection of startups. We’re a team of warm, welcoming, dedicated professionals with diverse international backgrounds. In everything we do, we strive for world-class results and believe you share that mindset.
   

  

 Join a team that values collaboration, creativity, and tangible impact through thoughtful design.
   

  

**Join our team**
 Please submit your portfolio, CV, and personal letter.
   

  

 We welcome international applications and are generally able to assist with work permits and relocation.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Product Engineering - EU
description:
Hi 👋🏾 I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for a versatile, persistent product engineer who’s not afraid to set up reusable building blocks across the stack and advocate for the time and space to do so. At Ashby, all our engineers ship features end-to-end at a high pace. Example is the best leadership. We’ll give you the room to do your best work, and you'll be our guide! If that speaks to you, read on.
   

  

 What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: 100,000+ weekly active users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.
   

  

 We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.
   

  

 You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double Engineering this year). We’re bubbling with ideas for how to support Talent Acquisition with software, and we recently launched Talent Management products to expand our total addressable market and become a company worth $60B+.
   

  

 We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).
   

  

**About The Role And How We Work**
 Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as ICs – where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.
   

  

 I started my career building software for artists in the Visual Effects industry. It was a formative experience for me as a software engineer because success relied on my ability to be a product manager and designer. I talked to artists to understand their needs. I came up with ideas. I did industry research, designed interfaces, and prototyped ideas. I watched artists use what I built and decided what to tackle in the next iteration. No daily stand-ups, no t-shirt sizing, no planning meetings.
   

  

 I studied computer science to solve problems, not tickets, and this felt exactly like that. I not only felt creative and fulfilled but the agency and ownership we were given as engineers powered an incredible amount of innovation.
   

  

 Innovation came differently (or not at all) at technology startups beyond the seed stage, often through an engineer’s force of will and ability to push back against culture (rather than any encouragement from it). Engineering was narrowed to implementation and delivery, partly due to the influence of other departments and partly due to the influx of "Agile" processes like sprint planning. In those companies, I felt like a JIRA jockey.
   

  

**About**
 At Ashby, we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve. An environment that embraces innovative engineers, and, frankly, often stays out of their way. As a Product Engineer, you’ll take ownership over a large portion of one of our products and own projects end-to-end (wearing hats traditionally worn by product and design). You’ll research competitors, write product specs, make wireframes, and more. To ground it with examples, product engineers at Ashby have:
   

  

* Designed and built automated interview scheduling. This feature automates scheduling by calculating possible times from a pool of interviewers and other constraints, and then presenting these times to the candidate for selection via our responsive web app. This solves the “Calendar Tetris” problem I talk about in "What We're Building."
* Built a generalized declarative filter architecture that allows users to create complex filters for any record with a consistent UI and compile it to SQL in our backend. Many user-facing features use it.
* Specced, designed, and implemented a feature that allows users to complete signing offers entirely within Ashby. This project involved talking to customers to understand their requirements, deciding what technologies to use, building a prototype, and working with other team members to integrate the final implementation into additional features.


 What We’re Building
   

  

 As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us
 **better** 
 at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition (TA) software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back.
   

  

 Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. A recruiter needed to manually collect availability from the candidate, identify qualified interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and make any last-minute adjustments as availability changed. They must do this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. 🥵 TA software didn’t help.
   

  

 As hiring managers, we know TA is a critical function, and as engineers, we know software can do better. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the
 *highest* 
 standard of tooling. Software that’s intelligent and powerful. Software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!
   

  

 As we’ve set the standard for excellence in TA software, HR teams have pulled us into solving their problems in areas like onboarding and performance management.
   

  

 Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply
   

  

 Software Engineers Come In Many Flavors, Not All Of Which Fit Our Model. Here Are Some Things To Help You Decide If This Fits You And What You’re Looking For
   

  

* You’re not afraid to tackle any part of a technology stack. You do what’s necessary to successfully deliver a feature, whether writing frontend or choosing new infrastructure. We’ll provide a supportive environment to do it successfully (e.g., design system, SRE team).
* You’ve tackled projects with a lot of product and technical ambiguity, and you thrive at the intersection of the two. We’re not building a simple CRUD app, and many of the challenges we tackle require you to use your knowledge of our customers to build powerful abstractions and flexibility in the system to solve a class of problems.
* You know how to strike the right balance between speed and quality. Ashby wasn’t built quickly. We took four years to launch publicly because convincing customers to switch required a high-quality product. However, time isn’t infinite, especially for a startup, so we still move with urgency—we’ve built the equivalent of three or more VC-backed startups with a very small team.
* You are ambitious and always looking to improve your skills. For most engineers, this role will give you more freedom and responsibilities than you’ve experienced in the past. To thrive (and level up), you’ll need to be open to feedback (and we give lots of it).
* You’re an excellent collaborator and communicator. Ownership and freedom don’t mean you work in a vacuum. You’ll need to vet your decisions with the appropriate stakeholders, keep them up to date when necessary, and work with other engineers to get your projects across the finish line. Clear and concise communication helps a lot here!
* You seek to create leverage in your work. The nature of software is that you can often automate or abstract what would be tedious, time-consuming work. Your impatience usually leads to new abstractions, tools to allow Support to debug before Engineering, new lint rules to prevent common bugs, etc.


**Put Another Way, You Shouldn’t Apply If**
* To you, a tech lead, staff, or principal engineer is someone who spends most of their time project managing or doing architecture reviews. Our most tenured engineers spend most of their time building, and we often trust them with our most challenging problems. While they lead product and technical areas and help other engineers plan their most challenging work, it’s not a requirement, nor do engineers need their sign-off.
* You need company-driven process and structure to get your projects across the finish line. Sprint planning and well-defined project management processes are things you need or look to others to lead. You’d rather focus on the technical details and challenges.
* You only want to do exciting work. We’re building a team of kind, collaborative folks. Customer issues and investigations are distributed across the team, including our high-level ICs.
* You can get lost in the details. Once you start implementation, it can be hard to take a step back and think about the project as a whole. You like everything to be planned upfront.
* You haven’t led or taken ownership of projects before. You’re used to working with tech leads and taking on tasks distributed by them.
* You want to mentor earlier-career engineers. We rely on engineers owning their projects, so we need engineers with that experience. This requires the team to be reasonably tenured. More than 90% of the team would be considered Senior or above in the industry today, so mentorship opportunities are very limited.


 Engineering Culture
   

  

 Our Engineering Culture Is Motivated By Benji’s (my Co-founder And CEO) And My Belief That a Small, Talented Team, Given The Right Environment, Can Build High-quality Software Fast (and Work Regular Hours!). We Do It Through
   

  

* Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design
* Natural collaboration and deliberate communication
* Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage
* Putting effort into building a diverse team


**Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership**
 The best engineers we’ve worked with delivered reliably magical outcomes. They took customer problems and relentlessly drove them to solutions that were not only successful but often brilliant and creative. While they did this with minimal oversight, stakeholders were never in the dark as to what was going on, and no setback was a surprise.
   

  

 Traditional product-development processes aren’t meant for the best engineers. Their purpose is to create consistent outcomes regardless of the engineer’s skill. But, consistency comes at the expense of an engineer’s time and freedom—both ingredients necessary to generate those magical outcomes. As a result, process stifles the best engineers and doesn’t give others the opportunity to practice the behaviors that made the best engineers the “best.”
   

  

 At Ashby, we want to build an environment that encourages every engineer to be their best. So, at Ashby, every Engineer runs their project. Product Managers (and Designers) build strategy, do customer research, and hand off problem briefs to Engineers. Engineers take on the rest: they research the problem, write product specs, build wireframes, and implement their solution end-to-end. We rely on engineers, not process, to push information outward to the relevant folks (e.g., Product Managers) and pull folks in to help (e.g., Designers, Infra). It’s a new level of ownership for many engineers, but we’d rather an engineer fail a bit and coach up their skills than use process as a crutch. Not everyone succeeds in our culture, but those who do
 *thrive* 
 .
   

  

**Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate**
 Our engineering team consists of lifelong learners who are talented but also humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally. We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers are in <2h meetings per week (I wrote about it here).
   

  

 To Drive It Home, Here's a Recent Calendar Of An Engineer Who Has Been With Us For Over 4 Years. ~34 Hours Of Focus Time, 2.5h Of Interviews, And 3.5 Hours Of Meetings
   

  

 We also meet in person at least twice a year, once as a department and once as a company. You also have a small budget to meet up with folks in your city/region.
   

  

**Increase Leverage, not Team Size**
 We Built Ashby With The Quality, Breadth, And Depth That Many Customers Would Expect From Much Larger Teams Over Larger Time Scales. We’ve Done This Through Investment In
   

  

* Great developer tooling. Our CI/CD takes ~10m, and we deploy at least 15x a day. A debugger that works out of the box. Everyone on the team has contributed to our developer experience 💪🏾.
* Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) that we constantly improve. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video below).
* AI-powered tooling. We think of AI as a way to automate the mundane parts of building and maintaining high-quality software. We use a combination of third-party and internally built tools that, for instance, auto-triage customer issues, suggest fixes, prototype ideas, generate production-ready code, and conduct code reviews. Engineers have an unlimited token budget (but are not measured on it). We write in detail about our philosophy, current use of AI, and future plans for AI in Engineering here.


**And a Demo Of One Of These Building Blocks**
 Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby:
   

  

**Put Effort into Diversity**
 Diverse teams drive innovation and better outcomes. Having seen my mother and partner build their careers as minority women in non-diverse fields, I want to make sure Ashby creates opportunities for the next generation of engineers from underrepresented groups.
   

  

 Today, 25% of engineers and 50% of our engineering leaders at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. We are taking conscious steps to improve, like sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, no leetcode interviews, and more.
   

  

**Work-Life Balance: It’s A Marathon, Not a Sprint**
 The intensity of work at Ashby should feel like a marathon, not a sprint (nor speed-walking). We work with urgency and ambition to build excellent software, but we don’t need to prove out a new software category or product-market fit. That requires ingenuity and thoughtfulness, and that doesn’t happen with unrealistic deadlines or sleepless nights.
   

  

 Our remote, low-meeting, high-ownership culture gives you
 *a lot* 
 of flexibility in how you structure your days and weeks. In practice, that means you keep your own hours, but there will be moments of intensity, like launching your feature at our annual user conference. We offer unlimited PTO, and you actually get to use it. Some of our most exceptional engineers take almost 30 days of vacation per year.
   

  

 This way of working allows many of us on the team to be active parents, including Benji and me. I block off 1.5 hours every morning to spend with my daughter and drop her off at school. Mujda (Product Engineer) puts it best in an article about us: “I can say that Ashby is a great place to be a mom… No one bats an eye if I have to take my kid to a doctor’s appointment or have to work weird hours because childcare fell through.”
   

  

**Interview Process**
 At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together via pair programming, writing product and tech specs collaboratively, and talking through decisions. There are no leetcode or whiteboard exercises.
   

  

**Our Interview Process Is Three Rounds**
* Introduction call with Hiring Manager (15 to 30m, live)
* A technical screen where we pair in our actual codebase (1h, live)
* Three non-coding interviews that focus on product thinking, technical design, and infrastructure (3h 15m, live can be split across multiple days)


 Depending on our leadership team’s bandwidth, we may start with an
 *additional* 
 30m screen with a recruiter.
   

  

 Your hiring manager will be your main point of contact and prep you for interviews. Each round will have written guidance so you know what to expect (you’ll need minimal preparation). You’ll meet 4 to 6 people in engineering (with 5-15 minutes in each interview to ask them questions). If we don’t give an offer, we’ll provide feedback!
   

  

**Your First Three Months at Ashby**
 We want an exceptional onboarding experience for every new hire. At Ashby, your dev environment is set up with a single script, you push your first product change on day one, and you spend the rest of your time shipping product changes that give you a tour of our codebase and best practices. The product changes increase in scope and ambiguity from simple copy changes to the delivery of a prominent, impactful feature. Your manager will do a 30, 60, and 90-day review to give feedback and calibrate on how we work together.
   

  

 It’s a team effort to get you successfully onboarded; you’ll have a peer paired with you to answer questions, pair program, and check in often to see if you need help. The rest of the team will run training sessions on our culture, product, engineering process, and technical architecture.
   

  

**Technology Stack**
 I’m sharing our tech stack with the caveat that we don’t require previous experience in it (but a love of typed languages is helpful 😀): TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, GraphQL API, Node.js, Postgres, Redis.
   

  

 When they joined Ashby, many of our engineers switched from other languages like Swift and Kotlin (Ben), platforms like iOS (Tom) and Windows (Adam). We care more about fundamentals (e.g., debugging, abstractions) and how fast you learn. For folks on the team who switched, it's nice seeing changes hot reload versus waiting for XCode to compile 😅.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and equity.
* 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
* Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.
* A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.
* Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
* $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
* $250/month tool budget plus access to Claude, Cursor, and Codex with generous token budgets.
* If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.


 Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.
   

  

*Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.*
*Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.*
 Compensation Range: €108K - €145K

title: Frontendutvecklare (React, .NET backend)
description:
Vill du utveckla användarvänliga digitala tjänster med modern teknik, nära kunddialog och verklig påverkan?
   

  

 Hos oss på Softronic bygger vi långsiktiga system som används av tusentals människor varje dag, ofta i verksamhetskritiska miljöer där teknikval och arkitektur verkligen spelar roll.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en senior fullstackutvecklare med frontendfokus som vill bygga moderna lösningar, påverka tekniska beslut och ta helhetsansvar i leveransen.
   

  

**Varför jobba hos oss?**
 Vi växer och stärker våra team med fler erfarna utvecklare som vill ta en aktiv roll i sina uppdrag.
   

  

* Gör verklig skillnad – du bygger system som används i skarpa, ofta samhällskritiska miljöer
* Arbeta nära kunden – du är delaktig i krav, lösning och tekniska beslut
* Jobba med modern teknik – React och .NET i riktiga produktionsmiljöer
* Påverka på riktigt – du är med och formar teknikval, arkitektur och arbetssätt
* Arbeta i långsiktiga uppdrag – lösningar som lever och utvecklas över tid
* Bra kollegor och kultur – vi delar kunskap, hjälper varandra och har kul på vägen


 Och ja – vi har kollektivavtal, trygga villkor, friskvård och flex för att få vardagen att funka.
   

  

**Vad du kommer att göra hos oss**
 Du arbetar i kundteam där du är en nyckelperson i utvecklingen av moderna digitala tjänster.
   

  

* Bygga frontend i React och TypeScript med fokus på användarupplevelse och struktur
* Utveckla backend i .NET/C# och arbeta med API:er och integrationer
* Vara delaktig i tekniska beslut och design av lösningar
* Säkerställa kvalitet genom test, CI/CD och moderna utvecklingsflöden
* Jobba nära UX, verksamhet och andra utvecklare genom hela leveransen
* Delta i hela utvecklingscykeln, från idé och design till drift och vidareutveckling av lösningar i produktion


**Vad vi vill att du har**
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling
* Mycket god erfarenhet av React och TypeScript
* God kompetens inom .NET / C#
* Erfarenhet av API:er och integrationer
* Erfarenhet av test, CI/CD och moderna utvecklingsflöden
* God svenska i tal och skrift
* Förmåga att ta ansvar, driva arbete och fatta tekniska beslut


**Meriterande**
* Tidigare erfarenhet som konsult
* Erfarenhet av e-tjänster eller samhällskritiska system
* Erfarenhet av Azure
* Erfarenhet av tekniskt ansvar, lead eller mentorroll


**Om Softronic**
 Vi är ett ledande nordiskt IT-bolag som stärker våra kunders IT-förmåga i en allt mer komplex digital värld. Med bred och djup kompetens hjälper vi organisationer att skapa stabila, säkra och moderna lösningar – från applikationsutveckling och integration till infrastruktur, drift och säkerhet.
   

  

 Vi tar ett helhetsansvar för IT och arbetar långsiktigt, både med våra kunder och med varandra. Hos oss är gemenskap, engagemang och utveckling en självklar del av vardagen. När vi trivs och växer tillsammans skapar vi också större värde.
   

  

**Låter det här som något för dig?**
 Hör gärna av dig till emelie.mirhagen@softronic.se om du har frågor om rollen!

title: Design Engineer, Brand
description:
**TL;DR** 
 - We're seeking an exceptional Design Engineer to build the tooling that makes AI-native brand production actually work at scale. You might be a full-stack product engineer, or you might be a design engineer - here you’ll be someone who builds real infrastructure specifically in service of brand and creative output, working alongside brand designers who owns taste and direction.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* Solid engineering fundamentals - you have a track record of building, shipping, and maintaining real full-stack software
* Genuine interest in AI generation systems (image/video models, fine-tuning, prompt pipelines) as a technical problem, not just as a user
* Experience translating scrappy explorations into production-ready systems
* Some design sensibility is a strong plus - you don't need to be a designer, but you should be able to tell when output is off-brand without needing it spelled out
* Comfortable building for a function with no internal precedent - you'll be making calls with no playbook to lean on
* You’ll push the boundaries of what's possible with generative pipelines the way our Design Engineers push the boundaries of the web


**What You'll Do**
 In one sentence: Build and own the systems that let AI-native brand production run at scale, reliably.
   

  

* Build pipelines connecting image/video generation APIs, internal tooling, and the systems brand and marketing already use (Lovable, Design tools, CMS, the marketing site, Slack)
* Build internal apps for the brand team - plausibly on Lovable itself, which is both a good dogfooding story and just the fastest way to do it
* Own reliability and versioning for the AI-generation system so brand output doesn't silently drift in quality or style over time
* Work closely with a Brand Designer who owns taste and direction - you're building the system that lets their judgment scale, not just executing tickets
* Constantly evaluate new models, APIs, and generation tooling as the landscape moves, and rebuild pipelines when something better comes along


**Our tech stack**
 Lovable is built with tools that both humans and AI love:
   

  

* Frontend: React, Tailwind
* Backend: Golang and Rust
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, many LLM and generation providers
* DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)


 And always on the lookout for what's next - especially in image/video generation APIs and pipelines. You’ll build custom tools in chorus with Lovable, while also contributing to Lovable upstream.
   

  

**How We Hire**
* Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.
* Show us some of your work you're really proud of.
* Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.
* In some cases, we may opt to do paid trial work.


**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English - it's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.
* We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested please apply through our careers portal.

title: Web Content Manager (m/f/d) | Legal AI Tech Scale-Up | Hybrid
description:
**Your team**
 At Noxtua, we’re building Europe’s Legal AI, and our marketing team’s mission is to make Noxtua the name legal professionals across Europe know and trust. You’ll join a growing marketing team of eight people and help make our website the place where that trust starts. You’ll collaborate across Brand, Product Marketing, PR, Product, and GTM, working most closely with our Frontend Web Developer, Brand Marketing Lead, Product Marketing Manager, and PR specialists.
   

  

 You’ll report to
 **Rafael Arcoverde** 
 , Brand Marketing Lead at Noxtua, who has spent the last 19 years in marketing, working on projects for clients including Warner Bros., Hornbach, McDonald’s, Sheraton, Red Bull, Unilever, and Bunge. His background is in Social Communication (Advertising), and he holds an MBA with a specialisation in Marketing. He has worked in hyper-growth tech startups and with global teams.
   

  

 Our websites are where lawyers, general counsel, and partners first meet Noxtua, and where many of them decide to talk to us. As Web Content Manager, you’ll own the content and strategy of the Noxtua website and our sub-brand websites. You’ll decide what we say, how we say it, and how every page helps visitors understand, trust, and choose Noxtua.
   

  

**About You**
* Degree in marketing, business, information management, or a related field. years managing website content, ideally in B2B SaaS, and 3 years of work experience.
* CMS skills: Hands-on experience building and maintaining pages in a modern CMS (e.g., WordPress, Webflow, HubSpot CMS), including landing pages and forms.
* SEO: You know on-page and technical SEO basics and work with tools like Google Search Console, Semrush, or Ahrefs.
* Writing: You write and edit clear, compelling B2B copy, and can turn complex product topics into simple language.
* Eye for quality, as you care about structure, consistency, and user experience, and spot broken links, outdated pages, and off-brand content.
* Data-informed, and you use Google Analytics 4 to see what content works and improve it.
* Excellent English and German, both written and spoken. You'll work with documentation, customers, and employees in both languages.


**Your Responsibilities**
* Own the content strategy, structure, and roadmap for the Noxtua website and sub-brand websites
* Write, edit, and maintain web copy that explains complex Legal AI clearly and credibly to a demanding legal audience
* Keep every page aligned with our brand voice and our core pillars of privacy, security, and compliance
* Plan and deliver content for product launches, campaigns, and landing pages together with marketing and product teams
* Brief and collaborate with the Web Developer - Frontend on new pages, features, and improvements
* Coordinate multilingual content and localisation across our markets
* Track performance (traffic, engagement, conversion) and turn insights into continuous improvements
* Manage the CMS and keep content accurate, up to date, and well-governed


**Our offer to you**
 Building
 **Europe's sovereign Legal AI** 
 is ambitious, meaningful work — and we want the people doing it to be properly looked after. Our benefits are built around flexibility, real-time off to recharge, and the setup to do your best work from wherever you are.
   

  

* Contract: Permanent, full-time employment (tillsvidareanställning)
* Working model: Hybrid — a mix of office and remote work, with flexible working hours
* Vacation: 26 vacation days and 1 additional vacation day per year of employment (up to 30 days)
* Pension & insurance: Occupational pension and insurance package
* Health: Private health insurance
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag): SEK 5,000 per year, reimbursable against invoices
* Equipment: Laptop (Lenovo or Mac), plus a SEK 11,000 net home office setup budget


**About Us**
 Noxtua (noxtua.com) is Europe's Legal AI built for legal professionals in law firms, legal departments, public administration, and the judiciary. Its AI covers the full workflow of legal text work: research, analysis of complex legal issues, and document drafting. Noxtua is built to meet the professional, criminal, and data protection requirements specific to the legal profession — including Section 203 of the German Criminal Code and Section 43e of the Federal Code for Lawyers — and holds certifications including BSI C5, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001. In partnership with leading European legal publishers, Noxtua is also building Europe's largest legal database, with more than 130 million searchable documents, and offering the market's first cross-continental European license.
   

  

 Founded in 2017 in Berlin on research by Dr. Leif-Nissen Lundbæk and Professor Dr. Michael Huth at Oxford University and Imperial College London, the company has offices in Paris, Berlin, Stockholm, Zagreb, Munich and Fribourg. Strategic investors include C.H.BECK, and MANZ, who have committed around €100 million as part of a Series C round in 2026.
   

  

**We explicitly encourage women to apply, as they are currently underrepresented. Our goal is to build a diverse and inclusive work environment that values different perspectives. Of course, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals – regardless of gender, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual identity.**

**Job Description:**

**The opportunity**

  

Join our IT Team supporting the Grid Integration HVDC business in Ludvika, part of Hitachi Energy. HVDC specializes in innovative and reliable solutions for power transmission and distribution, supporting efficient and sustainable energy systems worldwide.  

  



As an IT Infrastructure Specialist in Ludvika, you will be working in close collaboration with the Service Delivery Manager for HVDC Ludvika, ensuring business needs are met and overall satisfaction with IT services. Additionally, you will play a crucial role in integrating IT with business operations, enhancing connectivity and cybersecurity for all operational technologies.  



**How you’ll make an impact**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the business in their growth
* Overseeing and acting as a point of contact for the IT environment and responding to emergencies
* Supporting the IT Service Delivery Manager and the IT Service Delivery Specialist who is responsible for the HVDC site in Ludvika
* Participate in planning, developing, implementing, and maintaining the HVDC IT Infrastructure environment
* Conduct internal infrastructure audits in the plants to identify compliance issues (focus on business infrastructure)
* Remediate non-compliance item in IT internal audit/infosec reports
* Drive infrastructure optimization to improve cost and performance (business infrastructure)
Maintain, troubleshoot, support, plan lifecycles and provide solutions for installed IT systems and hardware that are used at HVDC for which there is no central IT support available.  
* 

  

**Your background**

* You have >10 years of work experience, ideally in a similar role
* Experience with manufacturing operations methods, processes, and change management is an advantage
* You have experience handling complex stakeholder scenarios and cross-functional problem solving. You also have a solid understanding of IT procedures, policies, and end-to-end business processes
* You are a team player who can also handle tasks independently and take on responsibility
* Knowledge of Service Now and ITIL 4 certified preferred
You are fluent in English and Swedish

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. * Psychological support program
* Supplementary compensation for parental leave
* Various trainings and education supporting employee development
* Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks  
* 

  

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.  



  

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today.


Recruiting Manager Britt-Marie Gustafsson, britt-marie.m.gustafsson@hitachienergy.com will answer your questions about the position. Union representatives - Sveriges Ingenjörer: Maria Lönnberg +46 72 200 47 96; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt + 46 107 387 043; Unionen: Karin Ulvemark +46 107 38 51 42. All other questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Tobias Nilsson, tobias.n.nilsson@hitachienergy.com.

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

  

**This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.**

  

**Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment**

**As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.**  

  

**Background Screening and Security Checks**

**As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.**

**For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.**

**The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.**

title: Servicehandläggare till Internservice, inriktning IT-support
description:
1 plats(er). Tycker du om att hjälpa andra och trivs i en miljö där ingen dag är den andra lik? Då kan det här vara ditt nästa steg. Vi söker en servicehandläggare inom IT-support till Internservice – för dig som vill göra skillnad för alla som arbetar i Skellefteå kommun, varje dag.
  
  

Här får du använda både din digitala kompetens och din känsla för service för att skapa en riktigt bra upplevelse för våra interna kunder. DIN ROLL Som servicehandläggare på Internservice är du en viktig kontaktperson för kommunens medarbetare och hjälper dem med både IT-relaterade frågor och andra interna servicetjänster. Du ger professionellt stöd via telefon, mejl, e-tjänster och vid personliga besök i vår reception. Med kunden i fokus arbetar du för att ge snabb, tydlig och tillgänglig service som förenklar medarbetarnas arbetsvardag.
  
  

Arbetsuppgifterna är varierande och omfattar allt från att ge stöd och vägledning kring datorer, surfplattor, mobila enheter och andra digitala verktyg till att hantera beställningar, statusfrågor och praktiska serviceärenden. Vi hjälps åt inom enheten vilket innebär att du även utför andra uppgifter till exempel lämna ut nycklar och passerkort, administration, internpost, tillhandahålla arbetskläder eller ge information till nyanställda. Du tar även emot och hanterar synpunkter och förbättringsförslag. Du arbetar i olika digitala verksamhetssystem och har ett nära samarbete med dina kollegor och medarbetare inom kommunens förvaltningar.
  
  

Tillsammans löser ni problem, delar kunskap och utvecklar arbetssätten för att ge bästa möjliga service. Arbetstiden är schemalagd måndag till fredag. Arbetet sker på plats i stadshuset Brinken. Tillsammans är vi navet som får kommunens digitala vardag att fungera smidigt.
  
  

DIN KOMPETENS OCH ERFARENHET För att trivas i rollen som servicehandläggare behöver du tycka om att hjälpa andra, vara noggrann och gilla när tempot varierar. Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av administrativt arbete och en god förmåga att hantera flera uppgifter parallellt. Din digitala kompetens gör att du snabbt sätter dig in i nya system och använder dem effektivt och säkert. Du är serviceinriktad, kommunikativ och ser det som en självklarhet att hitta lösningar som gör vardagen enklare för andra.
  
  

Samtidigt är du strukturerad, trygg och samarbetsorienterad – en person som både bidrar till god stämning i teamet och håller ordning när det behövs. Du uttrycker dig väl på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift, och om du dessutom kan något av de nationella minoritetsspråken – finska, jiddisch, meänkieli, romani chib eller samiska – är det meriterande. DIN NYA ARBETSPLATS Du blir en del av Internservice inom förvaltningen Support och lokaler. Här arbetar vi tillsammans för att ge kommunens medarbetare bästa möjliga stöd.
  
  

På Internservice möter vi människor från hela organisationen och varje dag bjuder på nya utmaningar – och nya sätt att hjälpa till. Du kommer till ett engagerat team där vi lär av varandra, utvecklar våra arbetssätt och har roligt på vägen. BRA ATT VETA Vi rekryterar kompetensbaserat och fokuserar på din erfarenhet, kunskap och potential. I stället för personligt brev besvarar du några urvalsfrågor och bifogar ett uppdaterat CV.
  
  

I rekryteringen används arbetspsykologiska tester och går du därefter vidare vill vi träffa dig på plats i Skellefteå för praktiskt test som sker v 46. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att bo och leva i vår kommun? Läs mer om Skellefteå (https://skelleftea.se/) som plats att bo och leva på. Här kan du också läsa om våra förmåner (https://skelleftea.se/formaner) och se lönestatistik (https://skelleftea.se/lonestatistik) för olika yrkesroller i kommunen.
  
  

**Anställningsform:** Tillsvidareanställning.

As an IT Infrastructure Specialist in Ludvika, you will be working in close collaboration with the Service Delivery Manager for HVDC Ludvika, ensuring business needs are met and overall satisfaction with IT services. title: Global Graduate Program IT
description:
**Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities.**


GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 32 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.6bn in 2025. There are no limits to where you can take your career.


**Why GKN Aerospace?**
----------------------


Our Graduate Program is well established, celebrating more than 40 years of success in developing future talent. It is highly personalised and enables you to set your own goals, explore your interests, and shape your future career. Throughout your graduate journey, you will have the opportunity to develop both professionally and personally while building a strong international network within a global organisation.

  

We aim to match your talents and aspirations with our strategic and operational needs, creating a rewarding experience for you and a strong future for our business. Through exciting assignments, international exposure, and close collaboration with colleagues across the organisation, you will gain a broad understanding of both engineering and business within one of the world's most advanced industries.


**Your Graduate Journey**
-------------------------


During the 22-month program, you will complete placements across different areas of our business, giving you the opportunity to develop a broad understanding of both our operations and technology. You will work on real projects and initiatives where technology is used to create business value, improve processes, and support organisational development.

  

Throughout the program, you will take part in a variety of graduate activities, including sessions with senior leaders and specialists, international development weeks, study visits, training courses, networking opportunities, and mentoring. These experiences will support both your professional and personal development while helping you build a strong network across the organisation.


**International Placement**
---------------------------


A key part of the program is a six-month international placement, providing the opportunity to gain experience in a global environment, build international networks, and broaden your understanding of GKN Aerospace's operations around the world.

  

The first 16 months of the program are based in Trollhättan, Sweden, followed by six months at one of our international locations.


**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Digital Technologies, Business and Management, or another manufacturing-related discipline
* Maximum 2 years professional experience after graduation
* Fluent in English and Swedish, both written and spoken
* Valid work permit for Sweden
  

**Preferred Experience**


Previous leadership experience is considered an advantage, as is knowledge or an interest in digital transformation, business improvement, and the use of technology to create business value. Experience in data analytics, programming, software development, enterprise systems, or industrial IT solutions is also desirable. An interest in aerospace, defence, and space industries is considered beneficial.


**Personal Qualities**
----------------------


Are you motivated to kick-start your career and develop valuable professional skills? We are looking for individuals with the following qualities:

  

* **Analytical:** You enjoy understanding complex challenges, analysing information, and solving problems.
* **Structured:** You work in a methodical and organised way and can effectively drive tasks and projects forward.
* **Communicative and Collaborative:** You build strong relationships and enjoy working with people from different parts of the organisation.
* **Curious and Eager to Learn:** You have a genuine interest in technology and digital transformation and are motivated to continuously develop your skills and knowledge.
* **Solution-Oriented**: You identify opportunities, take initiative, and contribute ideas that create value.
  

If you're ready to take the first step in your career, we encourage you to apply!


**Application**
---------------


**Employment:** We offer our graduates full-time employment from day one of the program


**Location:** Trollhättan, Sweden


**Travel**: You must be willing to travel as part of the program, including a six-month international placement.

  

Selection will take place in March and the program starts in August 2027.  

  

  



For more information about the program, please visit our trainee blog at www.aerotrainees.se.

  

Last application date: **2027-02-18**


We’ll offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities. This is your chance to be part of an organisation that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry; and is committed to pushing the boundaries even further. And with some of the best training on offer in the industry, who knows how far you can go?


**A Great Place to work needs a Great Way of Working**


Everyone is welcome to apply to GKN. We believe that we can only achieve our ambitions through a coming together of diverse minds who enjoy collaborating in an inspirational environment. Through our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging and by living our five powerful principles we’ve created a culture where everyone feels welcome to contribute. It’s a culture that won us ‘The Best Workplace Culture Award’. By embracing and celebrating what makes us unique we encourage everyone to bring their full self to work.


We’re also committed to providing an accessible recruitment process, so if you require reasonable adjustments at any stage during our recruitment process please get in touch and let us know.


We are the place where human dreams, plus human endeavour, shape the future of aerospace innovation and technology.

title: IT-förvaltare (vikariat)
description:
Vill du bidra till allas rätt att läsa på sina villkor? Nu har du chansen att bidra till vårt viktiga demokratiska uppdrag! Vi söker en vikarierande IT-förvaltare.


Myndigheten för tillgängliga mediers (MTM) vision är ett samhälle där all läsning är tillgänglig. Vi är ett nationellt kunskapscentrum för tillgängliga medier som arbetar för att alla ska ha tillgång till nyheter, litteratur och samhällsinformation.


**Om jobbet**
-------------

Som IT-förvaltare arbetar du med att säkerställa att våra IT-tjänster möter våra verksamheters behov. Arbetet omfattar både nyutveckling och förvaltning av MTM:s digitala lösningar.


Du kommer att arbeta med allt från att köpa in ny digital mötesutrustning till att riskanalysera ny funktionalitet inom Microsoft 365. Rollen är både operativ och strategisk vilket innebär att du både kommer att arbeta operativt med resurser i driftsmiljön samtidigt som du förväntas att kunna arbeta mer strategiskt för att kunna möta de olika behoven. När nya behov uppstår kommer du att, förutom att bidra med din kompetens, även att ha en samordnande roll som innebär att göra behovsanalyser, kvalitetssäkra leveranser, effektivisera processer och vara stöd i upphandlingar med mera.


Du kommer att tillhöra enheten IT och system som i dag består av 22 medarbetare.


**Om dig**
----------

Du förvaltar och utvecklar våra IT-tjänster utifrån verksamhetens behov. Genom att förbättra lösningar och arbetssätt skapar du nytta för våra medarbetare och tar tillvara möjligheterna med moderna verktyg, inklusive AI.


Vi söker dig som har:


* eftergymnasial utbildning med relevant inriktning för tjänsten
* aktuell erfarenhet av administration av Microsoft 365
* aktuell erfarenhet av system- och applikationsförvaltning
* mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har:


* kunskap om LoU
* erfarenhet av projektledning
* erfarenhet av arbete kring IT-säkerhet
* relevanta Microsoft-certifieringar

För att lyckas i rollen krävs det att du har en god kommunikativ förmåga och att du arbetar strukturerat och systematiskt. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och arbetar för att hitta lösningar som gynnar alla parter på bästa sätt. Du planerar och organiserar du ditt arbete på ett effektivt sätt och har förmågan att göra relevanta prioriteringar.


**Om arbetsgivaren**
--------------------


MTM vill kunna erbjuda en attraktiv arbetsplats som är fri från diskriminering och ger lika möjligheter för alla. Vi strävar efter en god arbetsmiljö och tycker att det är viktigt att varje medarbetare har möjlighet att kombinera arbete och fritid. Vi erbjuder till exempel förmånliga semesteravtal, friskvård på arbetstid och friskvårdsbidrag. Vi erbjuder också möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån och stor frihet att påverka din egen arbetstid.


På MTM arbetar vi efter den statliga värdegrunden. Det innebär att du som arbetstagare vid MTM och i staten arbetar på medborgarnas uppdrag, ett viktigt och ansvarsfullt åtagande. Som anställd på MTM känner du till och följer de lagar och regler som gäller i verksamheten, agerar sakligt och opartiskt, respekterar öppenhet och yttrandefrihet, behandlar alla lika och med respekt samt förenar service med effektivitet. Som medarbetare på MTM förväntas att du är öppen för nya idéer och välkomnar samverkan med andra.


**Om anställningen**
--------------------


Anställningen är ett vikariat på heltid med start enligt överenskommelse och löper till och med den 31/12–2027.
  

Lönesättningen på MTM sker i enlighet med de centrala löneavtalen RALS/RALS-T och vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Vårt kontor finns i Malmö och det finns möjlighet till visst distansarbete.


**Kontaktpersoner**
-------------------


Rekryterande chef, Karl Adam Tiderman, karladam.tiderman@mtm.se


Fackliga representanter;


SACO, Martin Strandberg, martin.strandberg@mtm.se
  

ST, Meri Stakovska, st@mtm.se


**Ansökan**
-----------


Du är välkommen att registrera din ansökan senast den 25 oktober 2026. Ange diarienummer MTM-P 2026/89 i din ansökan.


Besök gärna www.mtm.se för mer information om myndighetens verksamhet.

title: IT Operations & Cloud Lead
description:
**About KEYTO Group**
---------------------


KEYTO Group is building the leading technology-enabled platform for home services. Through our brands, we combine operational excellence with technology that simplifies everyday life for our customers.


As we continue to grow, Microsoft 365 and Azure play a critical role in supporting our employees, operations, security, and digital services. We're now looking for an experienced IT Operations & Cloud Lead to help evolve and secure our cloud platform while strengthening technical capabilities across the organisation.

**About the role**
------------------


As IT Operations & Cloud Lead, you'll play a key role within Group IT, taking ownership of the continuous improvement, security, governance, and operation of our Microsoft cloud environment.


This is a senior technical role combining hands-on implementation, technical leadership, troubleshooting, and platform development. You'll work closely with architects, developers, security stakeholders, and operational teams to ensure our environment remains secure, modern, scalable, and aligned with best practices.


You'll have significant influence over how we evolve our Microsoft ecosystem while helping drive automation, operational excellence, and future-ready cloud capabilities.


As AI and automation continue to transform the technology landscape, you'll also help ensure our platform is ready to support modern AI-driven services and ways of working.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Microsoft Cloud & Modern Workplace**

* Lead the continuous improvement of our Microsoft 365 and Azure environment
* Evaluate new Microsoft capabilities, recommendations, and security features
* Drive platform development across Microsoft 365, Azure, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and Intune
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and operationally sustainable

### **Identity & Security**

* Own and improve Microsoft Entra ID and Identity & Access Management
* Develop Conditional Access policies, authentication methods, privileged access, and role management
* Strengthen our security posture using Microsoft Defender, Secure Score, and modern security capabilities
* Support access governance, lifecycle management, and compliance initiatives

### **Automation & Operations**

* Drive automation and standardisation across the platform
* Develop solutions using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Terraform, Bicep, and related technologies
* Improve monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting, and operational visibility
* Support efficient and secure platform operations through automation and infrastructure-as-code practices

### **Technical Leadership**

* Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex incidents and problems
* Collaborate closely with architects, developers, and operational teams
* Ensure solutions are documented, supportable, and aligned with technical standards
* Share knowledge and help develop technical capabilities across the organisation

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

### **Required**

* Strong experience managing Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure environments
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Identity & Access Management
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, endpoint management, and device security
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Defender, cloud security, and security governance
* Experience with Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, and Data Loss Prevention
* Experience with Conditional Access, MFA, and privileged access management
* Knowledge of Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint
* Experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, and automation
* Experience with Terraform, Bicep, or similar Infrastructure-as-Code tools
* Practical experience with IT service configuration, DNS, email infrastructure, and Microsoft cloud services
* Strong troubleshooting, monitoring, and incident management skills
* Experience working with security, compliance, and technical governance
* Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken

### **Meriting**

* Experience with hybrid cloud environments
* Experience with Azure infrastructure and cloud networking
* Experience implementing Zero Trust principles
* Microsoft certifications within Azure, Security, Identity, or Microsoft 365
* Experience supporting AI-enabled platforms and modern workplace technologies

**Who you are**
---------------

* A senior technology professional who enjoys combining strategy with hands-on execution
* Analytical, structured, and solution-oriented
* Comfortable taking ownership and driving initiatives independently
* A strong collaborator who works effectively across technical and business teams
* Curious about emerging technologies and modern cloud capabilities
* Passionate about automation, security, and continuous improvement

**Why join us?**
----------------


This is an opportunity to take ownership of a business-critical cloud platform while helping shape the future of technology across KEYTO Group.


You'll work with modern Microsoft technologies, influence technical direction, and play a central role in strengthening security, automation, and operational excellence across the organisation.


If you're excited by cloud platforms, Microsoft technologies, security, automation, and the opportunity to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Servicehandläggare till Internservice, inriktning IT-support
description:
Tycker du om att hjälpa andra och trivs i en miljö där ingen dag är den andra lik? Då kan det här vara ditt nästa steg. Vi söker en servicehandläggare inom IT-support till Internservice – för dig som vill göra skillnad för alla som arbetar i Skellefteå kommun, varje dag. Här får du använda både din digitala kompetens och din känsla för service för att skapa en riktigt bra upplevelse för våra interna kunder.


**DIN ROLL**


Som servicehandläggare på Internservice är du en viktig kontaktperson för kommunens medarbetare och hjälper dem med både IT-relaterade frågor och andra interna servicetjänster. Du ger professionellt stöd via telefon, mejl, e-tjänster och vid personliga besök i vår reception. Med kunden i fokus arbetar du för att ge snabb, tydlig och tillgänglig service som förenklar medarbetarnas arbetsvardag.


Arbetsuppgifterna är varierande och omfattar allt från att ge stöd och vägledning kring datorer, surfplattor, mobila enheter och andra digitala verktyg till att hantera beställningar, statusfrågor och praktiska serviceärenden. Vi hjälps åt inom enheten vilket innebär att du även utför andra uppgifter till exempel lämna ut nycklar och passerkort, administration, internpost, tillhandahålla arbetskläder eller ge information till nyanställda. Du tar även emot och hanterar synpunkter och förbättringsförslag.


Du arbetar i olika digitala verksamhetssystem och har ett nära samarbete med dina kollegor och medarbetare inom kommunens förvaltningar. Tillsammans löser ni problem, delar kunskap och utvecklar arbetssätten för att ge bästa möjliga service. Arbetstiden är schemalagd måndag till fredag. Arbetet sker på plats i stadshuset Brinken.


Tillsammans är vi navet som får kommunens digitala vardag att fungera smidigt.


**DIN KOMPETENS OCH ERFARENHET**


För att trivas i rollen som servicehandläggare behöver du tycka om att hjälpa andra, vara noggrann och gilla när tempot varierar. Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av administrativt arbete och en god förmåga att hantera flera uppgifter parallellt. Din digitala kompetens gör att du snabbt sätter dig in i nya system och använder dem effektivt och säkert.


Du är serviceinriktad, kommunikativ och ser det som en självklarhet att hitta lösningar som gör vardagen enklare för andra. Samtidigt är du strukturerad, trygg och samarbetsorienterad – en person som både bidrar till god stämning i teamet och håller ordning när det behövs. Du uttrycker dig väl på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift, och om du dessutom kan något av de nationella minoritetsspråken – finska, jiddisch, meänkieli, romani chib eller samiska – är det meriterande.


**DIN NYA ARBETSPLATS**


Du blir en del av Internservice inom förvaltningen Support och lokaler. Här arbetar vi tillsammans för att ge kommunens medarbetare bästa möjliga stöd. På Internservice möter vi människor från hela organisationen och varje dag bjuder på nya utmaningar – och nya sätt att hjälpa till. Du kommer till ett engagerat team där vi lär av varandra, utvecklar våra arbetssätt och har roligt på vägen.


**BRA ATT VETA**


Vi rekryterar kompetensbaserat och fokuserar på din erfarenhet, kunskap och potential. I stället för personligt brev besvarar du några urvalsfrågor och bifogar ett uppdaterat CV. I rekryteringen används arbetspsykologiska tester och går du därefter vidare vill vi träffa dig på plats i Skellefteå för praktiskt test som sker v 46.


Vill du veta mer om hur det är att bo och leva i vår kommun? Läs mer om Skellefteå som plats att bo och leva på. Här kan du också läsa om våra förmåner och se lönestatistik för olika yrkesroller i kommunen.

**Job Description:**

**The opportunity**

Do you like how engineering software, digital tools, and business processes come together to drive innovation and value? Hitachi Energy’s Applications tools & LCM support department is looking for the next Teamcenter Application Specialist. You will be included in a diverse team and collaborating with multiple roles within the organization.


In this role, you'll be at the center of improving and evolving critical engineering applications that enable business suc-cess. Working closely with users, project teams, stakeholders, and leadership, you'll influence technology decisions, drive application improvements, and help shape future ways of working.  



  

This is more than an application support role. You'll have the opportunity to lead initiatives, support software and hard-ware deployment, collaborate across departments, and turn ideas into practical solutions that create real value. If you enjoy solving challenges, continuously learning, and making a visible impact through technology, this is an exciting opportunity to grow while delivering value to all parts of the organization.

Following and improving our way of working.

title: Software Engineer | Simulation & Testing | Range Operations
description:
**Job Description** **Hej Software Engineer!**


Do you want to furnish the future to make room for everyone?  

  

With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.


We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Digital Product Area ‘Simulation & Testing’, a part of Range Operations at Inter IKEA.


The Simulation & Testing Area develops and maintains digital solutions that support testing, validation, and simulation throughout IKEA's product development process. Together with our business partners, we enable smarter ways of working and help ensure that IKEA products meet high standards of quality, safety, performance, and sustainability.


We are growing our team in Malmö, Sweden, and we're looking for someone who enjoys collaborating with people from different backgrounds, experiences, and locations.

 **Your new job**


We're looking for a Software Engineer who wants to solve complex, real-world problems and create solutions that make everyday work simpler and better.


You will be part of a collaborative engineering team that develops and evolves digital products supporting IKEA's product development landscape. The impact of your work will help enable better products for the many people.


We believe that curiosity and willingness to learn are key ingredients for success. You'll be part of a team that values continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and learning from each other while contributing to meaningful solutions that support IKEA's product development journey.


On a typical day, you will:

* Build and evolve digital solutions that support product development across IKEA.
* Develop and maintain software applications, services, integrations, and cloud-based solutions.
* Contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery and design to delivery and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with engineers, product teams, and stakeholders across different locations and time zones.
* Help ensure high-quality software through code reviews, testing, automation, and modern engineering practices.
* Share knowledge, support colleagues, and contribute to a culture of learning, openness, and collaboration.
* Bring curiosity and new ideas that improve both our products and ways of working.

 **Qualifications** **What we’d like you to bring to the table**  

The role as a Software Engineer requires you to:

* Have experience developing modern software solutions and enjoy solving technical challenges.
* Have experience working with software engineering practices such as version control, testing, automation, and continuous delivery.
* Have an interest in cloud technologies and modern application development.
* Enjoy working in agile and collaborative environments.
* Have strong communication skills and the ability to communicate in a clear, structured, and honest way.
* Have good interpersonal skills, including active listening, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and coaching.
* Be curious, eager to learn, and motivated by continuous improvement.
* Take ownership and contribute positively to team outcomes.
* Enjoy working together with others and helping people around you succeed.
* Have a mindset and way of working that reflects IKEA values and cultural principles.


It’s a plus if you also have experience with:

* Cloud platforms and services.
* API development, integrations, or backend services.
* Infrastructure as Code, automation, or DevOps practices.
* Relational or document-based databases.
* Working in distributed and global teams.

 **Additional Information** **Be yourself, a Software Engineer and more!**  

  

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce, and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.  

  

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down-to-earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.  



**We welcome your application**  

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 23rd of October at the latest.  

  

This is a permanent role based in Malmö; hence, you need to be based in Sweden and be able to work from the office. We believe that your presence with the team and working most of the time in the workplace are important.  

  

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Vera Bendz, Recruiter, at vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com. If you have questions about the role, please contact Linnéa Leü, Hiring Manager, at linnea.leue@inter.ikea.com.

  

At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, or what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers’ dreams and needs.  

  

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

*We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in IKEA of Sweden and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB, provided competence requirements are met for the role.*

title: Project Office Area Manager till Axfood IT, Stockholm
description:
Project Office Area Manager till Axfood IT, Stockholm
Project Office Area Manager till Axfood IT, Stockholm
Karriärvägar: Projekt-/Programledning
Typ av tjänst: Tillsvidare
Arbetsplats: Torsplan kontor
**Ditt nya team
‍**
-------------------

På Axfood IT:s projektkontor är vi ett härligt och engagerat gäng av projekt- och förändringsledare som arbetar för att förverkliga idén om framtidens matbutik. Det är vårt team som ser till att alla stora digitala satsningar, oavsett om det handlar om nya lösningar för matkassarna online, smartare logistik till lagren eller smidigare självskanning i din lokala Willys- eller Hemköpsbutik, landar tryggt och skapar riktig nytta. Du blir en del av enhetens ledningsgrupp där vi stöttar varandra, utvecklar våra arbetssätt och tillsammans bygger en kultur präglad av framåtanda och gemenskap. Vi håller till i ljusa, moderna lokaler på vårt huvudkontor på Torsplan.


**Om rollen
‍**
---------------

I denna roll som Chef Projekt och Förändringsledning blir du delaktig i en spännande förflyttning där vi ställer om med kraft inom data, analys och AI. Du kommer att få en central roll i att utveckla och öka takten i verksamheten genom att koppla bolagets strategiska mål till operativt genomförande. Rollen innebär att leda och coacha ett team av projekt- och förändringsledare samt att ansvara för strategisk resursplanering. Du får chansen att arbeta med stor bredd i en händelserik miljö där du bidrar till att möjliggöra affärsnytta för hela koncernen.


**Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer att inkludera:**
----------------------------------------------

* Leda, coacha och utveckla dina medarbetare inom projektkontoret samt säkerställa kompetensförsörjning på både kort och lång sikt.
* Ansvara för Axfoods projektstyrningsmodell och metodik för förändringsledning samt aktivt utveckla arbetssätt och samverkan som optimerar helheten för Axfood och Axfood IT. Säkerställa att projekt, agila team och affär samverkar effektivt och att förändringar förankras och implementeras så att förväntad affärsnytta realiseras.
* Ingå i enhetens ledningsgrupp och aktivt bidra till att omsätta Axfoods och Axfoods IT strategi i taktisk planering och prioriterade förflyttningar samt tillsammans med dina kollegor driva genomförandet på kort och lång sikt
* Ansvara för avdelningens budget, prognoser och ekonomiska uppföljning samt leverantörsstyrning och avtal.
* Aktivt stötta och coacha projektledare och effektägare, fånga upp utmaningar tidigt och bidra till att lösa hinder och vägval för att projekten ska lyckas med sina leveranser och möjliggöra förväntad affärsnytta
**Din nya chef har ordet
‍**
----------------------------

*"Det här är en viktig roll för vår fortsatta utveckling. Vi söker dig som är riktigt bra på att samverka, bygga relationer och få med dig andra. Du är nyfiken och öppen och vill aktivt bidra till hur vi på Axfood IT driver förändring tillsammans med resten av koncernen. I rollen får du bidra till att omsätta våra strategier i konkret förflyttning, skapa ett effektivt samspel mellan projekt, agila team och affären och säkerställa att våra initiativ skapar den affärsnytta vi vill uppnå. Jag ser mycket fram emot att välkomna en ny kollega till vår ledningsgrupp!”* säger Åsa Östergren, Chef Utvecklingskontoret Axfood IT.


**Stämmer detta in på dig?
‍**
------------------------------

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är en trygg ledare med en gedigen verktygslåda inom projektledning. Du rör dig obehindrat mellan affär och IT och drivs av att se människorna i ditt team växa. Som person är du prestigelös, inlyssnande, kommunikativ och en riktig lagbyggare. Du har en stark förmåga att vara både strategisk och operativ, med en analytisk helhetssyn och förmåga att snabbt se komplexa samband. Vidare trivs du i en föränderlig miljö, kan hantera ett högt tempo och har en glad och positiv grundinställning.


**Vi tror också att du har:**

* Erfarenhet som chef, programledare eller liknande där du framgångsrikt drivit komplexa transformationer.
* Vana vid att navigera i, och förstå dynamiken hos, en stor komplex organisation.
* God erfarenhet av både agil metodik och traditionella vattenfallsprocesser.
* Erfarenhet av inköpsprocesser och leverantörskontakter.
* Du använder och utforskar AI i ditt dagliga arbete och ser AI som ett viktigt verktyg för att effektivisera projektarbete
* Det är meriterande om du har drivit initiativ inom Data & AI, gärna från dataintensiva branscher.
* Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.

*Känner du att du inte bockar i precis varje punkt? Sök ändå! Vi vet att potential, inställning och driv ofta är viktigare än en perfekt bock i alla rutor, och vi går igenom alla ansökningar löpande.*

**Ansökningsprocessen**
-----------------------

**Denna rekrytering hanteras av EQ Executive Search. Du gör din ansökan på deras hemsida:** **EQ Executive Search**

Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan därför tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag den 23/10/2026. Vår rekryteringsprocess innehåller tester, intervjuer, bakgrundskontroll och ID-kontroll. Observera att vi inte under denna rekryteringsprocess kommer be dig logga in med ditt Bank-id eller scanna någon QR-kod, men vi kommer be dig styrka din identitet i processens slutskede.


Om du har frågor om tjänsten, kontakta Rosanna Rimertz hos EQ Executive Search rosanna@eqexecutivesearch.com.


Av GDPR-skäl behandlar vi inga ansökningar eller annan personlig information via mail.

title: Senior IT Arkitekt ﻿
description:
*Vi tror att framsteg och möjligheter skapas bäst tillsammans. Välkommen till en plats där samarbete gör skillnad.*

  

  

### **Din roll**


Som IT-arkitekt hos Saab Business Area Surveillance kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i att forma framtidens IT-lösningar ihop med vår verksamhet. Du kommer att arbeta nära affärsintressenter för att förstå deras behov och översätta dessa till robusta och effektiva IT-arkitekturer.

  

  

Dina huvudsakliga uppgifter kommer att omfatta:

  

  

* Design, utveckling och dokumentation av IT-arkitekturer och lösningar med hjälp av metoder som t ex. TOGAF och modelleringsspråk som Archimate.
* Säkerställa att arkitekturerna är i linje med affärsbehov, operationella krav och övergripande IT-strategi, samtidigt som de uppfyller strikta säkerhets- och regulatoriska krav som är en förutsättning för våra verksamheters produktionslicenser.
* Analysera befintliga IT-miljöer för att identifiera förbättringsområden och säkerställa att de möter nuvarande och framtida affärsbehov.
* Samarbeta med utvecklingsteam, IT-drift och säkerhetsfunktioner för att säkerställa framgångsrik implementering och livscykelhantering av IT-lösningar vilket kräver en praktisk förståelse av implementationerna.
  

  

Rollen innebär både inrikes- och utrikesresor.

  

  

### **Din profil**


Vi söker en analytisk och strukturerad person med en stark förmåga att lyssna och förstå affärsutmaningar. Du har en passion för att översätta dessa utmaningar till välstrukturerade IT-lösningar.

  

  

Du som person är driven och kan ta ansvar för det du förväntas leverera. Du arbetar bra i samverkan med andra grupperingar för att få fram helhetslösningar i en komplex omgivning där många behöver bidra med kunskap. Du har en stark förmåga att kunna beskriva dina lösningar i text och bild och kan presentera för både IT och verksamheter på ett förståeligt sätt.

  

  

Vi kommer att utbilda dig som är rätt person i nödvändiga verktyg och rutiner för vår verksamhet.

  

  

Essentiell kompetens och erfarenhet:


* Gedigen erfarenhet av att arbeta som IT-arkitekt eller i en liknande roll med fokus på IT-infrastruktur, systemdesign och integration
* Erfarenhet från att arbeta i regulatoriskt styrda branscher som kraft, finans eller t.ex. inom försvars-, flyg- eller andra starkt reglerade sektorer och att designa/ta fram lösningar som uppfyller strikta säkerhets- och regulatoriska krav
  

  

Meriterande:


* Kandidatexamen eller masterexamen inom informationsteknik, datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande
* God förståelse för och praktisk erfarenhet av arkitekturramverk som TOGAF och modelleringsspråk som Archimate är meriterande
