title: Senior Android Engineer (Automotive)
description:
**We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!**
*As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.*
 At the Automotive and Data business unit of Arrive we are building Android Automotive Applications for different car manufacturers. As an Android Automotive Engineer, you won’t just be writing code; you’ll be an architect of spreading our application to different cars brands and models. You will design and build native AAOS applications and put them in every car we can reach.
   

  

 Our team is small, product-focused, and highly collaborative. We believe in radical ownership - from the initial goal-setting phase to the final feature delivery, you will have a seat at the table.
   

  

**Your Everyday Life as an Android Automotive Engineer**
* Build for Scale: Collaborate with a cross-functional team to design and deliver modular Kotlin code for our native Android apps.
* Drive Growth: Work on high-impact projects central to our global expansion and market acquisition strategies.
* Own the Lifecycle: Actively participate in defining product goals and breaking them down into actionable technical deliverables.
* Ensure Excellence: Write and maintain robust unit and UI tests to ensure reliability and prevent regressions.
* Collaborate Cross-Platform: Align with backend and iOS teams to ensure consistent integrations and a unified user experience.
* Lead by Initiative: Coordinate directly with other teams to solve challenges—we don’t believe in bottlenecks, we believe in proactive communication.


 What You Bring to the Table
   

  

* Android Expertise: 3+ years of professional Android development experience with Kotlin as your primary language.
* Android Automotive Expertise: minimum 1 year of development experience for AAOS.
* Modern Tech Stack: Hands-on expertise with Jetpack Compose, MVVM Architecture, Hilt and Kotlin Coroutines/Flows.
* System Design: Experience with app modularization and working with REST APIs, API gateways, and the BFF (Backend for Frontend) pattern.
* Growth Mindset: Familiarity with feature flags, A/B testing, and analytics tracking to drive data-informed decisions.
* Quality First: A proven ability to write comprehensive unit and UI tests.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication—you are comfortable proposing ideas, giving demos, and engaging in deep-dive technical discussions.
* Resilience: The flexibility to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.


**The "Nice-to-Haves"**
* Familiarity with Java backend solutions.
* Experience with Figma Dev Mode for seamless design-to-code transitions.
* A proactive approach to using AI tools to boost productivity (we love a tech-forward engineer!).
* Basic knowledge of Javascript or Typescript.
* Experience with multi-market or localized applications.


**Why Join Us?**
 You’ll be part of a team where your ideas are heard, your craft is respected, and your growth is prioritized. If you are curious, proactive, and ready to solve complex Automotive challenges, we want to meet you.
   

  

 This a hyrbid role based in Stockholm.
   

  

**About Arrive**
 Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

title: Enterprisearkitekt med inriktning mot verksamhetsarkitektur
description:
Ett jobb som räknas! Hos oss bidrar du till ett välfungerande samhälle för allmänhet och företag. Nu står vi inför utmaningen att växla upp vårt informationsutbyte med andra parter, utveckla vår analysförmåga och samtidigt möta både kunders och interna behov om effektivisering.
   

  

**Om jobbet**
 Vi söker en verksamhetsarkitekt som vill vara med och forma Kronofogdens fortsatta utveckling. Du har en central roll i vår utveckling och skapar helhet mellan myndighetens uppdrag, strategiska mål, verksamhetens förmågor och behov, arbetssätt, information och IT.
   

  

 Du hjälper organisationen att förstå nuläge, formulera målbild och tydliggöra vägen dit. Med arkitektur som verktyg analyserar du samband, beroenden och konsekvenser och omsätter dem till vägval och beslutsunderlag för ledning och andra beslutsfattare. Du är lika bekväm i diskussioner om strategiska vägval med ledningsgrupper som i nära samarbete med specialister och utvecklingsteam.
   

  

 En viktig del av arbetet är att skapa gemensam förståelse. Du leder och faciliterar workshops, synliggör komplexitet och kommunicerar arkitekturella frågeställningar, alternativ och konsekvenser på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt. Du arbetar i en iterativ utvecklingsmiljö där arkitekturen ger riktning utan att begränsa utvecklingen. Rollen kräver att du kan hålla fast vid långsiktiga mål och principer samtidigt som du är pragmatisk och väger olika alternativ mot verksamhetens behov.
   

  

 Du driver arkitekturarbete inom ett eller flera utvecklingsområden och bidrar till att utveckla myndighetens gemensamma arkitektur. Du arbetar nära verksamhet och IT och samverkar med bland andra verksamhetsutvecklare, verksamhetsrepresentanter, IT-arkitekter, andra verksamhetsarkitekter, utvecklingsledare, jurister och kravanalytiker. Vi har forum för att hantera tvärgående frågor, utveckla vår gemensamma arkitektur och kontinuerligt utveckla våra arbetssätt.
   

  

**Om dig**
 Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsinsatser, är trygg i att fatta beslut och kan anpassa dig när förutsättningar förändras. Du har god framförhållning, bidrar aktivt till förbättringar och trivs med att samarbeta för att nå bästa möjliga resultat. Du motiveras av att arbeta i en verksamhet som gör samhällsnytta och där uppdraget ibland innebär komplexa avvägningar och möten med människor i utsatta situationer.
   

  

 På Kronofogden Vill Vi Ha Ett Aktivt Medarbetarskap Där Alla Tar Ansvar För Sitt Arbete Och Bidrar Till Verksamhetens Utveckling. Läs Mer Om Våra Medarbetarkriterier Här
   

  

 För den här rollen söker vi dig som har stark helhetssyn och har god förmåga att kunna analysera informationsflöden, se samband mellan strategi, verksamhet och IT samt kan växla mellan övergripande frågor och detaljer. Du har en god kommunikationsförmåga i svenska, vilket innebär att du uttrycker dig på ett enkelt, tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt i både tal och skrift.
   

  

 Du har god förmåga att samarbeta med andra och vara hjälpsam, vilket innebär att du är lyhörd för andras synpunkter och tar ansvar för att gemensamma uppgifter genomförs. Du tar ansvar för att självständigt planera och driva ditt arbete framåt för att nå resultat. Du har förmågan och viljan att lära dig nya saker, vara flexibel och öppen för förändringar.
   

  

**Dina Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som har aktuell och relevant:
   

  

* akademisk utbildning om minst 180 hp (120 p enligt gamla systemet) alternativt arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer motsvarande
* flerårig erfarenhet av verksamhetsarkitektur eller motsvarande kvalificerat arkitekturarbete på operativ, taktisk och strategisk nivå
* erfarenhet av att analysera och beskriva samband, beroenden och konsekvenser mellan verksamhetens mål, förmågor, arbetssätt, information och IT
* erfarenhet av att ta fram nulägesbilder, målarkitekturer och beslutsunderlag samt omsätta arkitekturella vägval i konkreta utvecklingsinitiativ
* erfarenhet av att arbeta nära IT-utveckling med god förståelse för hur modern agil IT-utveckling bedrivs


**Det Är Önskvärt Om Du Har**
* erfarenhet av IT-arkitektur, exempelvis arbete med applikationslandskap, integrationer och tekniska beroenden
* erfarenhet av att utveckla och förvalta arkitekturprinciper, målarkitekturer och gemensamma arkitekturbeskrivningar
* erfarenhet av att leda och facilitera workshops samt att visualisera och dokumentera komplexa frågeställningar i modeller och arkitekturbeskrivningar
* formell utbildning inom verksamhetsarkitektur eller Enterprise Architecture, exempelvis certifiering inom området
* erfarenhet av arkitekturmetoder och ramverk, exempelvis ArchiMate eller Astrakan
* erfarenhet av modelleringsverktyg, exempelvis Sparx Enterprise Architect.


**Om oss**
 Kronofogden är en statlig myndighet med ett viktigt uppdrag. Vi jobbar nära människor i utsatta situationer. Vi hjälper den som inte har fått betalt och vägleder den som ska betala. Vi ger medborgare och företag information och god service, så att de kan fatta långsiktiga och hållbara beslut. Det kräver kunskap, handlings­kraft, omtanke och mod. Vi bidrar till ett väl fungerande samhälle för allmänhet och företag – ett samhälle där skulder och andra krav blir fastställda och indrivna på ett rättssäkert sätt.
   

  

 Hos oss kan du räkna med utmanande arbetsuppgifter som även är utvecklande för dig. När du går hem från en dag på jobbet kan du vara säker på att du har gjort något som verkligen räknas – både för andra och för dig.
   

  

**Bra att veta**
 Anställningen är tillsvidare och inleds med provanställning i sex månader. Du blir anställd som verksamhetsutvecklare. Kronofogden erbjuder möjlighet till distansarbete efter överenskommelse med arbetsgivaren.
   

  

 Att arbeta i staten innebär att du följer den statliga värdegrunden. Det ställs också särskilda krav på omdöme, säkerhetstänkande och att du följer gällande lagar. Vi ställer frågor vid intervju om tidigare eventuell brotts­lighet och brister i tidigare anställning. För slutkandidater ställs även dessa frågor till referenspersoner. Vi tar även in uppgifter om skulder registrerade hos Kronofogden, konkurs och närings­förbud. Framkomna uppgifter vägs in vid helhetsbedömningen av din lämplighet för den aktuella anställningen.
   

  

 En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhets­prövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.

title: Data Science Pod Lead
description:
**Mission**
 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
   

  

 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 We are looking for a Data Science Pod Lead to join our Data Science team - a senior technical leader who combines deep hands-on expertise with a passion for growing people and teams. This is a dual-track role: approximately 75% of your time will be spent as an individual contributor, developing and delivering production-ready algorithms and ML models from novel sensor data, while approximately 25% will be dedicated to people leadership, serving as the direct line manager and mentor for a pod of data scientists.
   

  

 You will work across projects such as ECG, Skin imaging, Thermal Imaging, Cardiovascular Algorithms, and Tissue Imaging - turning complex health data into validated, clinically impactful decision support. You will also shape the technical direction and quality standards of your pod, contribute to the broader Data Science leadership team, and collaborate closely with engineers, clinicians, and researchers to bring algorithms and models from prototype to production.
   

  

 If you are motivated by the intersection of cutting-edge machine learning and preventative healthcare, and you want to lead a team while staying close to the technical work, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months**
* Develop, verify, validate, and deploy machine learning models and algorithms for clinical decision support, contributing to new product features or research breakthroughs that improve member outcomes (Member-first, always).
* Build and lead a high-performing pod of data scientists — providing line management, mentorship, regular feedback, and career development support to help each team member thrive (Tech-enabled, human-centred).
* Set and uphold technical standards, code quality, and best practices within the pod, and deliver production-quality code integrated into Neko’s backend infrastructure, raising the bar for technical excellence across the Data Science team (Chase 10X, not 10%).
* Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware engineers, firmware engineers, software engineers, medical doctors, and clinical researchers to develop and validate clinical use-cases, and support the regulatory readiness of algorithms and models (Optimistic truth seeking)
* Contribute to the Data Science leadership team — shaping area-wide strategy, best practices, common tooling, and ways of working alongside other Pod Leads and the Area Lead.


**Requirements**
* MSc or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* 5+ years of relevant industry experience in a Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or Applied Scientist role, or 2+ years post-PhD in a comparable position.
* Demonstrated track record of shipping algorithms or ML models to production in a real-world product or clinical environment.
* Deep expertise in machine learning, signal processing, or computer vision, with hands-on experience across the full ML lifecycle.
* Strong software engineering skills: production-level coding, version control, testing, and integration with backend systems.
* Experience working with sensor data, time-series analysis, or medical imaging in cross-functional R&D environments.
* People leadership experience (e.g. line management, team lead, or equivalent), with the ability to inspire and develop a technical team.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with comfort operating under uncertainty, making pragmatic trade-offs, and driving clarity in ambiguous situations.
* Motivated to apply cutting-edge science to improve preventative and early-detection healthcare.


**Preferred**
* Experience working in a regulated environment (e.g. medical devices, IVD, or equivalent) and familiarity with regulatory requirements for medical algorithms.
* Prior experience in AI-enabled healthcare, medtech, or biotech.
* Systems thinking: ability to design and reason about end-to-end ML systems that are observable, safe, and scalable.
* Demonstrated success mentoring engineers or researchers in high-growth, mission-driven organisations.

title: Platform Advisor - Stockholm
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$200M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

 Our Enterprise and Strategic clients are among the most demanding legal teams in the world, and they expect a team that is prepared, consistent, and technically deep. In legal services, an error or a delayed response carries consequences beyond a frustrated customer: deadlines are fixed, privilege is non-negotiable, and the trust clients place in Legora reflects the trust they carry for their own clients. As a
 **Platform Advisor** 
 , you are part of that global dedicated team, owning issues end-to-end and holding the enterprise readiness standard across every handoff. This is a high-judgment, high-craft seat, and an early one, so you will help build the function as you run it.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Own it end-to-end: Take ownership of Enterprise and Strategic Premium issues from first signal to resolution. Maintain clean handoffs across a global team so clients experience continuity and enterprise-grade consistency, regardless of time zone or shift.
* Master the platform: Build deep expertise across Legora, including Assistant, Tabular Review, Workflows, Editor, and the Word Add-in, to diagnose and resolve complex, high-impact issues that demand structured thinking and sound judgment.
* Communicate with authority: Translate technical detail into concise, confident guidance for demanding professional users, and guide legal teams through complex workflows.
* Resolve first: Own every issue to resolution before escalating. When escalation is the right call, route to the Technical Platform Expert or Principal Platform Advisor with complete diagnostics, clear impact, and a recommended path. Not a hand-off that creates more work.
* Drive improvements: Spot recurring issues and user pain points, and partner with Product, Engineering, and Legal Engineering to fix them at the source. Produce reusable artifacts (playbook sections, troubleshooting guides, resolution templates) that raise the team's baseline.
* Set the standard: The way you handle enterprise readiness, escalation precision, and handoff quality today becomes the benchmark the team scales from.
* Cover the clock: Own your share of the global handoff rhythm. When you come on, pick up open issues with full context. When you hand off, leave nothing ambiguous. Enterprise clients should never feel the seams between regions.


 What you bring
   

  

* You have owned complex, high-stakes B2B relationships and consistently delivered exceptional outcomes for demanding professional clients.
* You turn frustrated users into advocates, and you take pride in the quality of every resolution.
* You notice patterns, surface issues before they escalate, and collaborate across functions to fix them for good.
* You are technically curious, learn new software quickly, and explain hard concepts simply.
* You write clearly under pressure: crisp updates with confirmed facts, named owners, and next steps, without speculation.
* You are fluent with support tooling such as Intercom, Zendesk, or similar platforms.
* A background in SaaS, AI, or legal tech is a strong plus.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

* Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across regions, on work that crosses every major legal market.
* Meaningful work: Your work shapes how the world’s leading legal teams adopt AI day to day.
* Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and the tools to do your best work.
* In-person environment: A workspace built for ambitious builders.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
**Job Title**
 Sales Engineer
   

  

**Job Description**
*Are you passionate about technology, customers and learning? This could be your next step. We're looking for a Sales Engineer to join our Nordic Sales Engineering team in Stockholm. In this role you'll help partners and customers find the right Axis solutions, and you'll learn our products and the security industry from the inside.*
**Your future team**
 You'll join the Nordic Sales Engineering team, part of the Sales Engineering & Training organisation for Northern and Eastern Europe. As a team player you’ll work closely with our sales and marketing colleagues. Together, we provide high-quality technical advice that helps our partners and customers succeed.
   

  

**What You'll Do As a Sales Engineer**
 As a Sales Engineer your mission is to deliver pre-sales engineering support to our partners and customers. By developing strong relationships as a trusted advisor, you help us drive sales growth and customer satisfaction. You'll work with our products, partners and customers every day. This puts you in a unique position to learn about the latest Axis solutions and how they're used, from security to industry projects. Your focus will be the Stockholm area, with some assignments elsewhere in Sweden and the Nordics.
   

  

* Design Axis solutions that meet customers' needs, and support partners in their project design
* Demonstrate, configure and set up Axis solutions for events, demos and proofs of concept
* Take part in customer meetings, trade shows, events and training sessions
* Help partners and colleagues with technical and product questions as a trusted advisor
* Responsible for our showroom in Stockholm and keep it up to date and inspiring
* Keep up with industry developments and keep building your skills


 This is a hybrid role, based in the Stockholm area, with commuting distance to our office in Kungsholmen.
   

  

**Who are you?**
 You're curious about technology and enjoy working with people. You like finding out what customers need and helping them find the best solution. You can explain technical topics clearly to different audiences, and you're comfortable giving presentations. You learn quickly, you enjoy teamwork, and you want to grow in a role that combines technology and business.
   

  

**We'd love to hear that you have:**
* A university degree, ideally in computer science, engineering or a related field
* Minimum 2 years of experience in a customer-facing role where you've used your technical skills
* Familiarity with networking, IP-based technologies or network infrastructure
* Fluent Swedish and English, both spoken and written
* A valid driving license


**Bonus points if you have:**
* Experience in a sales environment
* Experience from the IT, CCTV or security industry


**Travel:** 
 The role involves travel within Sweden for about 30% of your time, plus occasional trips to other Nordic countries.
   

  

**What Axis Has To Offer**
 We're a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance, developing solutions used worldwide.
   

  

 As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation and work-life balance.
   

  

 Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, a wellness allowance, health insurance and even your own Axis bicycle.
   

  

 Curious to discover more? Visit the Life at Axis blog, the Engineering at Axis blog and Innovation at Axis.
   

  

**Ready to act?**
 Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.
   

  

 We go through applications continuously, so don't wait. Send in your application today!
   

  

 If you have questions about the role, please contact
 **Tommy Strandvall** 
 , Manager for Technical Trainers and Sales Engineers, Northern and Eastern Europe, at
 **tommy.strandvall@axis.com** 
 .
   

  

*At Axis, our company is built upon people and values, which is why we do not use artificial intelligence to screen or interview candidates during our recruitment process; we believe in the value of human connection and evaluating every applicant personally.*
 Type of Employment
   

  

 Permanent Employment
   

  

 Posting End Date
   

  

 2026-10-24
   

  

*Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments.* 
*Notice will be provided before we take any action.*
**About Axis Communications**
 We enable a smarter and safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications.
   

  

 With around 6,000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. Together, we thrive in our friendly, open, and collaborative culture and inspire each other to think beyond the expected. United by our commitment to inclusion, diversity, and sustainability, we consistently seek to develop our skills and way of working.
   

  

**Let´s create a smarter and safer world**
 For more information about Axis, please visit our website www.axis.com.

title: Technical Consultant
description:

 Anställningsform** 
 Heltid, tillsvidare
   

  

**Placeringsort** 
 Stockholm
   

  

**Lön** 
 Konkurrenskraftig
   

  

**Om Leyton**
 Leyton är ett globalt konsultbolag med ett unikt mål: att snabbt förbättra våra kunders finansiella resultat utan att påverka deras kärnverksamhet. Vi erbjuder tjänster inom innovationsfinansiering (skatteincitament, bidrag och subventioner), energitjänster, outsourcing av affärsprocesser och olika skatterådgivningstjänster.

title: IT-inköpare
description:
**IT-inköpare konsultuppdrag till Alecta** 




  





**Är du den vi söker?** 




 Vill du arbeta med IT-inköp hos en av Europas största pensionsförvaltare? Alecta söker nu en erfaren IT/IKT-inköpare för ett konsultuppdrag med möjlighet till övertag. Det här är en roll för dig som är driven, självgående och trivs med många kontaktytor i en organisation där samarbete och leverans värderas högt.
 



  





**Arbetsbeskrivning** 




 Som IT/IKT-inköpare driver du IT- och IKT-inköp genom hela avtalets livscykel i nära samarbete med IT, IKT-ansvarig och juridik. Rollen tillhör Alectas inköpsteam som är en del av ekonomiavdelningen. Du är en central länk i trepartsdialogen mellan inköp, IT och verksamheten och tar ägarskap i frågor från kravställning till avtalsuppföljning. En viktig del av rollen är att säkerställa efterlevnad av DORA och bidra till att automatisera manuella processer kring avtalsklasser och regelefterlevnad. Du arbetar också nära verksamheten och leverantörer för att säkerställa effektiva inköp, korrekt avtalsuppföljning och god leverantörsstyrning, och fungerar som ett kompetensstöd inom IT/IKT-området för kollegor och beställare.
 



  





 Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar att:
 


* Leda och genomföra upphandlingar av IT-produkter och tjänster – exempelvis mjukvara, licenser, molntjänster, hårdvara och konsulttjänster
* Tillsammans med IT förstå och formulera kravställning
* Driva dialogen mellan inköp, IT och verksamheten och leda om beställare mot godkända lösningar vid behov
* Säkerställa att IKT-avtal följer DORA och Alectas avtalsklasser i samarbete med IKT-ansvarig och IT-jurist
* Administrera och förvalta IT- och IKT-avtal i organisationens avtalsregister
* Ansvara för avtalsuppföljning och livscykelhantering av IT-avtal
* Följa upp kostnader, fakturor och avtalsvillkor
* Vara operativ kontaktpunkt mot IT/IKT-leverantörer och bidra till goda leverantörsrelationer
* Vägleda och coacha beställare i inköpsprocessen och interna systemstöd
* Bidra till att automatisera manuella processer kring avtalsklasser och regelefterlevnad
* Aktivt omvärldsbevaka utvecklingen inom IT, IKT och leverantörsmarknaden
* Stödja övriga inköp vid behov



  





 Start: omgående
 



 Omfattning: heltid
 



 Kontor: Östermalm
 



  





**Din profil** 




 Vi söker dig som är kommunikativ, driven och trygg i att ta ägarskap och driva frågor till mål. Du navigerar lika obehindrat med beställare, IT-specialister och jurister och är inte rädd för att säga nej och leda om när en föreslagen lösning inte är acceptabel.
 



  





 Vi ser att du har:
 


* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av IT-inköp av system, mjukvara eller molntjänster
* Högskoleutbildning inom inköp, ekonomi, juridik eller IT – eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
* Teknisk förståelse nog att föra en kvalificerad dialog med IT om kravställning
* Kunskap om internstyrning, kontroll och formalia kring inköp och avtal
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift



  





 Det är meriterande om du har:
 


* Erfarenhet av IT-inköp inom bank, finans eller försäkring
* Grundförståelse för DORA och andra relevanta regelverk som GDPR



  





**Om Alecta** 




 Alecta är förvaltare av tjänstepension sedan 1917. Vårt uppdrag är att ge kollektivavtalade tjänstepensioner så stort värde som möjligt för både våra företags- och privatkunder. title: Resiliens Konsult
description:
**Job Description**
**Resiliens Konsult**
 Vill du göra samhället mer motståndskraftigt?
   

  

 Är du vass på beredskap så som kontinuitetsförberedelser, krisledning, riskhantering, försörjningstrygghet, totalförsvar, cybersäkerhet eller säkerhetsskydd? Kan du lära oss något som vi inte förstår? Vi söker en erfaren kollega till vår resiliensavdelning som finns på flera ställen i landet.
   

  

 Vill du skapa effekt på riktigt? Vill du bli lyssnad på? Vara del i team som kan sånt som du inte hade en aning om? Lösa problem åt människor? Förstår systemperspektiv och gillar att analysera samhällsviktig verksamhet?
   

  

 Tag del av vår annons nedan och hör av dig! Vi vill bli ännu fler! Vänta inte!
   

  

 Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att använda din nyfikenhet och kunskap inom beredskap, totalförsvar, informationssäkerhet eller säkerhetsskydd, för att stötta Rambolls kunder att skapa ett hållbart och resilient samhälle för alla dess invånare. För att trivas och lyckas i den här rollen tror vi att du har erfarenhet av utredning/analysarbete, workshops, utbildning och övning inom beredskapsområdet. På Ramboll kommer du kunna omsätta dina kunskaper för att göra skillnad i framtidens Sverige och bidra till att skapa motståndskraftiga samhällen även utanför Sverige då vi även stödjer i Norden och Tyskland för den som har det intresset. Vi ser gärna att du har en bakgrund som på något sätt spetsar dina kunskaper inom resiliens och kompletterar oss andra och att du vill arbeta i en global kontext.
   

  

 Detta är en bred annons där vi snarare vill att du beskriver vad du skulle vilja och kunna göra hos oss, det finns inte en specifik tjänst färdig, vi vill snarare skapa den utifrån dina förmågor, din vilja och vad som behövs för att göra vårt samhälle mer motståndskraftigt.
   

  

 Om du är vår nya kollega inom resiliens – sök gärna!
   

  

**Du kommer att tillhöra Resiliensavdelningen**
 Som medarbetare på Resiliens kommer du bli en del av vår starka satsning för ett mer motståndskraftigt samhälle. Vi ser att Rambolls kunder har en större efterfrågan inom resiliens och vi vill att du är med och utvecklar vårt erbjudande inom det. Vi arbetar innovativt för att hitta framtidens lösningar, vi fokuserar på konkreta och effektiva metoder för en hållbar framtid. Vi arbetar ofta i team och ger dig goda möjligheter att ingå i många olika typer av uppdrag, från tidiga skeden till slutskede. I samarbete med Rambolls experter inom andra områden – exempelvis hållbarhet, beteendeförändring, organisationsutveckling eller den tekniska ingenjörssidan – löser vi även uppdrag inom bland annat vattenrening, infrastruktur, sjukhus, energi och fastighet. Genom att arbeta tillsammans i hela Ramboll strävar vi även efter att integrera resiliensperspektivet i den större samhällsbyggnadskontexten för att skapa verkligt motståndskraftiga samhällen.
   

  

  

  

 Ramboll Resiliens verkar över hela Sverige.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:**
* Genomföra utbildningar och övningar inom exempelvis krisberedskap, totalförsvar, säkerhetsskydd eller angränsande delar
* Utreda och analysera komplexa utmaningar och möjligheter
* Metodutveckling inom krisberedskap, totalförsvar säkerhetsskydd eller angränsande delar
* Strategisk rådgivning inom resiliens


**Utvecklas tillsammans med oss**
 På Ramboll lägger vi stor vikt vid att möjliggöra din personliga och professionella utveckling. Vi erbjuder en dynamisk, inspirerande och innovativ konsultmiljö, där du får arbeta med ambitiösa kunder och kollegor. Dina kollegor utmärks alla av sitt stora samhällsengagemang, sin höga prestationsnivå, utvecklingsvilja, kompetens och prestigelöshet. Gemensamt för alla våra uppdrag är viljan att driva hållbar omställning tillsammans med våra uppdragsgivare och i samhället i stort.
   

  

 För att du ska växa och utvecklas finns här ett nära ledarskap som utmanar, coachar och inkluderar dig i strategiska beslut, där du som medarbetare har ett stort inflytande över vilka frågor och uppdrag du fokuserar på.
   

  

 Vi fäster större vikt vid dina individuella egenskaper och drivkrafter än formella meriter. Men för att lyckas i den här rollen tror vi att:
   

  

  

* Du är villig att utvecklas i din roll och vågar tänka nytt för att utforska nya lösningar
* Du har en vilja och förmåga att skapa delar i ett holistiskt system av andra mekanismer samtidigt som du är konkret.
* Du har erfarenhet av att vägleda och stödja verksamheter
* Du har erfarenhet av planering och utförande av workshops och/eller utbildningar, både digitala och fysiska utbildningar
* Du har goda kommunikativa förmågor i både tal och skrift, på både svenska och engelska
* Du har ett driv att utvecklas inom området och trivs med att ta ett stort eget ansvar
* Erfarenhet och förmåga inom annat område inom resiliens är meriterande då vi ofta verkar i kombinerade uppdrag.
* Du är väl förtrogen med lagstiftning och styrning inom krisberedskap och totalförsvar och förstår hur dessa hänger ihop
* Om du har erfarenhet av kriskommunikation eller angränsande områden är det meriterande


 Om du dessutom gillar att skriva, skapa strukturer i en omgivning som snabbt förändras, är flexibel och kanske varit konsult tidigare så är vi övertygade om att du är rätt för oss, kanske är vi rätt för dig?
   

  

 Du är en person som är ansvarstagande och självständig i dina arbetsuppgifter. Tack vare din strategiska infallsvinkel och samarbetsförmåga lyckas du möta våra kunders krav och leverera lösningar anpassade till morgondagens samhälle. Du är lösningsorienterad och trivs när du arbetar i intressanta projekt där din förmåga att tänka långsiktigt utmanas.
   

  

 Har du erfarenhet från att vara konsult så är du särskilt intressant.
   

  

**Välkommen till Ramboll Management Consulting och Ramboll**
 Ramboll Management Consulting är ett ledande konsultbolag i Norden inom hållbar omställning. Vi är experter på uppdrag där våra kunder styrs eller påverkas av politiska beslut och är specialister på att arbeta interdisciplinärt över gränser. Med 700 konsulter globalt, varav 110 i Sverige, får du hos oss en chans att utvecklas nationellt och globalt inom en stor variation av verksamhetsområden, marknadssegment och uppdragstyper, såväl inom privat som offentlig sektor.
   

  

 Ramboll Management Consulting är en del av Ramboll – en ledande samhällsutvecklare med 17 000 experter i 35 länder som designar framtidens samhällen där människor och natur kan blomstra. I Sverige är vi mer än 1 800 experter på ett trettiotal kontor. Vår globala strategi – ”The Partner for Sustainable Change” – pekar ut en tydlig ambition om Ramboll som en global ledare inom fyra hållbarhetsområden: ”Decarbonize for net zero”, ”Resilient societies and liveability”, ”Resource management and circular economy” och ”Biodiversity and ecosystems”. Med våra grundares värderingar i ryggen, och Rambollfonden som ägare, är Ramboll ”All in” på hållbarhet.
   

  

**Mångfald och en bredd av perspektiv är viktigt för oss**
 För oss är det viktigt att all kompetens på arbetsmarknaden tas tillvara. Vi välkomnar alla sökanden och eftersträvar en mångfald av perspektiv och erfarenheter. Därför ser vi gärna sökande till den här tjänsten som inte är som vi.
   

  

**Din ansökan**
 Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Bifoga ditt CV och personliga brev som beskriver varför du är rätt person för det här jobbet. Arbetsspråk är svenska.  Vi ser fram emot din ansökan så snart som möjligt, vi kommer att hantera ansökningar löpande i denna rekrytering, vänta därför inte med att söka.
   

  

 Att jobba som konsult vid Ramboll Resiliens innebär att du kan komma att omfattas av säkerhetsprövning.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Engagement Manager SMB
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$200M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.

* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the center of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced, strategic Engagement Manager to join our growing team and help a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams fundamentally change the way they work with Legora.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who has developed and executed a scaled customer motion, and who knows that transformation across a large portfolio of clients has to be designed, automated and measured. You will drive adoption, technical health and commercial outcomes of your portfolio end-to-end by leveraging systems and technology while reserving high-touch interactions for the most impactful moments.
   

  

 You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption program at Legora, helping clients realize measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 You'll own the post-sale motion end-to-end for a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams across our EMEA scaled portfolio. Specifically, you will:
   

  

* Improve the scaled adoption playbook: the tech-led onboarding, enablement, and change-management motions and target outcomes for how our scale customers adopt Legora and transform the way they work.
* Execute against that playbook, sequencing automated touchpoints and interventions from initial rollout to firm-wide adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve.
* Facilitate strategic touchpoints with your highest stakes accounts, while using one-to-many enablement to surface high-impact opportunities and guide the rest of the portfolio toward maximum value from Legora.
* Drive sustained value through a programmatic operating cadence: templated success plans, one-to-many enablement, scaled training and digital value reviews.
* Manage the health of the portfolio by monitoring adoption and utilization signals in our internal systems to proactively flag and act on risks and growth opportunities.
* Own the commercials for the scaled program end-to-end by running renewal and expansion as repeatable motions informed by exquisite portfolio hygiene, forecasting, and data utilization.
* Orchestrate engagement across cross-functional teams (Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Product Marketing, Support) to accelerate client success, maintaining end-to-end portfolio context and coordination.
* Translate scaled customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Product Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning, and enablement, and to represent the voice of the scaled segment.


**What You Bring**
 You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation at scale has to be designed, automated and measured. You're proactive, systems-minded and comfortable making tradeoffs about where to intervene and where to let technology do the work. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed.
   

  

**We’re Looking For**
* A scaled customer success, renewal management, or customer education background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering programs that serve large customer bases.
* Experience building repeatable adoption playbooks and educational programs and delivering them at scale across digital channels.
* 3+ years for Manager, 5+ years for Senior Manager, in scaled or digital customer success, customer operations, account management, or a related field, ideally with exposure to high-growth B2B AI verticals or Legal Tech. Leveling will depend on specific experience and fit for the segment.
* A track record of driving adoption, retention and expansion with a high-volume portfolio of clients.
* Ownership of a commercial number: you have carried GRR and NRR for a portfolio and run renewal and expansion yourself as repeatable motions, hitting the thresholds by leveraging data and automation.
* Technical fluency and systems thinking: you're comfortable configuring and deploying tooling (CS and CRM platforms, AI agents, LMS, data visualization platforms) to deliver outcomes.
* Data fluency and a metrics-driven approach to customer health, forecasting and portfolio strategy at scale.
* Exceptional program, project and prioritization skills; you keep many clients and multi-workstream initiatives moving concurrently.
* Excellent Finnish and English communication skills — written, verbal, and interpersonal.
* High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act.
* A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it.


**What We Offer**
* The opportunity to join and grow within Legora’s SMB post-sale engagement team in EMEA.
* A role with real ownership of customer outcomes and visibility across product, go-to-market, and support functions.
* Collaboration with leadership and cross-functional teams to build systems that shape customer outcomes.
* A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where excellence is rewarded, and growth is exponential.
* Competitive compensation, meaningful equity participation, and a Stockholm office designed for focus and high performance.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Master's thesis: Tracing Agentic AI for Efficient and Secure Execution
description:
Master's thesis: Tracing Agentic AI for Efficient and Secure Execution
   

  

 The Connected Intelligence Unit is part of RISE Computer Science in Kista. The current research focus is on devising intelligent autonomous systems for controlling and allocating resources in future computer and communication networks. Among the group's key technologies are the Internet of Things (IoT) and Edge computing. The unit conducts projects together with industry and academic partners from Sweden and across the world.
   

  

**Background and Purpose**
 AI applications are increasingly evolving from individual LLM requests into agentic systems, where AI agents interact with external tools, software environments, data sources, and other agents to complete complex tasks. These applications can exhibit very different execution patterns. Some are sequential, while others involve parallel tool calls, multiple interacting agents, and complex dependencies between individual steps. As a result, agentic applications are fundamentally different from traditional chat-based interactions.
   

  

 However, we still have a limited understanding of these workloads from a systems perspective. Existing traces and characterization tools often capture only part of the execution, for example model requests or high-level tool invocations, while providing little information about the underlying computational resources, data movement, dependencies, and system interactions generated by the complete application.
   

  

 A better understanding of these workloads is important for designing future AI infrastructures. Detailed workload traces could, for example, help decide how different parts of an agentic application should be scheduled across CPUs, GPUs, network accelerators, and other computing resources. They could also help identify security-relevant behavior, such as access to sensitive data or resources, interactions with untrusted tools, and isolation requirements between different workloads.
   

  

**Thesis Description**
 The goal of this thesis is to develop methods and tools for detailed tracing and characterization of agentic AI workloads. You will study existing agentic applications, workload traces, and characterization approaches, and investigate what information is currently missing to accurately describe their execution.
   

  

 Based on this analysis, you will design and implement an enhanced tracing framework able to capture both the high-level structure of an agent workflow and its interaction with the underlying system. Relevant information may include execution dependencies, concurrency, CPU and memory usage, storage and network activity, data movement, and interactions between models and external tools.
   

  

 Using the collected traces, you will characterize different classes of agentic applications and investigate whether patterns can be identified across workloads. The resulting characterization can then be used to explore how agentic workloads could be executed more efficiently and securely. Possible directions include identifying opportunities for acceleration or offloading, and studying security and isolation requirements associated with agent and tool execution.
   

  

**Terms:**
 Start Time: As soon as possible
   

  

 Scope: 30 hp
   

  

 Location: RISE Computer Science, Kista, Stockholm. Option to partially work remotely.
   

  

**Who are you?**
 We expect you to have good programming skills, especially in Python, and an interest in computer systems and AI. Knowledge of Linux, distributed systems, performance profiling, and machine learning are important. You should enjoy experimental systems work and exploring emerging technologies where many research questions are still open.
   

  

**We are looking forward to receiving your application!**
 To know more, please contact Mariano Scazzariello (mariano.scazzariello@ri.se). Applications should include CV, recent grades, and a code excerpt. Candidates are encouraged to send in their application as soon as possible but at the latest by the 1st of November 2026. Suitable applicants will be interviewed as soon as applications are received.

title: Account Executive (Swedish speaking)
description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
   

  

 As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
   

  

 We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
   

  

 If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
   

  

 Let’s build what’s next, together.
   

  

**What this role is all about?**
 To achieve our mission of reaching every mobile user on the planet, it is essential to continue building great relationships with new clients. As Account Executive, you will directly impact how our business moves and succeeds by helping new clients growing their businesses.
   

  

 The main goal for this role is to identify business opportunities with current leads/clients and prospective key clients and to sell Infobip’s product/service offering to its High-touch clients in the designated area and to proactively recommend solutions to our clients.
   

  

 In addition to the actual sales activities, the Account Executive is usually one of the most experienced sales representatives so it is expected of him/her to share his/her knowledge with the rest of the team members, mentor newly recruited sales team members, answer technical and procedural questions for less experienced team members.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Focus on lead qualification and closure for successful sale (pure hunter position)
* Sell a subset of product or services directly or via partners to a customer’s base (provided target account list) in designated team/squad.
* Involve specialists when needed for particular aspects of overall sales (e.g., SE for demo)
* Develop solution proposals encompassing all aspects of the application.
* Manage sales through forecasting, account resource requesting, account strategy, and planning.
* Participate in the development, presentation, and sales of a value proposition.
* Negotiate pricing and contractual agreement to close the sale.
* Maintain client relationships by collaborating with AMs, CSEs or Inside Sales team to sell and maintain account health
* Work closely with BDR teams to take over the lead
* As required cross sell for existing accounts on complicated deals (e.g., renegotiation)


**What Success Looks Like?**
* Quarterly and annual GP goals
* Number of new customers acquired


**How Success Is Rewarded?**
 Performance pays. Employees who meet their targets earn, on average, an additional 30% on top of their base salary, with further earning potential for exceeding targets.
   

  

**What makes you a strong fit?**
* 5 years applicable experience including 2 years of solution sales (in certain situations SaaS sales experience needed)
* Successful sales track record - commission earnings
* Ability to penetrate accounts, meet with stakeholders within accounts.
* Infobip knowledge and/or knowledge of Infobip's competitors.
* Interaction with C level players.
* Team player with strong interpersonal /communication skills.
* Excellent communication/negotiating/closing skills with prospects/customers.
* Bachelor degree or equivalent
* Fluent English and Swedish


**Why you'll love it here**
* Financial rewards & recognition - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) - As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work-life balance and Well-being  - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.
* International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.


*While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.* 
  

  

**Diversity drives connection**
**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.** 
 We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
   

  

 No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.
   

  

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.**
 Read more about our hiring process.

title: Senior Client Solutions Analyst
description:
**Department:** 
 Software Solutions
 



**Location:** 
 Stockholm, Sweden
   

  




**Description**
 Aurora’s Software Solutions team is building the global investment analytics platform for the energy transition. Widely adopted by leading energy companies and investors, the platform is changing how energy-market analytics is performed and delivered. To enable the best possible user experience through both product development and analysis delivery, Aurora’s global Client Solutions team provides the critical end-to-end interface between the underlying model development and the end user.
   

  

 Aurora is seeking a motivated and client-focused (Senior) Power Markets Analyst to join the team in Stockholm and support the use and adoption of Aurora’s software suite in Europe, with a focus on the Nordic power markets (Sweden, Finland, Denmark, and Norway). Stockholm is one of Aurora’s fastest-growing locations, offering early opportunities to make an impact and help lead the development of the Client Solutions team. This role is critical to expanding Aurora’s software offering. It involves working cross-functionally with Aurora’s Advisory, Product, Research, and Commercial teams and requires a combination of power-markets expertise and proficiency with Aurora’s software products.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine astute analytical ability with excellent communication skills and a passion for working with clients. They will be confident discussing power markets and the energy transition and eager to work in a creative, intellectually stimulating, and supportive environment, where they will play a driving role in one of Aurora’s key strategic priorities.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support leading developers, utilities, and funds across the power sector to deploy capital in the energy transition by integrating Aurora’s software into their strategic investment decisions.
* Deliver specialised onboarding training sessions and energy-market workshops to guide customers in using the software to build and interpret asset-specific and market-level revenue forecasts.
* Perform and deliver analyses for software-driven client projects.
* Exercise judgement and critically assess software outputs to ensure our financial forecasts are defensible.
* Help clients leverage insights from Aurora’s software during transactions and strategic decision-making.
* Answer client questions across a broad range of topics, ensuring that clients can unlock value from the software.
* Leverage insights from customer-usage data to perform strategic retention and expansion activities.
* Identify and help implement improvements while contributing to the expansion of the team’s capabilities in the Nordics.


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Required attributes:** 
* At least 1–2 years of professional experience in an analytical, knowledge-driven role.
* Strong understanding of Nordic energy-market topics, including energy policy.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence in client-facing situations.
* A high degree of persistence and a hands-on approach to ensuring that firm-wide goals are achieved.
* Demonstrated success in team environments.
* Ability to work in the Nordics. Please indicate any current or future visa sponsorship requirements as part of your application.
* Professional-level written and spoken English.


**Desirable attributes** 
* Experience in energy consulting or B2B client-facing roles.
* Power-market modelling and/or financial-forecasting experience.
* Transferable knowledge of other European power markets.
* Self-starting, entrepreneurial mindset and a desire to grow the business.
* Familiarity with presenting in front of senior stakeholders
* Understanding of Project Finance, debt transactions, equity transactions, M&A, and asset-management life cycles
* Proficiency in a Scandinavian or Finnic language


**What we offer**
 Some of the benefits we include are:
 * The opportunity to learn how major players in the energy sector view the evolution of power markets and make strategic investment decisions accordingly
* A chance to develop a deep understanding of investment processes such as capital raising, portfolio strategy and management, and transactions
* Direct engagement with clients across the energy industry through client presentations, Aurora conferences, workshops, and webinars
* A fun, informal, collaborative, and international work culture
* A competitive salary package
* Collective Bargaining Agreement
* Physical and mental wellbeing support via OneLab
* Access to regular coaching and mentoring sessions, and the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of development opportunities within the role and in the wider context of the energy sector
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365 on a wide range of personal and professional topics.


 At Aurora, we welcome requests for flexible working. For most roles, flexibility is typically possible through a hybrid model (remote and in-office) and adaptable start and finish times. This role will require four days a week in our Stockholm office. Please speak with us during your interview to explore the best options for you; we are willing to accommodate flexible-working requests.
   

  

 Aurora Energy Research is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates and employees. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of background or identity.
   

  

 The successful candidate will start as soon as possible. The team will review applications as they are received. The salary will be competitive and based on experience.

title: Staff Product Manager-AI
description:
**About Funnel**
 Funnel helps companies get more value from their marketing data. The platform enables teams to collect, organize and use that data to make better decisions and drive growth. As marketing teams increasingly include both people and AI agents, Funnel provides a shared data foundation that both can rely on and act on.
   

  

 We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead our AI domain, which covers agentic functionality in our native no-code app and Funnel’s MCP. This is a highly strategic role at Funnel. Our agentic features have already found strong early product-market fit, with several hundred customers using them every week. That usage gives the team direct feedback, clear evidence of customer value and a strong base to build from.
   

  

 At the same time, we believe this area is still early. AI will continue to change how teams work and create possibilities that were hard to imagine only a few years ago. This role is an opportunity to shape how Funnel competes and grows in an AI-first market, and how marketing teams around the world use data to make better business decisions.
   

  

**The Role**
 As Staff Product Manager-AI, you will lead the product strategy, roadmap and execution for Funnel’s agentic product experiences. You will work closely with engineering, product design, context design, commercial teams and company leadership to define where Funnel should invest, how we should build and how we bring new agentic capabilities to market.
   

  

 This is a staff level role since AI is core to our overall product strategy. With strong support from the CEO, board and executive team, you will have the mandate to influence significant changes across the product experience, the platform and how Funnel creates value for customers. We are looking for someone who can operate beyond a single roadmap: someone who shapes company-level strategy, identifies important risks and opportunities before they are obvious, creates clarity in a fast-moving domain and helps the organization make better decisions about where to invest.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Vision and strategy: Lead the vision and strategy for Funnel’s AI domain, including agentic experiences in the native app and Funnel’s MCP. Shape how Funnel uses AI to change the way marketing teams work with data, from reporting and analysis to setup, governance and decision support.
* Roadmap: Own the AI roadmap and make clear, evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, business impact, technical feasibility and speed of learning. Know when to move quickly, when to invest in foundational capabilities and when to cut scope.
* Product quality and trust: Own the quality bar for agentic experiences. Work with engineering and design to understand how agents behave in practice, where they fail and what is required for users to trust them. Use evals, usage data and customer feedback to improve reliability and overall product quality.
* Product discovery: Build a deep understanding of customer workflows outside Funnel, including how teams use marketing data to make decisions. Run discovery through user interviews, product usage, competitive research, market signals, eval analysis and hands-on experimentation with emerging AI tools.
* Build with cross-functional teams: Work closely with engineering and design to turn strategy into high-quality product experiences that ship, learn and improve quickly. Partner with go-to-market teams to ensure AI capabilities are successfully positioned, launched and adopted.
* Thought leadership: Represent Funnel’s product perspective on AI internally and, where relevant, externally with customers, partners and the broader market. Translate complex technical developments into clear product direction and customer value.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Depth in data and agentic products: Deep experience building and scaling data products, ideally in B2B SaaS. Hands-on experience with agentic products. Strong technical fluency and the ability to work closely with engineering on product decisions. Working fluency in machine learning is a strong plus.
* Business impact: Proven ability to drive business impact, not only ship features. You understand how product decisions affect adoption, retention, revenue and market position.
* Strategic product leadership: Strong strategic ability, including experience shaping product direction, influencing investment decisions and aligning senior stakeholders. You can define a compelling direction while staying grounded in customer evidence, business priorities and technical reality.
* System-level thinking: Strong ability to reason across the full product and business system, not only the immediate feature area.
* Execution discipline: Strong execution discipline, with a bias toward learning quickly, making trade-offs explicit and helping teams maintain momentum. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity while keeping teams focused on the most important work.
* Cross-functional leadership: Strong cross-functional leadership, including the ability to work effectively with engineering, design, marketing, sales and customer-facing teams. You create alignment across functions without relying only on formal authority.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical ideas into clear product direction and customer value.
* Learning mindset: High curiosity and learning speed. The AI landscape changes quickly, and this role requires someone who actively follows the field, experiments with new tools and turns learning into better product decisions. Experience operating at the frontier of a fast-moving technical field, where best practices are still being defined, is highly relevant.
* Experience level: Typically 10-plus years of product management experience, with meaningful experience operating at staff level.


 Additional experience that would be valuable in this role includes:
   

  

* Experience working in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
* Experience with marketing data, marketing measurement, analytics, or reporting.


**Location & Eligibility**
 At This Time, We Can Only Consider Applicants Who Are Already Based In Stockholm And Meet One Of The Following Criteria
   

  

* Hold Swedish citizenship
* Hold EU/EEA citizenship and are currently living in Stockholm
* Have a valid Swedish work permit


**Office-first**
 At Funnel, we have an office-first approach, and we work from the office a minimum of four days a week. We have lots of flexibility for when life happens, during the summer, through the holidays. We just like to avoid having standing remote days.
   

  

 Funnel is the leading Marketing Intelligence platform that empowers marketers to automatically integrate, attribute, measure, and report on data from over 500 marketing platforms.
   

  

 Trusted by almost 3,000 businesses worldwide, including globally recognized brands such as Adidas and Sony, Funnel generated over $70M in ARR in 2025 and continues to feature in the FT 1000 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies.
   

  

 Since its founding in 2014, Funnel has grown into a global team of over 300 employees, with offices in Stockholm, Boston, Hamburg, and Sydney.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
*Natural Cycles° is a leading women’s health company that developed the world’s first birth control app, used by millions globally. We are a fast growing startup, and we promote an international working environment filled with smart and ambitious colleagues based in Stockholm, Geneva, New York, and remotely. Our mission is to pioneer women’s health through research and passion, empowering every woman with the knowledge she needs to take charge of her health.* 




  





 We're looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager to lead our App Pod in the Product Team: the cross-functional team of designers, engineers and testers who build the in-app experience of the Natural Cycles° app. You'll own the pod's roadmap and day-to-day delivery, turning health data, from devices and user input, into clinically grounded features that help women understand their bodies across their whole reproductive health journey.
 



  





 You understand how the product works under the hood, care deeply about the user and about quality, and bring the team along with clear priorities. You use AI every day to work smarter and keep challenging how we work, while your own thinking and judgment stay in charge.
 



  





**Please note that we are hiring for this role in Sweden.** 




  





**What you will be doing** 



* Own the App Pod's roadmap: plan a few quarters ahead, sequence work around dependencies, and keep it achievable
* Lead and grow the pod: sprint planning, backlog, releases and clear priorities for designers, engineers and testers, with people management of team members as the role grows
* Shape features with design from problem to scope, and bring in engineering and QA at the right moment for feasibility and testing
* Build on health data, from what we have today (measuring devices, what users log) to new sources we may add: understand how data flows through our systems and the algorithm, and turn it into clinically grounded features that support women across their whole reproductive health journey
* Prioritize by user value and hold a high quality bar for what we ship
* Work closely with customer support, one of your most important partners: use their insights to find user pain points, and make sure they're ready for every release. Work with other partner teams too, such as data science, platform, regulatory and marketing, to deliver and launch features
* Work with user research and listen to user feedback to understand what users need
* Drive the pod's key metrics, retention and user satisfaction, and build in-app features that support growth and user acquisition
* Look at the data yourself: define success metrics, follow how features perform, and work with our product insights analyst on deeper analysis
* Use AI every day to speed up your work (PRDs, tickets, analysis, operations) and help the pod work smarter with it
* Challenge how we work and improve our processes, from discovery to release
* Work within our regulated setting (FDA-cleared, CE-marked medical device), including documentation and risk management



  





**What skills and experience we think you have** 



* 3+ years as a Product Manager in a tech company
* Experience leading a cross-functional team of designers, developers and testers, and aligning partner teams around clear priorities
* Experience owning a product roadmap and leading quarterly planning
* Strong technical understanding: you can follow architecture and estimates, and explain how data moves through a product
* Strong product sense and user focus: you prioritize by user value and care about quality and detail
* Comfortable working with data: you look at metrics yourself and use them to make decisions
* Daily use of AI in your work, and curiosity about using it in new ways
* A track record of improving how a team works or launching something new, not just maintaining what exists
* Based in Sweden, Stockholm preferred



  





**Nice-to-have skills and experience** 



* Experience in femtech, health or medical devices
* Experience in a regulated setting (ISO 13485, FDA)
* Experience with wearable or sensor data
* Experience leading a large UX restructure of an app
* A technical background (engineering, data, science)



  





**What we offer** 



* Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team based in and around Stockholm that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location
* Professional development - you will work alongside knowledgeable colleagues in the continuous growth and skill enhancement environment
* Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work
* Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value
* Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development



  





**Location** 




 We are remote-friendly, but we find great value in being able to connect with our teams in person.
 **Most of the Product team you will work with is located in Stockholm, and the team occasionally meets in the office for collaboration and face-to-face time.** 




  





**Sounds interesting?** 




 If you want to be part of a successful team, we encourage you to apply for this position as soon as possible.
 



  





 We look forward to hearing from you!
 



  





**How to apply** 




 To apply, just upload your CV and answer the questions on the application form. Keep in mind that we can't accept applications through email because of GDPR, and only applications submitted via the career site (and in English) will be considered.
 



  





 At Natural Cycles we value diversity and inclusion because we know that teams with people from different backgrounds and experiences are stronger. We welcome candidates from all walks of life and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.
 



  





  





**Note: We are not looking for consultants or help from recruitment agencies**

* Pension scheme

 At PostNord, we are looking for a Senior Process Specialist to join our Purchase to Pay team. This is a key role for an AP and SAP expert who will act as the go-to person for the business and our outsourcing partner, ensuring stable operations while driving continuous improvements across our Nordic finance organization.
   

  

**You, Us & The Job**
 PostNord is an important and sustainable part of society. We are proud of our expertise and our ability to drive development across the Nordic region. As a Senior Process Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence within Purchase to Pay and Accounts Payable.
   

  

 You will join our Shared Service Finance Unit and work closely with stakeholders across the Nordic organization as well as our outsourcing partner.
