title: Lead Architect - Digital
description:
We’re redefining how automotive software is built. As a joint venture between Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, Coretura blends startup speed with industry strength. Ever looked at a system and wondered who on earth decided this? Here’s your chance to be the who.
  
  

Coretura Digital is our development kit, internal developer platform, enterprise IT, AI platform, and data and observability. Plenty of good ideas, and they all need to point in the same direction. As Lead Architect, reporting to our CDO, you’re the one who makes that happen. What you’ll do You’ll own the target architecture for all of Digital, which mostly means deciding things.
  
  

**A few examples of what will land on your desk:** The Digital target architecture and principles. Yours to write, and yours to keep current Engineering standards for all of Digital, worked out together with our architects and tech leads The calls on what’s standard, what’s configurable and what’s off-limits as more customers come on board Security and regulation built in from the start with our Security Hub, rather than bolted on the week before an audit How AI shows up across everything we build, together with our AI Hub You’ll represent Digital in our Architecture Forum, where the big decisions are made, and take the day-to-day calls within Digital yourself. Together with our Head of System Architecture, you’ll also shape how our cloud and the software in the vehicle work together. No automotive background needed, we’ll get you up to speed.
  
  

What you bring You’ve made big architecture calls before, and some of them turned out wrong. You know which ones, and why. That’s exactly the experience we’re after. You probably around a decade of experience in software, a lot of it as the architect who actually decided, ideally somewhere that grew fast.
  
  

You go deep in cloud, data, AI or enterprise IT, and distributed systems, multi-tenancy and APIs that other developers depend on are familiar territory. We’re looking for someone who leads through technical credibility and can bring architects and engineers from different teams together around a shared direction. You’re just as credible with executives as with senior engineers, and you know how to guide people toward the solution that works best for everyone. Why Coretura?
  
  

At Coretura, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact. We value initiative, ownership, and a proactive mindset. You’ll have the freedom to drive projects forward, contribute ideas, and help shape the future of commercial vehicle technology. Our lean, innovative team is always learning and adapting, so your contributions will truly matter.
  
  

Next steps Ready to build the future of commercial vehicles? We review applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours! Last application date: 30th of October 2026. Questions?
  
  

Don’t hesitate to reach out to Frida Greve, frida.greve@coretura.com if you have any questions regarding the position. Please note we do not accept any applications via email. About our recruitment process We are committed to a safe and secure working environment. As a mandatory part of our recruitment process, we carry out drug and alcohol testing and background checks via 2Secure on the final candidate.
  
  

The background check covers personal details, financial information, company engagements, legal matters, CV verification, media and internet presence, as well as a risk analysis and recommendation. A negative drug and alcohol test and an approved background check are required before a formal offer can be made. All checks are carried out in accordance with GDPR, and candidates are always informed in advance. Read more →

title: Platform Specialist | Backend & .NET
description:
**Job Description** **Hej Platform Specialist,**


Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?


With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilites, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Platform Specialist, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

 **Your new job**


We’re looking for a Platform Specialist with strong backend and .NET expertise who wants to solve complex, real-world engineering challenges and make product teams more effective. You will join Range Technology Foundation, where we create horizontal capabilities, reusable services, frameworks, automation and guidance that help teams build and operate secure, compliant and reliable digital products. Your primary focus will be turning recurring backend needs into well-designed platform capabilities and attractive golden paths that are easier, safer and faster to adopt than building from scratch.

* On a typical day, you will:
* Design, build and evolve reusable backend capabilities and services using .NET and C#.
* Create reference implementations, libraries, templates and APIs that product teams can adopt with low friction.
* Shape engineering standards for API design, security, observability, testing, resilience and lifecycle management.
* Work hands-on with product teams to understand use cases, simplify onboarding and improve developer experience.
* Bridge product-team needs with shared infrastructure and enterprise platform services, resolving technical dependencies and integration challenges.
* Contribute to CI/CD frameworks, automation and operational readiness, including monitoring, supportability and continuous improvement.
* Document platform setups and patterns, share knowledge and help engineers build confidence in the capabilities we provide.
* Use measures such as adoption, availability, lead time for change, deployment frequency, time to restore service and change failure rate to guide improvements.

 **Qualifications** **What we’d like you to bring to the table**


The role as a Platform Specialist requires you to:

* Have strong professional experience in backend engineering with C# and modern .NET.
* Be skilled in designing and building secure, reliable and maintainable APIs, services and system integrations.
* Understand cloud-native development, containers, CI/CD, automated testing, observability and production operations.
* Turn complex engineering challenges into reusable solutions, clear standards and practical guidance.
* Communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, platform colleagues, architects, product teams and stakeholders.
* Be motivated by enablement: helping other teams move faster while retaining appropriate autonomy and ownership.
* Bring curiosity, sound judgement, attention to detail and a drive for continuous learning and improvement.


It’s a plus if you also:

* Have experience building internal developer platforms, shared libraries, engineering frameworks or self-service capabilities.
* Have worked with Azure services, Kubernetes, API management, identity and access, or infrastructure as code.
* Have experience coaching engineers, facilitating technical decisions or driving adoption across several teams.

 **Additional Information** **Be yourself, a Platform Specialist, and more!**

title: Junior Software Platform Engineer – AI & Automation | SEB Life & Pension, Solna
description:
Are you a recent graduate or early in your career and excited about software engineering, automation, AI and modern development practices?



At SEB Life & Pension, we are modernising how software is built, tested and deployed. Around 25 development teams rely on the platforms, tooling and engineering capabilities we provide.



We are now looking for a Junior Software Platform Engineer who wants to help us improve and shape how software engineering is done at scale.



You do not need previous experience as a Platform Engineer. We are looking for technical curiosity, problem-solving ability and a strong desire to learn, experiment and improve the way software is developed.



### **About the role**



You will join a team responsible for building and improving engineering capabilities used across our development organisation.



Working closely with development teams and other engineers, you will help create tooling, automation and platform capabilities that make software delivery faster, safer and easier.



Your work will span areas such as:



* CI/CD and deployment automation
* Engineering tooling and platform services
* Containers and Kubernetes-based environments
* Infrastructure as Code
* Automated testing, quality and security controls
* Standardisation and self-service for development teams
* AI-assisted and agentic software engineering
A particular focus for us is agentic engineering. We are exploring how AI coding agents, structured specifications, automated testing and engineering guardrails can work together as part of the software development lifecycle.



This is an area we are actively developing, giving you the opportunity to experiment, learn and help shape how these technologies are used across our organisation.



### **Who we are looking for**



You may be a recent graduate or have up to a few years of professional experience. We believe you have a technical university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering Physics or a similar field.



More important than the length of your experience is your curiosity, technical foundation and motivation to learn.



We think you will enjoy this role if you:



* Like programming and solving technical problems
* Are curious about how modern software delivery works
* Enjoy automation and finding ways to reduce repetitive manual work
* Like experimenting with new technologies and approaches
* Want to understand how engineering platforms work at scale
* Enjoy collaborating with developers and other engineers
* Want to contribute to how engineering practices evolve and improve
Your experience may come from university projects, a thesis, internships, open-source contributions, personal technical projects or previous employment. Familiarity with technologies such as C#, Python, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux or Terraform is an advantage, but we do not expect you to know them all. What matters most is a solid technical foundation and a strong willingness to learn.



### **Why join us?**



This role offers the opportunity to develop broad skills across software engineering, automation, cloud-native technologies and AI-assisted development while working with real systems at scale.



The tooling and capabilities you help build can influence how around 25 development teams build and deliver software, meaning an improvement you create can have an impact far beyond your own team.



You will also join us at a time when we are increasing our use of automation and Infrastructure as Code while actively exploring how AI and agentic engineering can become part of everyday software development.



If you are curious, eager to learn and want to help shape how modern software engineering is done at scale, we would like to hear from you.



### **Ready for to join?**


It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today, but no later than **1st of November 2026.**  

If you have questions about the position, please contact Laban Bondesson, Hiring Manager, by email at laban.bondesson@seb.se

**About the SEB & the recruitment process**

Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. We also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.

SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment.

The employment is covered by collective agreements signed between Finansarbetsgivarna and Akademikerföreningen, and between Finansarbetsgivarna and Finansförbundet.

**Learn more about working at SEB** on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.

title: Senior Platform Engineer | SEB Kort, Solna
description:
### **Help shape the future developer platform at SEB Kort.**



We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer who wants to help development teams across SEB Kort build, deploy, secure, and operate software more efficiently.


### **About the role**



You'll join a team that develops and evolves shared engineering capabilities used by multiple teams across the organization. Our focus areas include API automation, CI/CD enablement, Kubernetes platforms, security automation, and AI-powered engineering solutions.



A key part of the role is helping teams adopt modern ways of working through GitHub Actions, Argo CD, developer tooling, and self-service capabilities. We also work with automation that simplifies vulnerability management, dependency handling, and patching activities.



In parallel, we're exploring how AI, agents, and reusable skills can improve developer productivity and automate everyday engineering tasks.


#### **In this role, you will:**


* Develop and maintain API automation and integration solutions
* Develop solutions based on GitHub Actions, Argo CD, and modern CI/CD practices
* Improve developer experience through automation and self-service capabilities
* Build solutions that simplify vulnerability management and automated patching
* Collaborate with developers, architects, security specialists, and platform teams
* Contribute to AI initiatives involving agents, automation, and reusable skills
* Drive continuous improvements across our engineering platforms
* Develop monitoring and observability capabilities that help teams understand platform health, troubleshoot issues, and operate services reliably
* You will work with technologies such as Java, RUST, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node, Next.js, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Docker, Kubernetes and Bash.
### **Who you are**


We're looking for a highly experienced Platform Engineer who thrives on solving complex engineering challenges through automation, standardization, and reusable solutions. You have at least 7 years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, Software Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or a similar field, with a proven track record of driving engineering excellence at scale.
#### **Required experience and competencies:**


* Strong software development skills and experience building production-grade solutions.
* Deep expertise in CI/CD platform GitHub Actions, including pipeline design, governance, and automation.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes in enterprise environments.
* Proven experience implementing DevSecOps practices, including security automation and compliance controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Strong understanding of API design, API governance, and integration architectures.
* Solid experience with observability platforms and operational excellence, including metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, dashboards, incident management, and root-cause analysis.
* Experience designing and operating internal developer platforms or shared engineering capabilities is considered a strong advantage.
#### **You have demonstrated the ability to:**


* Lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions.
* Drive engineering best practices across multiple teams and domains.
* Act as a trusted advisor to engineers, architects, and product stakeholders.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands-on implementation.


Since you will collaborate across the organization and work with both Swedish and international teams, professional proficiency in both Swedish and English is required.


#### **Meriting Qualifications**


* Experience with OpenShift, Google Cloud, or Azure
* Knowledge of RESTful APIs and microservices
* Experience with Argo CD and GitOps
* Experience with developer tooling or internal platforms
* Experience with AI-assisted development, agents, or automation solutions

### **What we offer:**


You'll be part of a highly skilled team working with modern technologies and strategic engineering initiatives across SEB Kort.
Our mission is to make software delivery simpler, safer, and more efficient through platform engineering, automation, and developer self-service.

We offer a collaborative culture, opportunities to influence the future of engineering at SEB Kort, and a hybrid work model with three office days in Solna and two remote days per week.
### **Ready to take the next step on your career journey?**


Welcome to our inclusive culture, where our shared values inspire and uplift our team. We celebrate diversity and strive to ensure every employee feels seen, heard, and valued.

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today, but no later than 28 of October 2026. If you have questions about the position, please contact Håkan Abrahamsson hakan.abrahamsson@seb.se

**About SEB and the recruitment process**



Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, including, for example, identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements, and criminal-record history. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB may also undergo recurring background checks.



SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment.


The employment is covered by collective agreements signed between Finansarbetsgivarna and Akademikerföreningen and between Finansarbetsgivarna and Finansförbundet.



Learn more about working at SEB here: www.sebgroup.com/techcareers


It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.



.

title: DevOps / Build Engineer
description:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer who enjoys working across the full range of game development infrastructure, from Unreal build pipelines and game server deployment to backend services and cloud infrastructure. If you like solving problems that directly affect how fast teams can build, test, and ship games, we'd love to hear from you.
  

**About the Role**  

  

* You will be part of our Tech Foundations team while also working directly with our game teams to support their day-to-day needs. Your role will span two key areas:
  

  

On the game side, you will own and improve the infrastructure behind Unreal Engine development: build pipelines, build caching, automated testing, game deployment, and dedicated server deployment. Your goal is to make sure developers get fast, reliable, and actionable feedback, and that builds reach testers and platforms smoothly.


On the platform side, you will take on more classic DevOps work, including backend application deployment and infrastructure provisioning, in close collaboration with our Cloud and Backend team.


This role suits someone who enjoys variety and can comfortably move between a failing nightly build and an infrastructure change in the same afternoon.
  

**Who you are**  

  

* + Proven experience as a DevOps or Build Engineer working with complex game CI/CD systems.

	+ Senior, hands-on experience with Unreal Engine build and deployment workflows, including delivering production-ready projects.

	+ Experience deploying and operating backend services and cloud infrastructure, including infrastructure as code.

	+ Strong understanding of CI/CD infrastructure, tooling, and operational pipelines.

	+ Skilled in diagnosing complex issues across build systems, servers, and infrastructure, and getting to the root cause quickly.

	+ Passionate about improving developer experience and workflow efficiency.

	+ Collaborative and comfortable working across teams with different needs, from game developers to backend engineers.

	+ Committed to clear documentation and effective knowledge transfer.

	+ Comfortable working in our tech stack:
	  
	
		- Jenkins (Groovy, Jenkins pipeline)
		- Perforce version control
		- Python
		- Golang (used in backend applications)
		- Game platform SDKs (PlayStation, Xbox, Steam, etc.)
		- Grafana / Zabbix
		- GCP or similar cloud providers
		- Infrastructure as code, e.g. Terraform
		- Containers and orchestration, e.g. Docker / Kubernetes  
	
	**Nice to have:**
	+ Experience with Unreal build acceleration and caching, such as Derived Data Cache, Zen server, or Unreal Build Accelerator.

	+ Experience with Unreal automation testing frameworks such as Gauntlet.

	+ Experience hosting and orchestrating dedicated game servers.

	+ Familiarity with platform submission and certification workflows.
  

**What you'll do**  

  

* Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines for Unreal projects, covering compiling, cooking, packaging, and distribution.
* Own and optimize build caching infrastructure to keep iteration times short across the studio.
* Develop and maintain automated testing infrastructure so game teams can catch issues early.
* Automate deployment of game builds to internal testers and platform storefronts, and of dedicated servers to test and live environments.
* Deploy and operate backend applications in partnership with the Cloud and Backend team.
* Provision and manage infrastructure using infrastructure as code practices.
* Improve feedback, logging, monitoring, and error reporting across pipelines and services, introducing mechanisms for quick root cause determination.
* Keep pipelines healthy by acting on and recovering from failures to unblock development.
* Work directly with game teams to understand their needs, while aligning solutions with Tech Foundations standards.
* Produce clear documentation and guidance so improvements are adopted and maintainable long-term.
*Note: Research shows under-represented groups in the industry might not apply to a job if they don’t check off every requirement. At Avalanche, we’re more about your drive to learn and interest in tackling challenges than what’s on your resume! So don’t stress if you don’t tick every box— shoot us your application anyway! Diverse opinions and different experiences are what make our teams so great, not itemized lists of qualifications.*
**The Stockholm location**
Our Stockholm office is situated in Södermalm, the beating heart of the city’s game industry. It’s a physical representation of our games – the lush vegetation of Just Cause and theHunter: Call of the Wild meets corroded metal straight out of Mad Max. Our hybrid model requires you to be in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays to foster collaboration and creativity.
**Our values**
At Avalanche Studios Group, we create worlds beyond limits. But that’s not exclusive to our games, so we’re committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. All Avalanchers have a shared responsibility to create an open work environment where everyone is treated equally and respectfully. Being part of our world is not contingent on your heritage, your gender, or sexual orientation. It’s all about your passion and creativity.
**How to apply**
To apply for this position, provide your CV in English. We review applications continuously. All further studio-related information is provided under a non-disclosure agreement.
*At Avalanche Studios Group we're always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our passionate team, but please note that relocation assistance is not available for this role.*

* Ta fram, uppdatera och kvalitetssäkra teknisk användardokumentation för nya produkter och produktförändringar.
* Skapa och underhålla användarmanualer, monteringsanvisningar, illustrationer och annat informationsmaterial.
* Säkerställa att teknisk dokumentation uppfyller marknads- och myndighetskrav inom medicinteknik.
* Hantera och koordinera översättningar av produktdokumentation för internationella marknader.
* Administrera och publicera produktinformation i våra system och plattformar.
* Driva förbättringar och utveckling av arbetssätt, verktyg och struktur för teknisk dokumentation.
* Bidra med teknisk information och illustrationer i utvecklings- och underhållsprojekt.


Du kommer att tillhöra R&D-teamet, där du rapporterar till Head of R&D, och arbeta nära produktchefer, konstruktörer, kvalitetsfunktioner och andra specialistroller. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och ett stort eget ansvar. Du blir Etacs specialist inom teknikinformation med ett helhetsansvar för området och får möjlighet att utveckla och modernisera arbetssätt, verktyg och processer för teknisk dokumentation. Tjänsten blir ledig då vår nuvarande Teknikinformatör går i pension efter många framgångsrika år på Etac. Du kommer därför att få en gedigen överlämning från en erfaren specialist med djup kunskap om våra produkter, processer och arbetssätt, vilket ger dig mycket goda förutsättningar att växa in i rollen.

 **Din profil**


Vi söker dig som har:

* Utbildning inom teknikinformation, teknisk kommunikation eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
* Erfarenhet av att skapa och strukturera teknisk dokumentation, exempelvis användarmanualer, instruktioner eller produktinformation.
* Goda kunskaper i Adobe InDesign och erfarenhet av Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska.


Det är meriterande om du även har:

* CAD-kunskap, exempelvis i SolidWorks.
* Erfarenhet av SolidWorks Composer.
* Erfarenhet av XML-baserade system eller andra verktyg för dokument- och informationshantering.


Vi söker dig som trivs i en specialistroll och vill vara med och utveckla framtidens teknikinformation på Etac. Du kan vara i början av din karriär eller ha flera års erfarenhet, men har ett starkt intresse för teknisk kommunikation och en vilja att utvecklas inom området. Som person är du strukturerad, noggrann och trivs med att skapa ordning i komplex information. Du är självgående och känner dig bekväm med att ta ansvar för ett specialistområde där du ofta behöver prioritera och driva arbetet framåt på egen hand. Samtidigt har du lätt för att samarbeta med olika funktioner och kan omsätta tekniska detaljer till tydlig och användarvänlig information. Vi tror också att du är nyfiken på nya arbetssätt och drivs av att utveckla och förbättra processer utan att tappa fokus på kvalitet och regulatoriska krav.  

  

**Varför Etac?**


På Etac utvecklar vi produkter som gör vardagen enklare och mer självständig för människor världen över. Som Teknikinformatör har du en viktig roll i att säkerställa att våra produkter används på ett säkert, korrekt och effektivt sätt genom tydlig och användarvänlig information.


Det här är en roll för dig som vill kombinera teknik, kommunikation och struktur i ett arbete där kvalitet verkligen spelar roll. Du får möjlighet att bli vår specialist inom teknisk dokumentation och vara med och utveckla hur vi arbetar med teknikinformation framåt, samtidigt som du förvaltar en viktig grund av kunskap och dokumentation.

* Arbeta med produkter som förbättrar människors livskvalitet varje dag.
* Ta ett specialistansvar med stor frihet och möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt, processer och verktyg.
* Samarbeta med engagerade kollegor inom produktutveckling, kvalitet och produktledning.
* Vara en del av ett internationellt företag där innovation, kvalitet och användarfokus står i centrum.
* Få en unik möjlighet att ta över en etablerad specialistroll med stöd av en gedigen överlämning från nuvarande rollinnehavare.

 **Intresserad?**  

Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. För frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta *Sandra Mansikka (**talent acquisition**)* via email *Sandra.Mansikka@etac.com**.* Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via mail.

title: Senior Technical Manager
description:
Senior Technical Manager
Helsingborg, Skåne län
**Job Summary**
---------------


**Engineering Management** | **Microservices Architecture** | **Event-Driven Systems** 

**Cloud Platforms (GCP, Ali cloud)** | **Kafka | Solace & Messaging** | **DevOps & CI/CD** 

**Distributed Systems** | **Kubernetes & Docker** | **Technical Leadership** 

**Retail Domain Expertise** | **Agile & Roadmap Planning** | **People Development**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Engineering Excellence**

* Define and enforce Dev & QE best practices across squads
* Own Tech Design and Implementation approach
* Establish and operate DevOps pipelines and practices
* Drive AI enablement across engineering workflows

**Delivery & Execution**

* Accountable for overall Sprint Execution and capacity planning
* Facilitate and unblock work across all Engineering Leads
* Manage RAAIDD - with emphasis on unblocking technical dependencies
* Coordinate Release management in collaboration with the client
* Drive Go/No-Go decisions collaboratively with client’s stakeholders
* Own Production Cutover strategy and facilitation

**Agile & Ceremonies**

* Champion and embed Agile Ways of Working across teams
* Manage sprint estimations, velocity tracking, and capacity accountability
* Track all standard Agile/Scrum metrics and component KPIs

**People & Resources**

* People management - performance, growth, and engagement
* Assess resource requirements and skill sets; flag gaps proactively
* Act as closest leadership touchpoint to Squads, ELs, and engineers

**Governance & Financials**

* Manage tech costs and drive platform/people cost optimisation
* Measure and report on Delivery, Quality, Time, Cost, and Scope metrics
* Lead Change Request impact assessments
* Align dependencies across squads and external teams

**Stakeholder Collaboration (Amigos Model)**

* Collaborate across Product, Architecture, Data Architecture, PM, EL, QA, Legacy Team, and BAs
* Operate at multi-squad level bridging Engineering and Delivery roles
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


**Technical Expertise**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience; 3+ years leading engineering teams of 10 or more.
* Deep expertise in microservices architecture and event-driven systems (Apache Kafka, Solace, AWS MSK, or equivalent).
* Hands-on cloud experience on GCP/Ali cloud and their services.
* Strong foundation in Java/Kotlin and Spring Boot for backend systems.
* Proven track record delivering CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices in a production environment.
* Experience with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Database proficiency: PostgreSQL, MySQL, or equivalent; awareness of NoSQL and caching patterns (Redis/ElastiCache).
* Familiarity with API design (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and integration patterns (ESB migration, strangler fig).
  

**Retail / Domain Context (Preferred)**

* Experience with retail or e-commerce platform modernization
* Understanding of omnichannel retail architecture

**Leadership & Soft Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to manage hiring, performance, and career development for distributed engineering teams.
* Excellent stakeholder communication - able to translate technical complexity into clear business language.
* Strong agile practitioner; experience with SAFe or LeSS in large program contexts is a plus.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving decisions in a fast-paced transformation environment.
**Other Requirements**
----------------------

title: Senior Azure Cloud Engineer
description:
*Vi utmanar de traditionella konsultbolagen och vi kan med stolthet säga att Castra är konsultbranschens mest utvecklande arbetsplats där allt är möjligt. Känns det här som företaget för dig så läs gärna vidare.*
**Rollen**
 Vi söker en erfaren Senior Azure Cloud Engineer som vill vara med och designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla moderna, säkra och skalbara molnlösningar i Microsoft Azure. Du kommer att arbeta nära utvecklingsteam, arkitekter, driftorganisation och andra tekniska roller för att skapa stabila och effektiva molnmiljöer som möter både verksamhetens och teknikens behov.
   

  

 I rollen ansvarar du för att designa, implementera och förvalta Azure-baserad infrastruktur och plattformstjänster. Du kommer att arbeta med molnarkitektur, automatisering, säkerhet, nätverk och övervakning samt bidra till att etablera och vidareutveckla arbetssätt för Infrastructure as Code och CI/CD. Du förväntas kunna identifiera förbättringsområden, optimera prestanda och kostnader samt säkerställa att molnlösningarna följer etablerade riktlinjer för säkerhet, tillgänglighet och skalbarhet.

Du har förmågan att omsätta tekniska och verksamhetsmässiga krav till hållbara lösningar, skapa struktur i komplexa miljöer och samarbeta med olika intressenter. Som Senior Azure Cloud Engineer förväntas du kunna ta ett helhetsansvar inom ditt tekniska område, bidra med arkitektoniska vägval och fungera som en kunskapsresurs för teamet.
   

  

**Erfarenhet**

* God kompetens inom Azure-infrastruktur, inklusive compute, storage, nätverk, identitet och säkerhet.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform eller Bicep.
* Erfarenhet av automatisering och skriptning med PowerShell, Azure CLI eller Python.
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD och automatiserade flöden för provisionering och deployment.
* God förståelse för Azure-nätverk, inklusive virtuella nätverk, routing, DNS, private endpoints och brandväggar.
* Erfarenhet av Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities och säker åtkomsthantering.
* Erfarenhet av övervakning, loggning, felsökning och incidenthantering i produktionsmiljöer.
* Förmåga att självständigt driva tekniska initiativ, göra arkitektoniska avvägningar och samarbeta med utvecklings- och driftteam.
* Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift.


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av Azure landing zones, Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) och Well-Architected Framework.
* Erfarenhet av Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Docker och containerbaserade lösningar.
* Erfarenhet av kostnadsoptimering (FinOps), molnmigrering och hybridmoln.
* Erfarenhet av Azure-baserade databastjänster, exempelvis Azure SQL Database och Cosmos DB.
* Relevanta Azure-certifieringar samt erfarenhet från privat och/eller offentlig sektor.


**Varför ska du välja oss?**
 Här tror vi på frihet, möjligheter och medbestämmande. Att du som medarbetare ska ha möjlighet att utvecklas och forma ditt arbete utefter dina intressen och prioriteringar i livet. Att alla får vara med och forma och påverka bolaget genom delägarskap, advisory board och projektgrupper. Att det är viktigt att ha ett sammanhang, känna tillhörighet och att man har kollegor som stöttar, utvecklar och tror på en.
   

  

**Om Castra**
 Castra är en entreprenörsdriven konsultgrupp inom IT, management och systemutveckling. Bolaget ägs gemensamt av medarbetarna och tillsammans bygger vi det företag vi själva vill jobba på.
   

  

 Vår vision är att vi ska vara Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare för konsulter. Att vi blivit certifierade av Great Place to Work® fem år i rad är ett bevis på våra höga mål kring företagskultur. Våra tankar om delaktighet, påverkansmöjligheter och respekt för individens egna val och möjligheter fungerar.
   

  

 Företaget har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg, Malmö, Linköping, Norrköping, Örebro och Jönköping. Mer information om Castra-koncernen hittar du på vår hemsida www.castra.se.

 At Adobe, we help the world's leading brands create exceptional customer experiences. As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to some of the largest and most strategic organisations across the Nordic region.
   

  

 You will partner with customers to maximise the value of their Adobe Experience Cloud investment by driving technical readiness, solution adoption, operational excellence, and long-term business outcomes. Acting as an extension of the customer's team, you will provide proactive technical leadership, coordinate technical engagement activities, and help customers navigate complex digital transformation initiatives. As a champion for the customer, you will share personalised knowledge and business-critical insights across people, process, and technology, align Adobe teams on the customer’s behalf, and deliver consistent value across the entire customer journey.
   

  

****What You'll Do****
 As a Technical Account Manager, you will:
   

  

* Build positive relationships with customer collaborators ranging from technical practitioners through to senior leadership.
* Own the technical health of assigned customer accounts and proactively identify risks, opportunities, and optimisation recommendations.
* Develop and maintain Technical Readiness Roadmaps aligned to customer priorities and business objectives.
* Lead technical reviews including environment reviews, service reviews, release readiness discussions, and operational health assessments.
* Coordinate milestone-based engagements such as implementations, migrations, upgrades, integrations, go-lives, and peak-event preparation.
* Drive adoption of Adobe solutions through best-practice guidance, technical coaching, and use-case activation.
* Partner with Customer Success Managers, Solution Consultants, Product teams, Support, Engineering, and Technical Account Directors to ensure successful customer outcomes.
* Act as the customer's technical advocate within Adobe and facilitate appropriate management of blocking issues when required.
* Deliver regular business and technical insights that demonstrate customer value and support renewal readiness.
* Contribute to customer retention, growth, and long-term success through proactive engagement and careful planning.
* Connect customers with the right Adobe resources — such as Professional Services or Integrated Services — when hands-on implementation, development, or deployment work is required.


****Key Responsibilities****
**Technical Leadership**
* Provide strategic technical guidance across Adobe Experience Cloud solutions.
* Assess customer environments and recommend improvements to performance, stability, governance, and scalability.
* Support customers through major business events and digital initiatives.


**Customer Success**
* Drive measurable customer outcomes through structured technical engagements.
* Help customers realise value from existing investments and identify new opportunities for optimisation.
* Maintain a deep understanding of customer business objectives and technical priorities.


**Programme Management**
* Coordinate technical activities across multiple collaborators.
* Track customer objectives, technical achievements, and success plans.
* Ensure timely execution of agreed actions and commitments.


**Risk Management**
* Identify technical risks before they impact business outcomes.
* Develop mitigation plans and coordinate resources across Adobe teams.
* Support executive communications during critical situations when needed.


****Required Experience****
**What We're Looking For**
* Experience working in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Consulting, Solution Architecture, Professional Services, Technical Support, or a related customer-facing technology role.
* Experience managing enterprise customer relationships.
* Strong understanding of SaaS, cloud technologies, digital platforms, or enterprise software.
* Excellent communication and collaborator management skills.
* Ability to understand both business objectives and technical requirements.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and coordinating multiple collaborators.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with digital marketing, customer experience platforms, analytics, personalization, ecommerce, or marketing technology ecosystems.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud solutions.
* Knowledge of web technologies, APIs, integrations, data flows, and cloud architectures.
* Experience presenting to executive and senior leadership audiences.
* Project or programme management experience.
* Industry insight relevant to the customer’s sector, with the ability to translate market and technology trends into practical recommendations.


**Success in This Role**
* Build executive presence and trusted advisor relationships.
* Proactively identify risks and opportunities before customers do.
* Coordinate complex technical initiatives with confidence.
* Balance technical depth with strong business insight.
* Drive measurable customer outcomes while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
* Partner effectively across global and regional Adobe teams.


 This role sits within Adobe’s Technical Account Manager / Director (TAM/TAD) career framework, offering a clear path for growth as your scope and customer portfolio expand
   

  

 As our many awards will tell you, at Adobe you’ll be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You’ll be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog, https://blog.adobe.com/en/topics/adobe-life and explore the fantastic benefits we offer at Rewards.adobe.com.

title: Teradata Architect
description:
**About Cognizant**
 Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, helping organizations modernize technology, reimagine processes, and transform experiences so they stay ahead in a fast-changing world. With over 300,000 associates globally, Cognizant combines a passion for client satisfaction, technology innovation, deep industry and business process expertise, and a global, collaborative workforce that embodies the future of work. We are consistently listed among the most admired companies in the world and among the best companies to work for. Our culture is built on a foundation of transparency, inclusion, and collaboration — empowering our people to grow and thrive both professionally and personally. At Cognizant, you won't just be part of a company; you'll be part of a community that is shaping the future of industries across the globe.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced Teradata Architect with strong Snowflake expertise to lead and drive a large-scale data warehouse transformation within the banking sector. In this role, you will be responsible for guiding the migration from legacy Teradata environments to a modern Snowflake-based cloud data platform, ensuring a smooth, efficient, and scalable transition.
   

  

 The role requires a combination of deep technical expertise, architectural thinking, and hands-on involvement, along with the ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, and business teams.
   

  

 Location: Stockholm
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 You will take ownership of understanding the current Teradata data warehouse landscape and play a central role in driving its migration to Snowflake. This includes reviewing and validating the end-to-end migration strategy and identifying areas for improvement or optimization.
   

  

 You will support the design and evolution of the target Snowflake architecture, including storage, compute, and security layers, ensuring alignment with business and technical requirements. A key part of the role is working closely with engineering teams to convert Teradata SQL, stored procedures, and macros into Snowflake-compatible solutions, while refactoring scripts for improved performance and scalability.
   

  

 You will collaborate with data engineers, cloud architects, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment across the transformation initiative. In addition, you will provide technical leadership and mentorship, helping to guide teams through the migration and build best-practice capabilities.
   

  

 The role also includes working with existing security and access control frameworks, translating current role-based access models into the Snowflake environment, and ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance and compliance standards.
   

  

**Core Requirements**
 You bring strong experience in Teradata architecture and data warehousing, combined with advanced proficiency in SQL across both Teradata and Snowflake environments. You have hands-on experience working with Snowflake and a solid understanding of how to migrate, transform, and optimize data warehouse solutions in a cloud context.
   

  

 You have experience leading or playing a key role in at least one full-scale data warehouse migration and are comfortable working in complex transformation environments where both legacy and modern platforms coexist.
   

  

**Desirable Skills**
 Experience working with ETL tools is valuable, with familiarity in platforms such as IDMC considered an advantage. You bring a collaborative mindset and are used to working in cross-functional teams, contributing not only to technical delivery but also to overall solution design and continuous improvement.

title: Technology Account Partner - Banking - Nordics
description:
**What We’re All About.**
 Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.
   

  

**We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.**
**The opportunity.**
 This role will be based in Stockholm on a remote basis, with co-working spaces available, and will require travel to customer sites where appropriate.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Act as a functional expert in Quantexa’s platform and products, with a strong understanding of its capabilities and how they can be applied to real-world banking challenges.
* Bring a strong understanding of banking practices, regulatory environments and industry challenges, helping customers identify opportunities, gaps and risks that Quantexa can address.
* Lead discovery sessions with customers, prospects and partners to understand business challenges, technical requirements and desired outcomes.
* Work with customers, partners and internal teams to design and refine tailored solutions, ensuring the approach is aligned to the customer’s needs and objectives.
* Advise customers and internal teams on enterprise deployment options and technical decisions, helping to shape solutions that are scalable, practical and fit for purpose.
* Act as a key member of the account team for selected strategic banking customers, helping to define account strategy and drive long-term business value through the Quantexa platform.
* Own the strategy and vision for Decision Intelligence across the customer enterprise, helping senior stakeholders understand how Quantexa can support their broader business objectives.
* Work closely with Product, Delivery and strategic partners to ensure alignment with customer goals, adherence to agreed Blueprints and successful delivery, value realisation and expansion.
* Drive operational adoption of the Quantexa platform, ensuring customers are able to realise ongoing value from their investment.
* Build and maintain strong executive-level relationships, establishing appropriate governance and acting as a trusted strategic partner to key stakeholders.
* Support renewal and expansion opportunities, identifying where Quantexa can deliver additional value across the customer organisation.
* Contribute to the growth and development of the Banking Field Engineering function, sharing expertise, supporting colleagues and helping shape how the team works as it scales.


**What You’ll Bring.**
* Customer Focus: Your dedication to understanding customer needs is paramount. You consistently align with the core problems at hand, ensuring you grasp both the broader picture and the intricate details. You communicate effectively with senior level business and technology customers and convey confidence in sharing your perspectives. You are adept at helping customers define a strategic roadmap that enables them to realize the value of their Quantexa products.
* Technology Expertise: You will understand data or specialise in one of our solution domains within banking, including data management, financial crime, risk management, fraud detection or customer intelligence. You have platform implementation experience, understand the challenges faced by customers, and bring credibility through proven results.
* Relationship Management: You have significant experience working with clients and a proven aptitude for fostering and nurturing executive relationships. Customers should feel assured of your dedication, viewing you as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor.
* Consultative Approach: With an analytical mindset, you evaluate challenges from various perspectives. Collaborative in nature, you work alongside customers and internal teams to delineate and implement the most effective solutions. You have experience in a consulting role and are comfortable working with internal teams and customers to bring value.
* Scaling Teams: You have experience working across functions to create effective collaboration, driving best practices, and can provide clear and concise customer feedback to internal teams.
* You’ll be a team player internally across Quantexa teams and externally, building strong relationships is core as we are better as a team.
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with a track record of effective customer engagement
* Great communicator, able to captivate audiences of all sizes with an innate ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.


**Desired Skills & Experience**
* Significant experience in a commercially focused technical role, such as Solution Engineering, Pre-Sales, Technical Sales or Value Consulting.
* Strong experience working with data and technology platforms within the banking sector, whether through implementation, delivery or direct use.
* Experience setting and delivering against a long-term vision and roadmap.
* Strong product and technology expertise within the banking industry, with the credibility to engage with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Proven ability to build and manage relationships with senior and executive-level stakeholders.
* Willingness and ability to travel as required for customer and business needs.


**Required**
* Fluent in both Swedish and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.


**Our perks and quirks.**
 What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.
   

  

**We Offer**
* Competitive salary & Company bonus
* Annual leave, plus national holidays + your birthday off!
* Regularly bench-marked salary rates
* Well-being days
* Volunteer Day off
* Work from Home Equipment
* Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app
* Continuous Training and Development
* Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy
* Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials


**Our mission.**
 We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.
   

  

**It’s All About You.**
 We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you
 *Q* 
 . We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible.
 **If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.**
 No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Services Account Executive
description:
**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**Role Description**
 The primary goal of the
 **Services Account Executive** 
 position is to achieve and exceed an overall bookings quota for SAP Professional Services for both cloud and on-premises deployments. Services Account Executives work closely with the SAP License organization, SAP Delivery counterparts, customers, and partners to support the successful sale and implementation of SAP solutions and are expected to significantly contribute to the overall success of the customer relationship.
   

  

**Expectations And Tasks**
* Develop and execute territory and account plans leveraging available resources (e.g. lines of service, marketing, delivery) to drive pipeline and close opportunities.
* Ensure pipeline coverage across the territory and the breadth of SAP Services’ portfolio of products and services.
* Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing customers to help them achieve their strategy by leveraging SAP Services.
* Understand the customer decision process and build relationships with key decision makers, nurture champions and coaches, and advance deals through the sales cycle.
* Update, maintain, and accurately report regular updates to sales forecast and territory plan.
* Build productive internal relationships with license sales, alliances, services delivery, product management, and other groups.
* Participate in customer discovery and implementation scoping sessions to define requirements for input into implementation plans, estimates, resource models, and pricing models.
* Create formal services proposals, RFP responses, Statements of Work (SOW), and services contracts.
* Coordinate with internal resources, subject matter experts, and teams to formulate overall customer solutions and services that drive customer success.
* Create and deliver customer presentations on implementation methodology, approach, best practices, risk mitigation strategies, and deployment recommendations.
* Support the sales-to-services transition post-sale.


**Experience, Skills And Education**
* 3–5 years of services sales experience
* 2+ years of services delivery, consulting, or implementation experience
* Professional presence and ability to participate in discovery sessions with customers
* Ability to develop and maintain territory planning and pipeline development activities
* Experience identifying opportunities and managing them through the sales process to close
* Ability to lead and influence internal teams to drive pipeline and close deals
* Ability to research and understand customer business challenges and connect them to SAP Cloud Services portfolio value propositions
* Able to apply the principles of value-based selling throughout a sales cycle
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred


**LOCATION:**
 This role is located in Stockholm and requires fluent English language skills.
   

  

**Bring out your best**
 SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
   

  

**We win with inclusion**
 SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.
   

  

 SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
   

  

 For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.
   

  

 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.
   

  

 Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.
